jobs.description: Who We Are Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY. Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface. Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.  Description Cobalt is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to join our marketing team. This isn't a traditional demand gen role. We are building a sophisticated Growth Marketing framework that is focused on automation and orchestration to identify accounts with the highest propensity to buy, and nurture them into turning purchase ready.  In this role, you will develop and execute integrated marketing playbooks and measure the efficacy of the programs on regular cadences. With the goal of generating and accelerating pipeline across North America and EMEA regions, you will leverage your experience to build systems that are scaleable, repeatable and sustainable. With tight alignment with Sales and Revenue Operations teams, you will utilize Salesforce, UserGems, HubSpot to identify intent and track buyer movement, in support of both new business and expansion pipeline. You are accountable, fearless in taking ownership, and ready to move beyond "lead gen" to innovate programs across the entire customer journey. What You’ll Do Full-Lifecycle Account Progression: Develop and execute integrated marketing plans aligned to company growth objectives, focusing on both new logo acquisition and expansion within existing customer accounts. Multi-Touch Program Engagement : Drive multi-channel initiatives (such as email, webinars, social, direct mail and digital advertising) to guide target prospects through every phase of the buyer journey. Automation & AI Agents: Design and oversee automated agents to streamline routine workflows, accelerate program delivery, and ensure swift, confident execution. Intent & Movement Orchestration: Use UserGems intent signals and tracking to trigger automated playbooks that reach and engage buying committees and follow previous champions to new target accounts. Customer Marketing & Advocacy: Develop programs to nurture existing customers, leveraging their success stories to drive whitespace expansion and cross-sell. Content Strategy & Execution: Co-own the content calendar alongside the content team, designing multi-format programs to engage key contacts and activate target accounts. Sales & Success Enablement: Act as the primary marketing contact for sales and BDR teams, leading weekly syncs to align, equip, and empower sellers on activation plans and performance expectations. Analytics & Optimization: Track active program metrics continuously, taking direct ownership of course corrections to ensure key performance targets are met. You Must Have Experience: 6+ years of marketing experience with a focus on growth, demand generation, or regional marketing, ideally within a B2B technology or cybersecurity environment. ABM Execution: Demonstrable expertise in account-based marketing strategies, tactics, and modern growth technologies. Marketing Automation & CRM: Demonstrated expertise with Salesforce, HubSpot, and intent tools (such as UserGems or 6Sense), along with hands-on experience developing MCP agents Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret data to derive actionable insights that drive campaign optimization and improve outcomes. Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for creating engaging, conversion-focused content. Accountability: A strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. jobs.title: Director, Lifecycle Marketing Operations
jobs.description: About the role Chime is hiring a Director of Lifecycle Marketing Operations to build and run the operational engine behind everything we send to members: campaign execution, channel health and deliverability, the automation and platform layer, and the governance that keeps it all safe and high quality at scale. Most of that work is manual today. Your mandate is to make it faster, higher quality, and increasingly automated, with an agent-supported operation as the destination. You'll lead a growing execution team through an execution lead and a set of channel and platform specialists, and partner closely with MarTech, Growth Engineering, and the lifecycle strategy leads to turn strategy into live, high-quality messaging. This is a leadership role with real technical depth: you set the operational strategy and prioritize the work, and you go deep into the detail when it counts. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $211,000 and up to $275,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. In this role, you can expect to Own the Messaging Operations engine and set its operational strategy across campaign execution, channel health, deliverability, automation, and the platform layer — and own the metrics that say whether it's working: throughput, quality, speed to launch, deliverability, and channel health. Own the operational process end to end, from intake to launch: build, QA, deployment, and the standards that keep quality and speed high as volume grows. Drive the automation and AI-agent roadmap, taking the team from manual execution to supervising and governing automated workflows, and fold what you learn from experimentation into the wider Lifecycle roadmap. Own governance for everything that ships: channel standards, deliverability and compliance, and the QA model for automated and agent-driven sending, in a regulated environment where safe sending is non-negotiable. Own channel excellence across email, push, in-app, and SMS — health, analytics, opt-in/opt-out, and deliverability. Set the benchmarks the operation runs on, connect them to the business metrics leaders care about, and scout and pilot new channels before we need them. Build and lead a growing, increasingly technical team through an execution lead plus channel and platform specialists: set the structure, proactively source talent for your team and across Chime, set clear expectations, and give the team the context and room to own outcomes. Act as Lifecycle's primary stakeholder to MarTech on how we use the platform and what gets built on top of it, partner with Growth Engineering on the build, and work with the lifecycle strategy leads to turn their plans into live messaging. To thrive in this role, you have 8+ years in marketing or CRM operations, lifecycle execution, or martech, including 3+ years leading teams — with experience developing leads or managers, not only individual contributors. Deep expertise with engagement and CRM platforms (Braze or similar): campaign operations, journey architecture, automation, and the technical layer underneath. A strong track record in governance: setting and enforcing channel, deliverability, and compliance standards, and building the QA that keeps a high-volume operation safe. A real track record of building toward automation. You've scaled manual processes and have a clear point of view on where AI and agents fit in marketing operations. Deep channel health and deliverability expertise at scale: sender reputation, inbox placement, fatigue management, and opt-in/opt-out hygiene. Strong operational and analytical judgment. You run on metrics, can tell at a glance whether the engine is healthy, and balance speed against safe, compliant sending in a regulated environment. The influence to align peer Directors and VPs across Marketing, Engineering, and Product on shared standards, and the range to lead at altitude on strategy and transformation while translating the technical detail into a story each audience can act on. Bonus points if you have Experience standing up or scaling an automation or agent layer in a marketing or CRM context. Fintech or regulated-industry experience and the compliance instincts that come with it. Experience in a business where owned-channel volume is measured in millions of sends per week. #LI-Onsite #LI-AM1 A little about us At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential. We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. Sales and Customer Success win and onboard employer partners; once a partner is live, we gain access to their workforce — their eligible employees . Converting those eligible employees into Chime members is the challenge this role owns, and mastering it unlocks one of the most powerful and defensible distribution channels at Chime. While the role retains core product marketing strengths — research, positioning, and messaging — it goes further by owning results and tradeoffs. This role sits at the intersection of growth and financial responsibility, requiring strong strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to balance business impact with member trust and regulatory considerations. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $150,000.00 and up to $208,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. jobs.title: Senior Strategist, Paid Search B2B
jobs.description: About Code3 Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms. Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.  With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success. The Opportunity As a Senior Strategist, Paid Search B2B, you’ll be responsible for leading paid search strategy, activation and thought leadership across a portfolio of B2B clients. You’ll bring a strong understanding of how search can drive demand throughout the B2B buyer journey, from initial consideration and lead generation through qualified opportunities, pipeline and revenue. You have a deep passion for staying on top of trends and understand how paid search fits into the broader B2B media and demand generation ecosystem. You’ll work closely with cross-disciplinary teams across both challenger and enterprise accounts, managing performance, driving growth and helping clients shift their thinking beyond basic campaign metrics to connect paid search investment with broader marketing, sales and business outcomes. What you’ll do: Provide paid search strategy & conduct routine audits on your portfolio of B2B  accounts across platforms  (Google and Microsoft) and tactics (Brand, Non-Brand, PMAX, Demand Gen, Competitor, and other emerging search opportunities) Develop paid search strategies designed to generate qualified leads, opportunities, and sales pipeline, aligning campaign strategy with each client’s business objectives Deliver activation excellence on campaign builds, pacing management and optimization deployment Conduct keyword research, writing ad copy, optimizations and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs Perform QA for all campaign builds, edits, landing pages, URL tags, campaign settings and measurement studies Leverage CRM, marketing automation and analytics data to evaluate paid search performance beyond the initial website conversion and identify the campaigns, keywords and audiences driving the greatest business value Partner with client and internal teams to develop measurement approaches and feedback loops that connect paid search activity to lead quality, sales outcomes, pipeline, and revenue Be a storyteller: turning complex search strategies into compelling campaign recommendations Maintain high standards across media planning, forecasting, budgeting, campaign setup, learning agenda development, and performance analysis Cultivate strong relationships with clients by providing POVs, industry trends, platform updates and acting as a trusted advisor on search and digital marketing Support new business initiatives and pitches by conducting platform audits and recommendations Who will love this role:  A paid search marketer who is passionate about the ever-changing media landscape and the evolving role search plays within B2B marketing A data-driven decision-maker who enjoys connecting media performance to lead quality, pipeline and business growth Someone who is curious about the full customer journey and wants to understand what happens after a prospect converts A people person who enjoys building close relationships with teams, partners, and clients Someone who is passionate about sharing thought leadership and new ideas through presentations, blogs, and other content channels A problem solver with the ability to develop creative solutions  You should have:  4-6 years of hands-on paid search experience, including substantial experience developing and optimizing SEM programs for B2B organizations with lead-generation, pipeline and revenue objectives Demonstrated experience developing and executing paid search strategies designed to generate qualified leads, opportunities and sales pipeline Ability to anticipate client requests, team and agency needs and provide proactive solutions Experience working with CRM and marketing automation data to evaluate paid search performance beyond the initial website conversion; experience with platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo or similar strongly preferred Certifications in digital marketing and/or paid search media strategy are a plus ( Google Analytics Certification, Microsoft Advertising Search Certification, Google Ads Search Certification, etc.) The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents  here . For best results, open the link in a new tab. Salary Range $82,000 — $106,000 USD Working at Code3 At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human. Here’s what you can expect as a Coder: Remote-first workplace designed to support flexibility and connection Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits , plus a generous retirement program Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program Flexible Time Off , sabbatical opportunities, paid holidays, quarterly Company “Recharge” Days, and a holiday closure in December Ongoing learning and development opportunities  to help you grow your skills and career A commitment to transparent DEIB practices  and building a workplace where everyone can thrive A Few Things to Know All candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check. Want to get to know us a little better? Check out  Life at Code3  to learn more about our people, culture, and what it’s like to be a Coder. Our Interview Process During this first call, we’ll get to know you, learn more about your experience, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next opportunity. We’ll also explore alignment with our company and values, and depending on the role, we may ask a few technical or role-specific questions. From there, the process can look a little different depending on the role. You can expect to meet several members of the team and, for some positions, complete a skills assessment such as a Take-Home Assignment or Live Exercise. We’ll make sure you know what to expect every step of the way. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk you through the full process during your initial conversation. Inclusive Workforce At Code3, we’re committed to creating a culture where people from all backgrounds feel welcome, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We want every Coder to feel included and have the opportunity to contribute fully to our vision and goals. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic in the location where the candidate is applying. If you have an accessibility need or would benefit from an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know at recruiting@code3.com. We’re happy to work with you to make the process as comfortable and accessible as possible. For more information about the data we collect and how we use it, please refer to our  Privacy Policy . We use AI technology to help streamline parts of our hiring workflow. People are at the heart of our hiring process, and all candidate decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition Team. Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruitment firms.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Manager
jobs.location: Leeds, England, United Kingdom; United States - Remote
jobs.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview   We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Campaign Manager to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple business units within our Education Division. This role will act as the key liaison between each business unit and our external marketing agency to drive pipeline growth across the division’s portfolio of products and services.   Location: This role is open to candidates based in the Eastern U.S. time zone as a fully remote opportunity, with a preference for candidates based in or near Leeds, UK, where the role can be offered in a hybrid/remote capacity. Key Responsibilities   Campaign Strategy & Planning   Develop and lead comprehensive, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned to business unit goals.   Collaborate with business unit stakeholders to understand target audiences, value propositions, and key business priorities to inform marketing campaign strategy and messaging.   Execution & Project Management   Manage end-to-end campaign execution, partnering with business unit functional teams and our external marketing agency.   Own campaign timelines, deliverables, and budgets, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.   Performance & Optimization   Monitor and analyze campaign performance using marketing analytics tools and dashboards.   Continuously test, optimize, and iterate based on data-driven insights to improve conversion rates and pipeline contribution.   Collaboration & Communication   Partner closely with sales to ensure campaign alignment, support enablement, and accelerate opportunities.   Communicate campaign plans, performance, and insights to key stakeholders across marketing and business leadership.   Competencies   Strategic Execution: Able to translate business objectives into measurable marketing campaigns. Balances creative concepts with analytical rigor to ensure campaigns ladder up to pipeline, revenue, and brand goals. Demonstrates a strong understanding of audience segmentation and funnel dynamics.   Analytical Decision-Making: Comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify patterns, draw insights, and recommend next steps. Skilled at using experimentation frameworks (A/B, multivariate, incrementality) to validate hypotheses and continuously improve performance.   Operational Excellence: Drives campaigns from ideation through post-mortem with exceptional organization and attention to detail. Anticipates dependencies across channels, timelines, and stakeholders; maintains clear documentation and repeatable processes for scale.   Communication and Collaboration: Communicates campaign goals, insights, and results clearly across marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams. Skilled in vendor and stakeholder management, ensuring alignment on deliverables, expectations, and optimization decisions.   Agility and Growth Mindset: Thrives in dynamic environments. Rapidly adapts to performance trends, feedback, or market changes while maintaining focus on long-term objectives. Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning in new platforms, tools, and testing methods.   Creative and Brand Stewardship: Shows strong creative judgment and an eye for brand consistency across channels. Partners effectively with content and design teams to ensure messaging and visuals drive engagement while staying true to the company’s identity.   Qualifications & Experience   Required Qualifications   5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2+ years in campaign management.   Experience managing campaigns across multiple business units or products within a division.   Proven success driving integrated campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes (pipeline, revenue)   Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.   Proficiency in marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot (or Marketo/Eloqua), Google Analytics, and project management tools.   Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.   Familiarity with segmentation, personalization, and campaign automation best practices.   Preferred Qualifications   Vertical B2B SaaS experience in education or edtech   Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies. Why Join Us? At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance: Health and Wellness: Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment. Retirement Savings: 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life. Parental Leave: 12 weeks paid leave for all employees. Remote Work Support: Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely. Holidays: Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones. Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one! jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Science & Analytics
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.  We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.   We have offices in the US, London and Germany.  Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, Planet Fitness, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.       OVERVIEW We are hiring a Supervisor, Marketing Science & Analytics to join Redbox, Crossmedia’s marketing science and data science team. You will serve as a day-to-day analytical lead across client engagements, new business opportunities, and internal initiatives, partnering closely with Analysts, Engineers, Directors, and cross-functional agency teams. This role combines hands-on statistical and data science expertise with client leadership, team management, and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear, actionable insights. YOUR ROLE Lead marketing science and analytics workstreams across current clients, new business, and internal initiatives, managing projects from data and measurement through analysis, insights, and recommendations. Partner directly with clients and account teams to define measurement objectives, translate business questions into testable hypotheses, and develop rigorous analytical approaches. Apply statistical and data science methods including media mix modeling (MMM), regression, causal inference, experimentation, geo-lift/DMA holdout testing, Bayesian methods, segmentation, forecasting, and optimization. Build, interpret, and communicate statistical models and translate complex analyses into compelling, actionable stories for clients and internal stakeholders. Use Python and SQL to analyze data and build reproducible, well-documented analytical workflows; experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery is preferred. Develop dashboards, visualizations, and other data products using tools such as Tableau, Python visualization libraries, or Datorama. Manage analytical delivery and execution with external measurement and data partners. Serve as a trusted statistical and marketing science expert in client meetings, confidently explaining methodology, findings, limitations, and recommendations. Ensure analytical work is statistically rigorous, reproducible, and meets XM’s standards for quality. Lead and mentor Analysts and Data Scientists, providing guidance on prioritization, analytical approaches, coding practices, and professional development. Keep Directors and account teams informed of project progress, risks, and key decisions, escalating issues and seeking senior support when appropriate. Contribute to the development of Redbox’s marketing science and data science capabilities through training, thought leadership, technical content, and new methodologies. Participate in broader team and agency initiatives, including talent development, recruiting, vendor management, and department planning. Stay current on emerging statistical, data science, and marketing measurement approaches and adapt as Redbox’s tools and capabilities evolve. REQUIREMENTS: 3+ years of experience in marketing science, statistics, econometrics, data science, or another quantitative discipline; media or advertising experience is a plus. Strong foundation in statistics and hands-on experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems. Proficiency in Python, with experience using tools such as pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, PyMC, Meridian, or similar. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets; cloud data warehouse experience preferred. Experience with marketing measurement, including MMM, incrementality, experimentation, causal inference, or related methodologies. Ability to independently manage analytical workstreams and client relationships while knowing when to bring in senior leadership. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience managing, mentoring, or developing junior team members. Curiosity, sound analytical judgment, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning. Ability to thrive in a collaborative, evolving environment and move comfortably between client work, new business, and internal initiatives. CROSSMEDIA BENEFITS Our principles of Trust, Reason, and the Pursuit of Happiness are brought to life through benefits that recognize and support the diversity and physical, emotional, and professional well-being of our people, including: Flexibility to work in hybrid manner with in-office and work from home options (depending on role).  Open/Flexible PTO/Annual leave with US & UK specific policies  Sponsored healthcare options and agency-wide physical & mental health support  401k with company match (USA), and generous Pension (UK)  Paid sabbatical at significant milestone anniversaries Generous paid parental leave policy Life milestone recognition & support The Pursuit of Happiness Fund devoted to helping Crossmedians find their happy (be it travel, enrichment class, fitness membership or professional development) Cell phone/tech reimbursement Student Loan payment plan (US) Tuition reimbursement Learning & Development and training programs And burgers – lots and lots of burgers   COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION Diversity is in our DNA. As a minority-owned company, our commitment to an inclusive environment has long been embedded into agency practices and at every level. Almost one third of senior leadership identifies as a person of color and over half of our executive leadership are women. We have active mentoring & internship programs that create opportunities for underrepresented groups. Internal agency programming is anchored by XMEquity365, a permanent, year-round initiative fostering acknowledgement and support of marginalized communities within five pillars – Excellence, Voices, Education, Giving & Representation. Crossmedia is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and creating a diverse and inclusive company culture and that does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.  All job requirements are subject to possible revision to reflect changes in the position requirements, business necessities and/or to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Essential and other job functions are subject to modification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to which will be required in this position. Employees will be required to follow other job-related duties as requested by their supervisor/manager (within guidelines and compliance with laws in the US and UK ). Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.” Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions in compliance with the American with Disabilities Act of 1990 (US based)  Physical Demands:  The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:  Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. Ability to stand, bend, and reach Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer. The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer). In compliance with the current Americans with Disabilities Act and state and local laws, if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation to apply for a position with Crossmedia, please email  people.team@xmedia.com .  (US based candidates).

jobs.title: Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central
jobs.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.  Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the Role We’re looking for an Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central to join Cresta’s Revenue Marketing team. This role owns strategy, execution, and performance across a high-volume portfolio of field marketing programs — from industry events and executive dinners to regional programs, roadshows, customer experiences, and partner activations. This isn’t an events-for-events-sake role. Field Marketing is a meaningful pipeline channel at Cresta, and you’ll partner closely with Sales to determine where we invest, which accounts and audiences we target, and how programs contribute to pipeline creation and acceleration. You’ll typically own 8–10+ programs per quarter and be responsible for taking them from initial strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, measurement, and optimization. Location: This is a remote role supporting our East region. We strongly prefer candidates currently based on the U.S. East Coast , but are open to candidates in the Central U.S. who can easily support Eastern time zones and regional travel. This role requires approximately 20–30% travel , with heavier travel during peak event seasons. Responsibilities Own Field Strategy + Execution: Build and execute field marketing programs aligned to regional Sales priorities, target accounts, and pipeline goals. Drive Pipeline + ROI: Set program KPIs, track sourced and influenced pipeline, measure conversion and ROI, and translate results into clear recommendations. Partner Closely with Sales: Work with Sales before, during, and after programs on account targeting, attendance, meetings, follow-up, and opportunity acceleration. Manage a High-Volume Portfolio: Own 8–10+ programs per quarter across tradeshows, executive dinners, roadshows, customer programs, regional activations, and partner events. Own Programs End-to-End: Manage strategy, budgets, vendors, contracts, promotion, attendee experience, onsite execution, and post-event reporting. Make Smart Investment Decisions: Evaluate program performance, forecast spend, identify trade-offs, and shift investment toward the programs driving the strongest business impact. Build Integrated Campaigns: Partner with Demand Gen, Digital, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales to drive attendance and engagement across target accounts. Create Standout Experiences: Bring new ideas and formats to the table that differentiate Cresta and create meaningful experiences for customers and prospects. Build Repeatable Playbooks: Develop processes and workflows that allow the field marketing motion to scale as Cresta grows. Support Executive Programs: Partner with Cresta executives and Sales leaders on messaging, speaker preparation, executive experiences, and customer engagement. Qualifications 3–5+ years of B2B field marketing, regional marketing, event marketing, or integrated campaign experience Experience owning field programs end-to-end , from strategy through execution and measurement Comfortable managing 8–10+ concurrent programs per quarter in a fast-moving environment Strong understanding of pipeline, revenue attribution, conversion, and event ROI Proven experience partnering directly with Sales on account targeting, program strategy, and follow-up Experience managing program budgets, vendors, contracts, and competing priorities Strong communicator who can work effectively across Sales, Marketing, executives, agencies, and external partners Currently based in the Eastern or Central U.S., with a strong preference for East Coast Willing and able to travel approximately 20–30% Preferred Qualifications Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or startup environment Experience with AI, Contact Center, Customer Experience, or adjacent enterprise technology Experience supporting enterprise or strategic Sales teams Experience with ABM/account-based field marketing programs Previous Sales/SDR experience or strong understanding of enterprise Sales processes Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and field marketing/event tools such as Mobly Perks & Benefits Medical, dental, and vision plans designed to fit you and your family’s needs Flexible vacation time to support a healthy work-life blend Paid parental leave Monthly gym and phone allowance Work-from-home office stipend Lunches and dinners for in-office employees via Grubhub Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors including experience, skills, education, and geography. jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger. It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline. You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working. What You'll Do Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself. Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution. Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results. Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume. Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync. Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution. Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread. What You'll Bring A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync. Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency. Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks. B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle. Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners. Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role. Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively  manage internal stakeholders and external vendors and partners. Bonus Points Experience in privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or another regulated, technical software category. Marketo or Pardot experience alongside HubSpot. Familiarity with account-based marketing or intent-data tools. Comfort using AI to speed up operational work, such as campaign QA, data hygiene, or reporting synthesis. Experience being the first or founding owner of a demand gen or marketing ops function, from the ground up with hands-on responsibility for building and scaling it.  What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: Learn DataGrail's product, buyer personas, and ICP quickly enough to start contributing, not just observing, and meet the marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success teams to understand what's running and where the friction is. Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel. Drive the event calendar and process, and produce a keep, fix, or cut recommendation for each program. Audit HubSpot and existing reporting, and deliver a written list of what's fragile, missing, or misleading in current attribution and lifecycle reporting. Ship at least one visible fix to a live, underperforming channel or process Within 180 Days You'll: Show measurable improvement, with before and after comparisons, on two to three of the biggest inefficiencies identified in the 90-day audit, whether that's rebalanced paid spend, improved event-to-pipeline conversion, or cleaner attribution. Run paid media and events with full autonomy, proposing and executing budget and calendar changes without waiting on sign-off. Ship at least three new or rebuilt nurture and re-engagement tracks, with early performance data on each. Rebuild or upgrade the dashboards used for weekly pipeline calls. Build a working rhythm with Sales, RevOps, and Product Marketing so hand-offs, routing, and lead flow don't require chasing people down. Within 365 Days You'll: Own a program for paid media, events, and HubSpot that runs noticeably better than the one you inherited, with clear before and after numbers on channel efficiency and cost per qualified opportunity. Be the person others trust when they want to know how well our campaigns and events are actually performing. Have made real budget and channel calls, moving spend into what works and cutting what doesn't, with pipeline impact you can point to. Have built a foundation that doesn't need rebuilding when volume doubles. Have identified where the team needs more support, whether that's tooling, headcount, or an agency change, and made the case for it.   Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $140,000 — $165,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law.  Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing
jobs.description: Role Description As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox’s regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets—Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan—while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox’s global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance.   You will be Dropbox Marketing’s senior voice in the region—bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution. Responsibilities Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox’s global marketing strategy. Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth. Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics. Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data. Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution. Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox’s market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand. Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams. Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI. Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression. Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution. Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries. Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-country APJ marketing strategies that produced measurable pipeline and sales impact. People-management experience, including coaching and developing marketers working across different countries, cultures, or time zones. Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, translate sales priorities into marketing plans, and build alignment through planning and business reviews. Experience leading an integrated mix of field and channel programs, including events, account-based programs, partner co-marketing, campaigns, and pipeline-acceleration initiatives. Strong commercial and analytical skills, including experience managing regional budgets, setting program KPIs, evaluating pipeline contribution, and using performance data to optimize investment. Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed, and highly collaborative organization. Preferred Qualifications Deep familiarity with the APJ technology market, with experience developing differentiated strategies across mature and emerging markets; direct experience in several of Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets is strongly preferred. Experience in a channel-led or partner-influenced go-to-market model, including co-marketing with resellers, distributors, alliances, or technology partners. Experience building or evolving a regional marketing function, operating model, or playbook in a growing or changing business. Strong understanding of enterprise and commercial buying journeys, account-based marketing, opportunity acceleration, and regional event strategy. Experience working in a Virtual First or similarly distributed global organization. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.   About the Opportunity As a Growth Marketing Specialist, you will scale our Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) by contributing to enrollment growth. In this role, you will support the marketing strategy and enrollment goals for key device categories. By combining your skills in multi-channel marketing and project management, you will execute initiatives that champion our VPP programs. You will also collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to support existing relationships and identify opportunities for optimization.   To thrive in this role, you should be a versatile marketer who embraces new challenges as opportunities to learn and grow. A natural curiosity and an appetite for testing, analyzing, and adapting will be the keys to your success. What you will do: Deeply understand the customer journey, identify friction points, and stay informed about industry realities. Execute multi-channel marketing campaigns, including paid social, to deliver measurable growth. Use marketing analytics to build reporting and surface data-driven insights for ongoing initiatives. Help manage paid media, regularly analyzing marketing efforts to identify bottlenecks, optimize channels, and confidently make strategic assumptions with existing data. Coordinate co-marketing efforts with OEMs, complementary brands, and communities. Explore creative messaging strategies and work with external copywriters and designers to deliver high-quality, on-brand content and design assets. What we expect from you: 3-4 years of non-internship marketing experience, ideally in a startup or agency environment where you gained hands-on experience across multiple channels rather than being specialized in just one area. High comfort level with ambiguity. You are willing to test out new concepts, learn fast, and pivot your approach when data tells you a campaign is not working. Foundational knowledge of marketing analytics with a growing ability to review datasets and translate insights into actionable strategies. Hands-on experience with marketing tracking, platforms, and tools like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta, and CMS platforms. Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools such as Sigma, Tableau, or adjacent technologies is a plus.  Strong project management and communication skills to support multiple campaigns and collaborate effectively across teams. Curiosity to develop category knowledge and a willingness to learn creative and customer experience best practices. Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time. Why work for EnergyHub? Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other. Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team! Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs. Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate. About EnergyHub EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power. Cross-sell, upsell, and the new product line are entirely self-serve. There is no human in the loop, which means the messaging, the timing, and the on-page experience have to carry the entire decision on their own. Life insurance is a high-consideration purchase, so lack of trust and product understanding are the biggest drivers of drop-off. Across all three journeys, you own the connective tissue that moves someone from "a company I found on the internet" to "a company I trust to safeguard my future." You will operate on shared OKRs with the product managers who own each of these three areas, and — for the conversion journey — in close working partnership with Sales leadership, agents, and our voice AI team. Build the digital nurture that moves people forward on their own, and build the follow-up content, sequences, and talking points that make every agent and voice AI conversation land — the right articles, proof points, or next steps that can go out within minutes of a call ending, and a system that gets smarter over time rather than sending the same packet to everyone. Own its self-serve lifecycle end to end: activation, onboarding, and the messaging that turns early traction into a repeatable, scaling funnel. Copywriting and Messaging Strategy. Self-Serve Conversion Instincts. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. The Opportunity  Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches. We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting. This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project. You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it. What You'll Be Doing Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones. Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it. Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter. Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content. Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing. Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it. What Makes You a Great Fit 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus). Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions. Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers. Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for. Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword. Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust. Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator. Bonus Points For Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries. Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost. Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem. Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar). Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. jobs.description: Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. We are looking for a Principal PMM to own the narrative, strategy, and GTM for the fastest-moving surface in our platform – the agentic execution layer that turns everything Gong knows about a revenue organization into action. This is where the vision for the Gong Revenue AI OS becomes real for the market. This is not a role for someone who wants to market features. This is a category-defining role for a technical buyer audience. You will shape how enterprise IT and revenue operations leaders think about agentic AI for revenue: what governed execution actually looks like, how organizations move from agent sprawl to a coordinated operating model, and why the data foundation underneath agents is what determines whether they deliver compounding value or plateau. You will partner closely with Product, GTM, and executive leadership to turn a genuinely new architectural concept into a narrative that earns trust with buyers who evaluate infrastructure, not just software. RESPONSIBILITIES Own the technical buyer narrative — define positioning and messaging that earns credibility with CIOs and RevOps leaders evaluating enterprise AI infrastructure for revenue. Go beyond outcomes: make governance models, orchestration architecture, data permissioning, and agent lifecycle management feel purpose-built and immediately trustworthy. Build the infrastructure conversation — develop the content, frameworks, and tools that help CIOs and RevOps architects understand how Gong fits into their AI stack. This means data flows, governance controls, agent coordination, MCP integrations, audit trails, and the role of the Gong Revenue Graph as the grounding layer that makes autonomous execution reliable at enterprise scale. Unify AI and execution into a single story — intelligence and execution are one product. Your job is to make the integrated picture feel inevitable to a technical buyer who has spent the past 18 months evaluating fragmented point solutions and wondering why none of them hold up in production. Take a portfolio view — make and defend recommendations about how AI execution capabilities are packaged and monetized across the platform. Shape product and GTM strategy — bring structured buyer, competitive, and analyst insights into product planning; develop a deep POV on how enterprise IT and revenue operations teams evaluate, adopt, and govern agentic AI; be the team’s expert on how this market is evolving and how enterprises are making platform decisions. Drive high-impact launches — partner with the broader PMM team, PM, Enablement, sales, post-sales, comms, and ops to drive launches from brief to execution. QUALIFICATIONS  8+ years of B2B product marketing experience, with at least four years owning the full PMM lifecycle for an AI platform, agentic infrastructure, or complex workflow product at an enterprise SaaS company with demonstrated success marketing to technical buyers.  Working knowledge of agentic workflow concepts: triggers, actions, plays, next-best-action, human-in-the-loop governance, MCP integrations, and how enterprises think about AI governance and data residency. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You write with precision, distill architectural concepts into narratives that earn trust, and can adapt your message to a variety of audiences across business and technical audiences. A bias toward evidence and action — you test positioning with customers, validate it in win/loss data, and iterate based on what actually moves technical buyers. Comfort operating in ambiguity and at pace. Gong ships fast. You will make good decisions with incomplete information and adapt as the product and market evolve. Experience marketing to RevOps, Sales Operations, or Revenue Leadership (CRO, VP Sales) personas. A track record of making complex, multi-layered systems feel coherent and inevitable to skeptical enterprise buyers. You have had to explain governance models, data permissioning, orchestration logic, or agent lifecycle management and made it land. Prior experience working on a product that was actively defining or expanding a market category, not just competing in an established one. Experience with analyst relations (Gartner, Forrester) — you have presented at briefings, shaped Magic Quadrant narratives, or contributed to Wave evaluations. Comfort with quantitative analysis: win/loss data, pipeline influence metrics, adoption curves, and consumption/credit pricing models. PERKS & BENEFITS  We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.  We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.   Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.   If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. Reporting to the Head of Japan Field Marketing, you will create and localize credible content for Japanese enterprise buyers, then work with Sales, partners, and marketing teams to ensure it reaches the right audiences and contributes to demand and pipeline. This is an individual contributor role. “Manager” reflects ownership of the content marketing function and does not currently include people-management responsibilities. Improve priority Japanese website pages and lead localization and editorial quality for global content. Create Japan-native content such as customer stories, blog articles, solution guides, white papers, e-books, and video scripts. Build practical SEO and AIO/GEO programs that improve discovery, engagement, and conversion. Develop Japanese customer references and proof points with customers, Sales, Customer Success, Communications, and Legal. Partner with Sales and Field Marketing to identify content gaps in priority accounts and active opportunities, and develop sales-ready assets that help buyers take the next step. Plan how major content will be distributed and activated across digital, events, partners, nurture, and Sales channels. Collaborate with Glean partners to review deliverables and co-create content that is relevant to shared customers and campaigns. Manage agencies and freelancers while maintaining ownership of messaging, product accuracy, and final quality. Measure content performance and use the results to improve engagement, lead generation, Sales usage, and pipeline influence. About you:  You are a native-level Japanese writer and editor with professional English communication skills. You have 7+ years of B2B content marketing experience, ideally in enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or AI. You have owned content beyond production, including distribution, activation, and performance measurement. You understand Japanese enterprise buyers and can explain complex technology in clear, credible business language. You have experience with website content, SEO, analytics, customer stories, and demand-generation assets. You can work hands-on while managing multiple projects, agencies, and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment. You are an effective cross-functional partner who can work with local, regional, global, and external partner teams. You use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, creation, repurposing, and analysis while maintaining strong editorial standards. Location: This role is remote and must be based in Tokyo, Japan.
