Our Values If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. About the role Marketing Operations (MarOps) at Justworks builds and runs the systems and capabilities that maximize Marketing’s ability to deliver against its mission. MarOps enables us to know our customers, execute the customer journey, ship great experiences, understand our performance, and safely leverage agents to scale our impact. You’ll be joining Justworks at an inflection point in our business. Our top company objective this year is to change the shape of our growth by transforming how we go to market and engage customers.You will play a key role in accelerating this transformation by building the next generation of our MarOps function. The foundations are already in place along with the resources to design and build your stack to serve Marketing’s outcomes. Your mission is to move Justworks out to the frontier of marketing effectiveness. You’ll be responsible for the systems marketing builds and runs on, how marketing measures its impact and improves, and the safe, effective use of agents to scale all of it. You'll do this as a functional owner working inside a matrixed operating model and in close partnership with leaders from Revenue, Product, Technology, and Data. What you'll be responsible for: Demand Operations: Decide what experience a customer sees and when, across every channel marketing runs, and own the handoff and re-engagement standards that move a customer from marketing to sales, partner, and self-serve paths. Marketing Activation: Own the platform marketing executes through, including what marketing builds vs. buys, how it integrates with our GTM system, and which activation capabilities are required to deliver on the Marketing strategy. Marketing Intelligence: Ensure marketing is able to understand the impact of its work on the business and enable teams to take action to improve performance and the customer experience. AI Capabilities: Build the foundation that lets Marketing use AI safely and effectively, including the shared context humans and agents work from, the templates teams use to build their own agents, and rules for what an agent can do on its own vs. what needs a human-in-the-loop, and the observability standards that enable troubleshooting and improvement. Cross-functional GTM: Own Marketing's engagement with Engineering, Revenue Operations, Product, Data & Analytics, and Security & IT on operating and building our growth engine. The team: Hire, develop, and grow a team of senior individual contributors that set the standard for a top-tier modern Marketing Ops function. In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for: Camaraderie  - Day to day, you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others. Openness  - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others. Grit  - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude. Integrity  - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.  Simplicity  - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.” What you'll bring: Experience: 12+ years in marketing, business, or GTM operations functions, including responsibility for driving marketing effectiveness in a B2B or hybrid growth model. Builder Mindset: AI solutions you’ve built are in production and driving business impact, along with the guardrails necessary to run them safely. Comfort with Complexity: A track record of navigating and cutting through technical and organizational complexity to deliver outcomes. Focus on Output: Success designing and implementing operating models that upleveled and overhauled how a function worked to deliver an outcome its previous model could not. Craft Expertise: Technical fluency and systems expertise, including composable CDP architectures (warehouse-native, reverse-ETL), data analytics and SQL, modern marketing activation and CRM platforms, and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Opencode, and Codex. Leadership: Experience hiring and growing senior individual contributors who operate as autonomous owners of their domain. Experience managing managers is not required. Partnership: The ability to establish strong working partnerships across business and technical functions, including aligning on where each function's scope begins and ends, how to manage shared capabilities, and cross-functional commitments and collaboration standards. jobs.description: By the 1970s, the travel industry had quietly figured out something that most businesses hadn't: growth at scale required three different go-to-market motions happening at once. Individual travelers booked directly — they walked in, called up, and bought. Corporate travel programs needed a sales rep to negotiate rates and sign contracts. And then there were travel agents: independent businesses with deep client relationships who effectively decided what their clients bought. The airlines and hotel chains that grew fastest were the ones that recognized all of these distribution motions and invested in each of them in the right ways. Mercury runs the same three motions. Most of our growth is self-serve and product-led: Founders discover us, sign up, and stay. Our fast-growing sales team closes meaningful deals with larger businesses. And our partners — incorporators, accountants, investors, and platforms that already have the trust of the businesses we want to reach — refer customers to us the same way a great travel agent would: because they believe in our product and its value to their clients. We are looking for a go-to-market leader who can make all three of these motions work harder together with a data-driven strategy and consistent positioning across the customer journey. jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, team player who loves a fast-paced environment and thrives on results. In this role, you will meticulously plan, execute & measure new events and programs for Samsara. These events can include industry trade shows, hosted events, customer and executive experiences, regional summits, educational programs and workshops, strategic sponsorships, partner activations, and other high-impact field marketing programs. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close partnership across Sales, Account Development, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations & Product Management. You should be results-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about driving business impact. This is a fast-growing area of the business that plays a strategic role in our future success. This is a remote role open to candidates based in Mexico City and will require travel up to 50% in Mexico. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Marketing, agencies, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. As the Marketing Platform Operations Manager, you will own data quality and data flow across Smartsheet's marketing technology stack with a particular focus on how lead and account data moves between systems, where it breaks down, and how it can move better in an AI-first environment. You'll dig into the mechanics of our lead flow: where data originates, how it's enriched and scored, how it syncs across platforms, and where gaps or failures cost the business pipeline. This is a hands-on, systems-fluent role. You'll partner closely with Marketing Platform Operations, Campaign Operations, Analytics Engineering, and Sales teams to diagnose data issues, improve data architecture, and support the evaluation and rollout of new tools that improve enrichment, orchestration, and data integrity across the funnel. You'll also contribute to broader Marketing Operations initiatives as they arise. You will operate as a central, region agnostic capital allocator within Growth — ensuring time, budget, and effort are deployed toward the highest incremental impact opportunities. Acting as a key partner to Growth leadership, you will turn complex data into clear trade off decisions, pressure test assumptions, and help determine where the next dollar and the next hour should be invested. In this role, you will own Growth’s forecasting and planning processes, ensuring regional and central teams are aligned on targets, assumptions, and trade offs. You will run the operating cadence for Growth, steward the business inputs, scenario frameworks, and planning logic layered on top of Data’s forecasting model, and translate performance insights into cross regional and cross channel allocation decisions that improve incremental growth and capital efficiency — operating within the financial guardrails set by our Finance team. Forecasting, Planning & Operating Rhythm Own Growth’s forecasting process end to end: gather assumptions, challenge inputs, coordinate with Data, and prepare forecast narratives for leadership Maintain and continuously refine the business logic, pacing, scenario planning, and target setting frameworks built on top of Airalo’s forecasting model Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews — prepare materials, synthesize insights, and ensure follow-ups drive real action Run weekly operating cadence for Growth: performance reviews, KPI tracking, variance analysis, and strategic escalations Budget Allocation & Strategic Decision Support Build data-driven recommendations on spend allocation across regions and channels, using CAC, pLTV, incrementality and ROI insights to optimize for incremental profit/growth Conduct granular regional deep dives (country/segment/channel) and identify levers to improve growth or efficiency. Identify cross-regional capital reallocation opportunities and quantify trade-offs between markets (e.g., where incremental $1 delivers highest marginal return). Partner with Growth, Product, Brand, and Finance to align on targets, trade-offs, and the drivers behind plan variances. Analytics Partnership & Insight Activation Serve as Growth’s primary business partner to the Data team: consolidate analytical needs, provide business context, and ensure high-quality inputs into Data’s roadmap. Translate analytical outputs (forecasts, dashboards, experiment results) into decisions, actions, and processes that stick. Ensure Growth teams adopt and operationalize dashboards and models — build documentation, training, and clear workflows. Cross-Functional Strategy & Special Projects Lead cross-functional projects such as regional/channel diagnostics, efficiency audits, or market deep-dives - including 30 day “drop-in” sprints to fix specific business problems Build frameworks that guide decision-making: ROI models, sizing models, scenario tools, prioritization structures. Identify and implement process improvements across the Growth org to increase speed, clarity, and execution quality. 9+ years in Marketing Strategy, BizOps, FP&A, Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, or similar analytical roles. Demonstrated experience owning planning cycles and influencing capital allocation decisions at a multi-market or global level. Demonstrated ability to maintain forecasting models (Excel/Sheets) and run scenario planning, CAC/LTV experience, pacing, and ROI logic. Strong analytical proficiency: Excel (advanced), and comfort working with SQL and modern BI tools (Looker, Lightdash, Tableau). Experience with MMM models a plus. Clear experience turning data into recommendations — not just reporting results, but synthesizing insights into “what we do next.” Ability to challenge assumptions, pressure-test inputs, and navigate ambiguous or incomplete data. Experience working cross-functionally with channel leads, PMs, and Data teams; strong communication skills with senior stakeholders. Comfort managing complex, deadline-driven projects, prioritizing across markets, and driving alignment among multiple teams. A proactive, structured problem-solver who can pick up unclear problems, untangle them, and deliver clarity with minimal guidance. Experience in consumer tech, marketplace, travel, or subscription businesses Familiarity with marketing analytics: attribution, CAC/LTV modeling, incrementality testing, funnel analysis Comfort coordinating experimentation roadmaps and interpreting lift tests or causal results Prior experience as the business partner to a Data/Analytics org Why People Join Us 🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact. For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home. 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers. Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane. 🇦🇪 Why people join us in the UAE We're a fully remote team across 60+ countries, built on a simple idea: trust people to own their work and deliver without unnecessary layers or heavy process getting in the way. Many people joining us from the UAE are looking for clarity in scope and real ownership in their role. They want to know what they're responsible for, how success is measured, and have direct access to the people making decisions. What often stands out is the combination of a global, product-led company with a flexible remote setup. For many, it's the opportunity to work on a product used by millions of travelers worldwide, alongside a team that moves quickly and values clear ownership and accountability. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency. Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country. Role Summary: As a Product Marketing Manager, you will be a key part of the execution engine behind Filevine's go-to-market motions. You will take our sophisticated Legal Operating Intelligence System capabilities and turn them into highly effective customer-facing assets, product content, and targeted tier-1 through 3 launches. Working directly at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, and Marketing, you are responsible for keeping pace with an AI-forward environment where speed wins. Generative AI & LLMs: Comfort with technical concepts, APIs, modern software architectures, and specific familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or legal workflows. Professional Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated product marketing experience within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally experiencing the high-growth transition from Series C to IPO. jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Flex
jobs.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners. We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. Flex is building its product marketing function from the ground up. We're looking for someone who can own how the market understands Flex — positioning, competitive narrative, and the “why us” story across our full product suite: reward card, credit card, banking, AP automation, expense management, AR/invoicing, working capital, and global payments. This is a builder's role: you'll be the first dedicated owner of product marketing at Flex. Today, that work happens through ad-hoc conversations between Product and Sales leadership — there's no formal owner, no documentation (no formal case studies, external collateral, or internal knowledge repository), no consistent process, and no one dedicated to making sure something that ships well also lands well in-market. You're fixing this from zero, not inheriting a system someone else already built. You'll partner closely with Revenue Leadership (Sales, Partnerships, CS, Support), Sales Enablement, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the story you build actually lands in the market. That story must resonate with our target audience no matter where it surfaces: in marketing campaigns, live deals, automated customer journeys, in-app experiences, and everywhere Flex shows up to a prospect or customer. You'll partner directly with Product early and often — bringing market, competitive, and customer signal into how we plan, sequence, and position what we ship — rather than writing about it after the fact. Own go-to-market for everything Flex ships. Partner with Product leadership every quarter to bring market and customer signal into roadmap planning, and work together in defining what “ready to launch” means across all stakeholders; orchestrate between Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Support, and Ops as product updates and new releases are being built; create internal content (messaging, what it is, how it works, competitive positioning, etc.), then partner with Enablement to deploy revenue enablement programming that equips the teams prior to any launch. It's critical that you're comfortable holding the line with Product when something isn't positioned well enough to ship externally yet, or when there's misalignment with Revenue leaders and customer needs. Own Flex's competitive positioning end-to-end. Define the ICP across each of our product lines using real data, conduct market research, and leverage Apollo call-recording data to identify why we win — then translate that internally and externally so it holds together across our full product suite, in a market where Ramp, Brex, and Bill.com are all fighting for the same mental real estate. Run win/loss analysis and turn what you learn into real changes to messaging, internal battlecards, external collateral, and objection handling. When gaps are identified, proactively surface them with Revenue, Ops, and Product leadership so they can be evaluated and prioritized against the Product Roadmap. Give Lifecycle Marketing and Sales Enablement ready-to-go information, content, and messaging for their needs. Own all aspects of the written content and messaging used internally and externally: company narrative, value props, pains addressed, proof points (case studies, best-in-class client examples, relevant success-story statistics), where we lose, and objection handling that both teams pull from. Lifecycle turns this into campaign copy for email/SMS sequences; Sales Enablement incorporates it into the CMS, pitch materials, and training. You're the source of truth for what to say and why it's true. Take a data-first approach to determine how we prioritize launches and messaging, based on customer, market, industry, and product research you proactively conduct. Use data to inform your decisions — listen to real conversations with prospects and clients to understand how things are landing in the market, review win/loss data to understand why we win and identify GTM or product gaps, proactively research competitors to stay on top of what's new, and review tool-adoption data and identify customer examples so teams have data points to use on calls. This informs how you decide what pain-centered messaging, positioning work, competitive intel, and launches matter most given Flex's current stage — rather than waiting to be told. Be the internal expert and resource on how Flex is positioned in the market, our full product suite, and the owner of our launches. Become the SME on our value prop, who we serve, how we address market pains, why we win and lose, how we're differentiated, and everything about our product offerings (what they are, how they work, the value they provide, how customers use them). Beyond owning external messaging, you'll equip internal Revenue teams with what they need to succeed (in partnership with Sales Enablement), and brief Leadership and Product on what's changing in the competitive landscape, why it matters, and how gaps can be addressed via the Product Roadmap. 5+ years in product marketing, including at least 2 years in B2B fintech, financial services, or another regulated, complex-product industry Demonstrated GTM ownership: you've built positioning and messaging, launched products, and driven adoption — including at least one zero-to-one, “no existing function to inherit” experience, where you defined a Product ↔ PMM ↔ Stakeholder handshake from scratch Strong competitive intelligence instincts — you know how to build a battlecard that gets used on a live sales call, not filed away Strong instincts for what resonates in the market and in GTM — you can clearly separate the most important elements of an internal or external message from what's “fluff,” and you intuitively know the questions a new prospect, client, or CSM will ask about how something works, why it's built that way, and what objections will come up Proven experience partnering directly with Product on positioning, without a dotted-line PM relationship to lean on Excellent written communication — much of this role lives in documents (positioning frameworks, battlecards, briefs) that other teams execute directly against Comfort with ambiguity and zero-to-one building; you don't need an existing playbook or team to make progress Bonus: experience at a company without a dedicated marketing leader, where you had to establish process rather than inherit it Bonus: direct experience as a SaaS individual contributor (Sales, AM, CS) — ideally as a CSM — who intuitively understands what customers want and what internal employees need to know about a product to inform launch strategy Most product marketing roles at this level either inherit an established function or slot into a larger marketing org with brand, demand gen, and content already in place. This one has neither yet — which means the person who takes it defines what “good” looks like for product marketing at Flex, with outsized influence on how we're positioned in market for years to come. A visionary founding team with deep industry expertise. Competitive salary + equity + benefits. 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision. Stock options with massive upside. Unlimited vacation policy. Remote-friendly culture with biannual offsites. Backing from leading Silicon Valley investors. At Flex, we value ambition, integrity, and impact . If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the desire to build something meaningful, we’d love to hear from you. Why Join Us Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners. Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists. Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.title: Director of SEO & AI Search (Remote - West Coast Only & Pacific Time Hours)
jobs.description: Search is being rewritten. Come lead the team doing it. The way people find brands is changing faster than it ever has, and most agencies are scrambling to keep up. GR0 isn't. We're one of the fastest-growing digital marketing agencies in the country, and we're hiring a Director of SEO & AI Search to own the evolution of our core service line. This is the role for someone who sees what's coming in search, has the chops to build for it, and wants to lead a team doing work that actually matters. You'll have a real seat at the table. You'll own outcomes, not just tasks. And you'll have the resources, the team, and the client portfolio to prove what's possible when deep SEO expertise meets genuine AI fluency. What this role actually is: You're the head of SEO at a high-growth agency working with some of the most ambitious D2C brands in e-commerce. Your job is to make the department perform, scale, and stay ahead. That means leading a talented team of SEO managers, driving retention and results across a diverse client portfolio, and being the person in the room who knows both the technical fundamentals and where the industry is going next. You'll also be a builder. New processes, new capabilities, new revenue streams. If something isn't working, you fix it. If there's an opportunity no one has spotted yet, you find it. What you'll own: The team. Hire great people. Coach them well. Build a culture where high standards and psychological safety coexist. Weekly 1:1s are coaching sessions, not check-ins. The clients. Senior voice on strategy calls, QBRs, and escalations. You know which accounts are at risk before they churn, and you have a plan ready before anyone asks. The work. Full-funnel SEO strategies built on data: technical audits, content roadmaps, backlinking, digital PR, and cross-platform approaches spanning Google, Bing, Amazon, and beyond. The business. Department P&L, capacity planning, tooling decisions, sales pitches. You're not just running a service line. You're running a business unit. The future. AI search is not a side project. You'll lead GR0's point of view on generative engine optimization and make sure the team is ahead of every platform shift, not reacting to it. Who we're looking for: You have 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including 2+ years managing people, with agency experience that's non-negotiable. You've managed managers. You've owned a P&L. You've recovered at-risk campaigns and helped close new business. But beyond the resume, you're the kind of leader who gets energy from building. You're curious about AI search, not intimidated by it. You know how to win over a C-suite client and how to give a junior employee feedback they'll actually use. You hold a high bar and people still want to work for you. 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, 2+ years in people management Agency experience (required, not preferred) Proven track record managing managers and leading high-performing teams, including offshore Deep expertise across technical SEO, content, and off-site disciplines Financial acumen with P&L ownership experience Genuine enthusiasm for AI's role in search and the future of discovery Strong executive presence: comfortable on pitch calls, client calls, and the conference stage Experience with D2C brands and performance marketing environments Prior success managing offshore talent across time zones Entrepreneurial background or history of launching new initiatives inside an agency or startup Team members promoted from within. 1:1s never skipped. SOPs that the team actually uses. A department that's recognized, inside the agency and outside it, as the standard for what SEO looks like in the age of AI. Stage 1 — Recruiter Screen After submitting your application, our People & Culture team will review and reach out to selected candidates. During this 30-minute call, we'll get to know your career journey, professional motivators, and what excites you about GR0 — while giving you a full picture of who we are and what we're building. Stage 2 — Panel Interview You'll meet with members of our leadership team for a deeper dive into your background and experience. Expect to walk through your technical skills, people management approach, and how you think about strategy — and of course, share why you're excited about this opportunity at GR0. Stage 3 — Co-Founders Connect The final conversation is always our favorite. You'll get to connect directly with our CEO & Co-Founder, Kevin Miller , and our Chief Growth Officer & Co-Founder, Jon Zacharias . This is your chance to ask big questions, share your vision, and see if the feeling is mutual. Stage 4 — Offer If a #GR0mance has brewed — we'll extend a competitive offer and hope you'll join the team! Shared Financial Success - GR0 believes strongly in equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one vehicle to achieve that. Annual compensation for this role is market competitive. Health and Family Benefits - GR0 offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options for GR0ers and their families. Wi-Fi Reimbursement - All employees receive a monthly reimbursement to help cover internet expenses while working. Unlimited PTO - We know that rest is vital to your well-being and career success, so we give you the flexibility and trust to take it when you need it. Paid Holidays - Take time to celebrate and rejuvenate with 13 fully paid holidays throughout the year. Community Impact - GR0 is committed to supporting the communities where we work and live by partnering with local charitable organizations to give back in various ways. Please note: GR0 is currently able to hire in the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Iowa, Nevada, North Dakota, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wisconsin. Candidates must be based in one of these states to be considered for this role. jobs.description: Meds.com is a rapidly growing consumer technology firm operating a suite of healthcare businesses, including our flagship brands BlueChew & MOD. With a team of 350 professionals across various specialties, we've built scalable pharmacy, telemedicine, and e-commerce platforms using cutting-edge technology. As we continue our accelerated growth trajectory, we're launching new products to expand our patient base and accelerate growth. Join us in tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of healthcare and technology. Build the customer journey that drives long-term growth: We're building one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer healthcare brands in the country, and we're looking for someone to own one of the most important growth levers in the business: customer retention. Our customers don't stop interacting with us after their first purchase. Every message, every renewal, every product recommendation, and every touchpoint is an opportunity to build trust, increase lifetime value, and create an exceptional customer experience. As our Manager, Retention & Lifecycle Marketing, you’ll own the strategy and execution behind the customer journey from first purchase through long-term loyalty. You’ll combine customer insights, compelling creative, experimentation, personalization, and automation to deliver the right message to the right customer at the right time. This is a high cross-functional role that sits within the Creative Strategy team. You’ll partner closely with Growth Marketinbg, Creative, Product, Customer Experience, Analytics, and Engineering to build best-in-class lifecycle programs that strengthen customer relationships while driving measurable business growth. Join our team in Austin, TX or Chicago, IL - we're looking for someone who truly values and enjoys working in the office, not just tolerates it. Build and optimize automated customer journeys that improve engagement, retention, renewal rates, and customer lifetime value. Partner with designers, copywriters, and creative strategists to develop compelling lifecycle campaigns that strengthen customer relationships and increase revenue. Analyze customer behavior to identify opportunities to reduce churn, increase repeat purchases, and improve subscription retention. Monitor and report on key lifecycle metrics including retention, renewal rate, churn, repeat purchase rate, engagement, unsubscribe rates, and customer lifetime value. Continuously identify new opportunities to improve customer engagement through experimentation, data, and creative thinking. What Great Looks Like You think beyond campaigns. Qualifications 4+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, CRM, email marketing, or customer marketing. jobs.title: Director of Demand Generation

We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries. We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. You’ll drive leads across three channels: paid advertising (Google, LinkedIn), organic search and SEO, and AI-powered search and LLM visibility (GEO). You’ll report to the VP of Marketing, and partner closely with our Sales team. This is a builder role. You’ll own the strategy, run the channels, and build the agentic workflows that make the whole machine run more efficiently over time. Your success is measured in the qualified pipeline, not activity. You think in systems and automation. The goal is a demand gen function that compounds over time, not one that depends on you doing everything manually. You treat Sales like a partner, not an internal customer. Pipeline is a team sport. You can walk into ambiguity, build structure, and make progress without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook. Hands-on experience building AI agents or agentic workflows: not theoretically familiar, not interested in learning. You have built at least one agent that automated something real and you can speak to what it did. A clear track record of digital lead growth tied to revenue: you can point to a channel you found or optimized and tell us what it made the business. Experience with paid media platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn) and marketing automation or CRM systems (HubSpot, Marketo, ActiveCampaign, or equivalent). jobs.title: Director, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description: About Pendulum Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome. Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities + in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome. Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale. The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list. If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading. The Opportunity Pendulum is seeking a Director, Influencer Marketing to build an industry-defining influencer platform that establishes Pendulum as the most credible and trusted brand in microbiome science—and turns that trust into meaningful brand and revenue growth. This is an opportunity to architect the strategy, not simply manage an existing program. You will determine how Pendulum engages the full spectrum of influential voices—from scientists, physicians and other trusted experts to customers, cultural tastemakers, creators, celebrities and performance-driven affiliates. You will build a portfolio in which each plays a distinct role in earning consumer trust, educating the market, shaping the category and driving demand. The ideal candidate is an ambitious strategist, relationship builder and hands-on operator. You can deeply understand the science behind Pendulum’s differentiation and translate it into stories that are credible, compelling and highly shareable. You recognize that trust must be earned through authentic voices, scientific integrity and consistent execution—and you know how to build a strategy that protects that trust while accelerating growth. You bring strong creative instincts, commercial discipline and the drive to roll up your sleeves—identifying talent, building relationships, developing breakthrough content, negotiating partnerships, analyzing performance and continuously improving the model. You will serve as the connective tissue across Pendulum’s marketing organization, partnering closely with our external PR firm and our creative, organic, growth and DTC teams to ensure influencer storytelling is amplified across earned, owned and paid channels. Your work will help define how consumers understand the microbiome, why they trust Pendulum and why Pendulum is uniquely positioned to lead the category. Success will be measured by your ability to build a scalable influencer engine that consistently generates distinctive content, deepens consumer trust, strengthens Pendulum’s authority and delivers measurable business results. Key indicators will include brand and category leadership, content quality and effectiveness, organic reach and engagement, earned-media impact, qualified site traffic, conversion efficiency, customer acquisition and revenue growth. Performance-focused influencer strategy . Establish the strategic vision for how influencer-led storytelling builds trust, consumerizes our science, sparks advocacy and drives action, fueling both brand equity and measurable customer acquisition and revenue growth. Diversified influencer portfolio . Build a reliable influencer pipeline aligned to brand and growth priorities, defining the role of macro- and micro-influencers (including health & wellness and lifestyle influencers), celebrity talent, health care practitioners and other subject-matter experts, and customer advocates. Productive influencer partnerships . Cultivate authentic relationships and long-term partnerships with cultural voices, healthcare experts and creators who can inspire community and make microbiome science and gut health engaging, relatable and accessible to everyone while increasing influencer-generated new customers. Disciplined testing and optimization . Work closely with the DTC team to develop clear frameworks for campaign types (organic vs. paid, affiliate vs. whitelisted) and creative, systematic testing approaches (testimonial vs. quote, still vs. motion, clinical vs. lifestyle storytelling) to consistently improve influencer CAC and revenue efficiency. High sharable messaging and formats . Collaborate with the Creative team as well as Clinical and Regulatory to provide strategic guidance to influencers to balance creator authenticity with Pendulum’s science-forward guardrails, while developing messaging and formats that scale. Multi-platform reach . Scale our influencer program across various channels, including organic, DTC (including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters and other emerging platforms), HCP and Wholesale channels. External agency & partner management . Partner with our PR firm, talent agencies and affiliate network to drive influencer relationships, creator content and credible expert voices that convert into meaningful coverage and thought-leadership opportunities, and measurable, durable outcomes. Dependable process and reporting . Create and own holistic dashboards and reports delivered on a weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence to ensure accountability, transparency, iterative optimization informed by top-performing campaigns, and predictable growth. Team development . Mentor and develop Pendulum’s Manager, Influencer Marketing to build a high-performing Influencer team. Cross-functional long-term planning . Represent influencer marketing in cross-functional planning - annual and quarterly brand and growth planning, launch calendars, and budget cycles - so influencer activity is sequenced with PR, paid media and retail moments. The Director, Influencer Marketing will develop and own the frameworks and metrics that measure the effectiveness of Pendulum’s influencer strategy, including applicable PR and DTC metrics, ensuring all activities deliver against both brand-building and business-driving objectives. Success will be defined not only by engagement and reach, but by Pendulum’s ability to earn trust, solidify its position as the leader in microbiome health, and drive measurable customer acquisition and revenue growth. Team aligned on the guidelines for influencer performance (investment vs ROI). Growing organic consumer engagement (followers, likes, shares) and paid-media performance (traffic, CVR, CAC, affiliate revenue and AOV), as well as amplification/earned media impressions and fatigue thresholds. Growing cohort performance by talent type (e.g., HCPs, RDs, micro-influencers, marquee voices). Share of voice in microbiome, gut health, and metabolic health conversations. Pendulum influencers selected to speak at conferences, panels and cultural forums as well as participate in bylines, interviews and citations. 7+ years of experience in marketing (with a strong focus on influencer marketing, social media, and content strategy), along with a proven track record of executing campaigns that drive engagement, brand awareness and measurable growth. Several years in a managerial or director-level role, demonstrating the ability to own and lead our influencer strategy, as well as mentor team members. Strong strategic planning and communication skills, enabling you to collaborate cross-functionally and unify efforts across the organization. Proven success working with and through external agency partners (PR, talent, affiliate networks), influencing outcomes and driving alignment without direct authority. A demonstrated ability to combine creative storytelling with data-driven decision-making. Experience in the health, wellness, or healthcare sector is highly preferred. BA Required; MBA or Masters a plus. $190,000 - $215,000 Medical, Dental, and Vision Commuter Benefits Life & STD Insurance Company match on 401 (k) Flexible Time Off (FTO) Equity

jobs.title: SEO Manager
jobs.description: Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work. We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference. Silverback’s next SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll also flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses. AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Analytical Skills: Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Client-Facing: Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner. Client Management: Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships. Tactical Execution: Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale. Innovation: Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices. Data Analysis: Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life. Agency Background: You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results Years of Experience: We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 2 years of agency experience; 3 years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required, 5+ years preferred. Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients. AI Search Testing & Optimization: You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out. Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar. Content Experience: You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production. Tools/Platforms: You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog. “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day. Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you. Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable. Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact. Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously. Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works. Unlimited PTO Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans Monthly Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture Company-paid ClassPass membership 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave Summer Fridays 401(k) with Employer Match We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication. We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality. Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you! Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. jobs.title: Account Based Marketing (ABM) Manager
jobs.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description Account-based marketing is at the center of how Sonar wins and expands its most strategic enterprise accounts, and we are investing to scale it. Based in one of our hubs in Austin, London, or Geneva and part of the Demand Generation squad, the ABM Manager owns the strategy, execution, and measurement of one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many programs that engage our highest-value target and customer accounts. You will orchestrate personalized, multi-channel campaigns that align marketing and sales around a shared list of accounts, accelerate pipeline, and deepen expansion within the enterprises that rely on Sonar. This is a full-funnel, hands-on role that blends strategic account selection with day-to-day campaign execution. You will partner closely with sales, SDR, field, demand generation, and product marketing teams to build account plans, deploy the right plays at the right stage, and prove impact with rigorous measurement. Success requires equal parts strategic thinking, creative campaign building, strong analytics, and the relationship skills to keep marketing and sales moving as one team against a common set of accounts. Own ABM strategy and account selection: Define and run Sonar’s account-based marketing strategy across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many tiers — partnering with sales to select, segment, and prioritize target and expansion accounts based on fit, intent, and opportunity. Build and execute multi-channel account plays: Plan, build, and continuously optimize personalized campaigns across paid (e.g., LinkedIn, display, and ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase), email, web personalization, direct mail, and content — tailored to each account’s buying stage and stakeholders. Align marketing and sales: Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the account teams — co-developing account plans with AEs and SDRs, equipping them with the right messaging and assets, and coordinating outbound and marketing touches into a single, orchestrated motion. Define and optimize the ICP: Partner with product marketing and sales to define, refine, and continuously optimize Sonar’s ideal customer profile — using performance data, intent signals, and win/loss insight to sharpen account selection and targeting. Leverage intent and engagement data: Use intent signals, engagement scoring, and account analytics to identify in-market accounts, prioritize outreach, and trigger the right plays at the right moment. Drive pipeline and expansion: Generate and accelerate qualified pipeline within target accounts and expansion within existing customers — tracking engagement, opportunity creation, and influenced pipeline against clear goals. Measure and report on impact: Define and own ABM metrics — account engagement, pipeline contribution, velocity, and ROI — and deliver regular reporting with clear, data-driven recommendations to refine targeting and spend. Partner cross-functionally on content and messaging: Work with product marketing and content teams to develop account- and persona-specific messaging, assets, and experiences that resonate with technical and executive buyers. Collaborate on field and event programs: Partner with field and demand gen teammates to integrate ABM into events, executive roundtables, and webinars that engage priority accounts and convert into pipeline. Manage budget and vendors: Allocate and steward the ABM budget for maximum return, and manage ABM platform, data, and agency vendors to ensure quality execution. Have 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on account-based marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns — preferably within enterprise SaaS or technology. Bring a proven track record of planning and executing ABM programs (one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many) that engage target accounts and drive measurable pipeline and expansion. Have hands-on experience with ABM and intent platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and an understanding of how to operationalize account data and intent signals. Have strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, optimize spend, track account engagement and pipeline, and report on ROI across channels. Be experienced partnering closely with sales and SDR teams to align on account strategy, plays, and follow-up. Be proficient with marketing automation tools and CRM systems (e.g., Marketing Cloud, Salesforce). Be familiar with paid media and digital channels relevant to ABM, including LinkedIn and programmatic display. Be highly organized and able to manage and prioritize multiple programs, accounts, and stakeholders simultaneously and independently. Have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments and functions. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA a plus). In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. You will work closely with the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager to research, launch, and scale emerging platforms—from programmatic DSPs to community-based channels like Reddit—driving user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early. This role carries real ownership. You’ll operate with meaningful day-to-day autonomy, exercise judgment within established frameworks, and produce analysis and recommendations that shape how we invest in new channels. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Analytics, Creative, and channel partners to bring experiments to life and move quickly from proof of concept to scaled channel. Acorns is a remote-first organization , offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA. What You Will Do Channel Testing & Execution Help develop and execute a structured testing roadmap for new and emerging paid media channels, including programmatic display, Reddit, Snapchat, and other alternative platforms. Own day-to-day campaign management across existing channels like Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, and YouTube Run tests on new channels, including setup, trafficking, pacing, and ongoing optimization. Use performance data and judgment to make in-channel optimizations, escalating broader strategic decisions to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager as needed. Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ad assets tailored to each platform and audience. Measurement & Reporting Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, collaborate with the Analytics team to design the test structure, and own the launch and ongoing performance monitoring of each experiment. Track and report on key performance indicators for new and existing channel initiatives, translating data into clear summaries for internal stakeholders. Maintain organized records of test results, learnings, and optimization actions to build a shared knowledge base for the team. Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration Support acquisition growth across our brand portfolio—Acorns and Acorns Early. Work collaboratively with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to execute experiments efficiently and surface actionable insights. Actively monitor the AdTech landscape—including gaming platforms (e.g., Roblox, Discord), community platforms, and emerging programmatic DSPs—and bring forward channel opportunities for the team to evaluate. What You Will Bring 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, or growth marketing with a BS/BA; or equivalent work experience. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you follow processes carefully, flag questions early, and aren’t afraid to modify your approach when the situation calls for it. Clear written and verbal communication skills—you can summarize experiment results and share channel recommendations in a way that’s easy for stakeholders to act on. Genuine curiosity about where digital advertising is heading and a hunger to explore channels competitors aren’t using yet. A belief that your work is connected to something bigger—helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do at Acorns, and we want teammates who are energized by that mission. jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description: About Atlas At Atlas, we believe the financial system should work for everyone. We’re building a modern rewards credit card and banking platform designed to grow with our members - helping them build credit on autopilot with 0% APR, no late fees, and premium rewards. By replacing harsh penalties with empathy and smart technology, we are making stress-free financial progress accessible to millions. We are a product- and technology-obsessed team with roots at Facebook, Amazon, Robinhood, and Uber. If you’re ready to build a high-impact product that democratizes opportunity and accelerates financial empowerment, join us. About the role We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to design and optimize the programs that engage, retain, and grow our members across their entire journey with Atlas, from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention, with a clear focus on driving engagement, retention, and user lifetime value (LTV). We want a marketer with experience building targeted campaigns across all channels we own (email, SMS, in-app messages, push) and connecting those touchpoints to the broader, lifecycle goals that shape how members experience Atlas. You’ll turn performance data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business, and you’ll use AI tools to drive efficiency and output. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco. Team members are expected to come into the office two days a week. What you’ll do Own post-activation lifecycle strategy: from onboarding to long-term retention, building targeted campaigns that drive engagement, retention, and member LTV. Turn segments into personalized campaigns: define the segments that matter and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across multiple channels. Continuous experimentation: data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications Steward our communications ecosystem: develop and own channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of every message we send members. Leverage AI to compress the work: use AI tools to automate analyses, accelerate research, and remove busywork so the team ships faster. Partner cross-functionally: build strong relationships across Engineering and Operations to deliver on shared strategies for large, cross-functional initiatives. What we’re looking for 4-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing A proven track record of running successful campaigns against targeted segments across multiple channels (email, SMS, in app messages, push) Strong analytical skills; comfort with pulling data, performing analyses, and reporting on performance to drive key business decisions and outcomes across the user lifecycle The ability to work cross-functionally and exercise significant independent judgment. Crisp written communication; high agency; low ego; bias to action, customer obsession. What sets you apart Fintech experience - bonus points if you’ve worked on credit, lending, or other consumer financial products. Hands-on experience with key marketing platforms (Braze or similar). Comfortable leveraging AI tools as a daily multiplier - for analysis, automation, research, and writing. A strong self-starter mindset – adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources. Strategic thinking; you naturally ask “why” and “what if,” not just “what happened.” What we offer Competitive salary and benefits with market leading equity. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. 401(k) match Medical, dental & vision insurance Unlimited PTO & work from home flexibility Lunch & dinner at the office

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description: Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby. I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I've worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum, with whom I'd spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 to lead Product Marketing, thrilled to build something meaningful with people I admire, and to help shape the future of hiring in a way that's thoughtful, effective, and human. We're a small team with high standards and mutual respect for our teammates and community. The way we do Product Marketing at Ashby reflects that, all with a good dose of fun 🎉. We value clarity over cleverness, lean into autonomy, and treat writing well and first-principles thinking as core parts of the job. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and focus on helping customers and prospects genuinely understand what our product does and how it can help them. What we’re looking for We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own our Enterprise narrative, content and enable our go-to-market teams with clarity and confidence. This includes the messaging, content, and sales support that helps us win and grow our largest, most complex customers. This role is about deeply understanding what it takes to sell and support Ashby at the Enterprise level: longer sales cycles, more sophisticated buying committees, and a much wider set of stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and more). You'll partner closely with our Director of Product Marketing to make sure Enterprise messaging ladders up to Ashby's overarching company narrative, while you go deep on what makes that narrative land specifically with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers. You will synthesize inputs from customer research, product direction, market dynamics, and company vision into clear, compelling narratives that scale across the segment. You’ll work hand-in-hand with Solutions Engineers and Sales Leaders to drive success within the segment, as well as collaborate with other marketing teams such as our Content & Community, Demand Gen, Events and Partnerships, to influence campaigns for the Enterprise segment. This role is a great fit for someone who loves to problem-solve through complexity, enjoys working with sophisticated buyers, and wants to own a full segment end-to-end. Your Background There's no perfect path into this role. We're open to a variety of backgrounds, including: Product Marketing Sales Enablement Competitive Intelligence Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering What You’ll Do Own Enterprise segment narrative development Conduct deep research and develop messaging for the full Enterprise buying committee: Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and other stakeholders that don't show up the same way in smaller segments. Translate Ashby's company-level narrative into a story that resonates with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers. Maintain the Enterprise messaging framework that empowers Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to communicate, sell and service Ashby’s differentiation with confidence. Be a strategic partner to Enterprise sales Partner deeply with Sales Leadership and Solutions Engineering to identify opportunities within the segment Develop Enterprise-specific enablement and build campaigns and materials that support the Enterprise sales process. Act as the source of truth and connective tissue between Marketing, CS, and Sales on how to speak to the Enterprise buyer, overall messaging and collateral Deliver well-crafted trainings to sales in collaboration with other sales-supporting teams to move forward audience positioning and other key initiatives. Develop Enterprise-specific content Own the content and collateral that's unique to Enterprise: case studies, decks, one-pagers, and campaigns, including 1-1 and 1-to-few ABM built for this buyer set. Support TCO reports and ROI content that help Enterprise buyers and champions justify Ashby internally. Make sure CS, Sales, and Marketing are aligned and working from the same Enterprise messaging. Examples of Projects You'll Work On Support Enterprise ABM initiatives: Support enterprise messaging for the marketing ABM program with the content, and compelling creative campaigns that support 1-1 and 1-to-few messaging. Analyst Relations Briefs: Partnering with Analyst Relations to prepare and brief analysts and press on Ashby’s offerings. Sales Leadership Strategic Initiatives: Work with Sales Leadership to translate big ideas and top company priorities into actionable assets, initiatives and roll outs that the Sales Team can use to drive deals forward. Enterprise buying committee messaging: Build out messaging tailored to secondary Enterprise stakeholders (Legal, Analysts, RecOps) who influence but don't lead the buying process. Enterprise sales deck refresh: Partner with Sales leadership to refresh the core Enterprise pitch as our narrative evolves. Cross-functional alignment: Make sure CS, Sales, and Marketing are aligned and using the same Enterprise messaging as new campaigns roll out. You Might Be a Fit If You ... Love the complexity of Enterprise buying: multiple stakeholders, longer cycles, higher stakes. Are a confident writer who can flex a company narrative to resonate with a more sophisticated, skeptical buyer. Are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design to produce polished, Enterprise-grade assets. Like partnering closely with Sales and being in the room for their biggest deals. You Might Not Be a Fit If ... You are drained by ambiguity or unsolved problems. You don't love the enablement aspects of product marketing. You'd rather work on message development in the abstract than get into the weeds of a specific deal or buyer. You are not a confident writer and storyteller. The Director, Influencer & Affiliate Marketing owns the performance and growth of BIOptimizers' creator partnerships program. This is not a traditional influencer marketing role focused primarily on impressions, engagement, or brand awareness. Success is measured by your ability to build a scalable creator ecosystem that generates profitable customer acquisition while establishing long-term partnerships that become strategic assets for the business. You will own a significant annual influencer budget, recruit and develop high-performing creator relationships, negotiate commercial partnerships, build scalable ambassador systems, and continually improve campaign performance through data-driven decision making. We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, commercially minded, analytical, and energized by building something exceptional. You'll receive clear business objectives and the freedom to develop the strategy, systems, and partnerships necessary to achieve them. Key Responsibilities 1. Own & Scale Performance Influencer Marketing Own and optimize a $500,000+ annual influencer marketing budget while consistently achieving or exceeding a minimum 1.7x last-click Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) with both paid and commission-based influencers and double annual revenue from 2026 vs 2027. Develop profitable creator acquisition strategies across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Podcasts, email sponsorships, websites, newsletters, and emerging channels. Continuously improve campaign profitability while increasing influencer contribution to overall company revenue. Negotiate high-value creator partnerships that maximize licensing rights, paid usage rights, Meta advertising permissions, multi-channel deliverables, affiliate opportunities, and long-term ROI. Work closely with Paid Media to activate creator content through Meta advertising and maximize performance beyond organic distribution. 2. Build a World-Class Creator Ecosystem Recruit, activate, and grow a high-performing ambassador community of 500+ active commission-based and hybrid creators. Develop scalable recruiting systems that consistently generate new creator relationships while reactivating dormant ambassadors already within the BIOptimizers ecosystem. Build direct relationships with creators and creator representatives while minimizing reliance on traditional influencer agencies whenever practical. Identify emerging creators before they become expensive, negotiate favorable long-term partnerships, and develop relationships that grow alongside their audiences. Manage strategic creator relationships through consistent communication, accountability, performance reviews, and long-term partnership development. 3. Lead Creator Strategy & Commercial Partnerships Transform product positioning and campaign objectives into creator briefs that consistently generate high-performing, conversion-focused content. Expand creator relationships beyond one-time sponsored posts into comprehensive omni-channel partnerships that include email, YouTube, websites, podcasts, paid advertising, affiliate promotions, licensing rights, and future product launches. Negotiate creative partnership structures that deliver exceptional value while strengthening long-term relationships with creators. Partner closely with Creative, Paid Media, CRM, Product Marketing, and Analytics teams to maximize campaign effectiveness. Continuously identify opportunities to improve creative performance, messaging, offers, and partnership structures based on campaign results. 4. Own Performance Analytics & Business Intelligence Measure success through revenue, contribution margin, ROAS, creator productivity, customer acquisition, and long-term partnership value—not vanity metrics alone. Analyze campaign performance to identify optimization opportunities and confidently explain what is driving results. Track creator performance, recruitment pipelines, licensing agreements, and partnership health through organized reporting systems. Present structured business updates supported by clear insights, actionable recommendations, and measurable performance improvements. Develop scalable reporting processes that improve forecasting, operational visibility, and executive decision-making. 5. Experience negotiating creator contracts, licensing rights, usage rights, affiliate agreements, commission structures, and long-term partnership agreements.
