jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
About Backstory Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like OpenAI, IBM, Red Hat, Verizon, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue. By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue. Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital. The Role As Senior Manager of Demand Generation at Backstory, you will own how buyers find us and how they convert into pipeline. This is an AI-first marketing seat—equal parts strategy and hands-on execution. You will manage paid media, agency partners, web conversion, and organic discovery across both traditional search engines and AI answer engines. Partnering directly with the SVP of Marketing, you will commit to an enterprise pipeline target and build the automated systems to hit it. 
 Responsibilities Own paid acquisition and performance marketing across paid search, paid social, display, and digital ABM, optimizing toward pipeline, CAC, and payback. Manage performance marketing agency partners, driving strong execution, creative output, experimentation, and efficient campaign performance. Lead SEO and AI-driven discovery (AEO) across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other emerging channels, including technical SEO, content strategy, schema, and site health. Own Backstory’s Share of Model strategy, increasing brand visibility, citations, and recommendations across AI answer engines relative to competitors. Build AI-powered campaign automation tools to scale enrichment, personalization, research, and campaign execution. Own web performance and CRO, continuously testing landing pages, messaging, offers, and user experiences to increase qualified conversions and pipeline. Lead lifecycle nurture and funnel optimization, improving segmentation, messaging, sequences, and conversion across MQL → SQL → Opportunity. Co-own integrated campaign strategy and pipeline performance with the SVP of Marketing, aligning paid, search, content, and distribution while measuring impact through multi-touch attribution. Drive performance creative strategy, partnering with Creative and agencies to develop, test, and optimize campaign assets based on CTR, conversion, and pipeline contribution. Qualifications 6+ years in Demand Generation / Growth Marketing at a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise AI startup. AI-Forward Operator: Proven track record of testing and integrating cutting-edge AI software into campaign operations. You are deeply technical with modern tools and constantly look for ways to replace manual marketing tasks with automated AI workflows. Proven Pipeline Ownership: Track record of owning a qualified enterprise pipeline number and managing paid digital budgets end-to-end. Full-Funnel & Lifecycle Mastery: Strong experience managing paid performance, CRO, and automated email nurture streams Data & Attribution Rigor: Fluency in CAC, payback periods, multi-touch attribution, and CRM/MAP reporting. Cross-Functional Partner: Ability to work smoothly alongside Product Marketing, Creative Director, and Sales to turn messaging and content into scalable pipeline. Curiosity, collaboration and a focus on impact. 
 $150,000 - $170,000 a year 
 Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Backstory is backed by Y Combinator and Silicon Valley’s top investors, including ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures, and Mubadala Capital. Backstory is listed in the top 20 percent of Inc 5000 companies, is a regular leader in our key categories on G2, and is on the Forbes list of America’s Best Startup Employers. For more information, please visit www.Backstory.ai . -- Regular employees may be eligible for commissions or bonus programs (target included in OTE), equity, and benefits. The range is subject to change. Backstory takes into wide range of factors when determining an individual’s pay. These factors can include, skill set, training and experience, licensure and certifications, and location and metropolitan area.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARTERA Our Mission: Make healthcare #1 in customer service. What We Deliver: Artera is an agentic company strengthening how healthcare providers communicate and care for patients. As an agentic partner, we bring over a decade of healthcare experience to address urgent workflows from day one and build custom solutions as healthcare providers’ needs evolve. Trusted by 1,000+ specialties, FQHCs, health systems, and federal agencies, Artera strengthens and protects and enhances patient relationships across every interaction - from intake and scheduling to referral management, post-visit care, and more. Hear from our CEO , Guillaume de Zwirek, about why we are standing at the edge of the biggest technological shift in healthcare’s history! Our award-winning culture: Our award-winning culture: Since founding in 2015, Artera has consistently been recognized for its innovative technology, business growth, and named a top place to work. Examples of these accolades include: Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); Built In Best Companies to Work For (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026). Artera has also been recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers,” Newsweek as one of the “World’s Best Digital Health Companies,” and named one of the top “44 Startups to Bet your Career on in 2024” by Business Insider. Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full-time, long-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future. About the Role We’re looking for a Demand Generation Manager to build and execute integrated programs that create pipeline, engage buying groups, and help accelerate opportunities through the funnel. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a strategic, analytical marketer who can translate growth priorities into coordinated programs across paid media, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll own demand program strategy and execution, direct our paid media agency, and continuously use performance data to determine what we should test, optimize, and scale. You’ll work closely with Content Strategy, Product Marketing, Events, Marketing Operations, Sales, and agency partners to connect audiences, content, and channels into cohesive buyer experiences that drive measurable business outcomes. 
 Responsibilities Drive Pipeline Across the Funnel Build and execute integrated demand campaigns that generate new pipeline, engage buying groups, and accelerate existing opportunities. Develop distinct strategies for pipeline creation and acceleration, tailoring audiences, content, channels, and calls to action based on where buyers are in their journey. Partner with Sales to understand account and pipeline priorities and identify opportunities for targeted engagement. Own Digital Channel Strategy & Performance Own the strategy and performance of paid media, email, nurture, web, and emerging demand channels, connecting them into cohesive cross-channel programs. Direct agency execution across paid media and email, setting audience, channel, investment, testing, and performance expectations while holding partners accountable to pipeline outcomes. Own paid media, email, and nurture strategy and performance, continuously optimizing audience segmentation, engagement, conversion, and progression through the funnel. Identify and test new channels, tactics, and approaches to expand reach and improve demand performance. Build Integrated Campaigns Partner with Content Strategy to jointly develop campaigns, with you bringing audience, channel, funnel, and performance insights and Content Strategy bringing content strategy, narrative, and format expertise. Partner with Product Marketing to connect buyer, market and competitive insights to audience and demand strategies, while sharing campaign performance insights that inform future messaging and go-to-market decisions. Extend Events and other Marketing programs through pre- and post-event digital engagement that maximizes their pipeline impact. Partner with Marketing Operations to leverage standardized campaign processes, tracking, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that improve execution and scale. Measure, Experiment & Optimize Own campaign and channel performance against pipeline and revenue goals, using funnel and channel-level metrics to continuously optimize investment and execution. Analyze performance to identify audience, content, channel, and conversion opportunities and turn insights into actionable recommendations. Develop hypotheses, run experiments and determine where to optimize investment. Use AI to accelerate campaign planning, personalization, experimentation, analysis, and optimization, and partner with Marketing Operations to turn successful approaches into scalable workflows. Requirements 5–8 years of B2B demand generation, growth marketing, digital marketing, or related experience, preferably in healthcare/health tech or another complex B2B environment. Demonstrated experience building integrated demand programs that contribute to pipeline and revenue. Strong knowledge of paid media and email strategy and performance, with experience effectively managing agencies or external partners. Strong analytical skills and experience using funnel and campaign data to diagnose performance, develop hypotheses, and make investment recommendations. Hands-on experience using AI to improve campaign development, personalization, analysis, experimentation, or marketing workflows. Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, with the ability to turn strategy into action and independently drive programs forward. What Success Looks Like You’ll build a repeatable demand engine that creates pipeline while increasing engagement across the full buyer journey. You’ll bring together audience, content, channels, data, and experimentation to continuously improve performance—and help us scale demand generation as Artera expands into new audiences and go-to-market motions. 
 $130,000 - $170,000 a year This compensation range is for candidates who will be based out of our Santa Barbara, CA or Seattle, WA offices. This role also comes with a 10% annual bonus, equity, and various benefits. 
 OUR APPROACH TO WORK LOCATION At Artera, we believe the best work happens when people are truly connected. Our AI services model has shown what’s possible when small, focused teams move fast together — the speed of collaboration, pace of career growth, and quality of what we build can become stronger when teams share space. As we grow, we want every new teammate to feel part of an in-person community from day one. That’s why we are focusing our U.S. hiring in three cities, where we are investing in offices and building strong local teams: Santa Barbara, CA (Our HQ) Seattle, WA Kansas City, KS/MO Unless a role’s posting states otherwise, new U.S. roles are based in one of these three cities, and candidates should reside in (or be willing to relocate to) one of these areas. Each location follows an in-person schedule that reflects how our local teams work best; we’ll walk you through what to expect for your specific role and city during the interview process. Focusing on offices and hiring in a few locations, rather than spreading thin across many cities, lets us invest deeply in each one so every team has real community, mentorship, and momentum in person. WORKING AT ARTERA Company benefits - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term & long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k) and more! Career development - Manager development resources, employee development funds Generous time off - Company holidays, Winter & Summer break, and flexible time off Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) - We believe that everyone should belong at their workplace. Our ERGs are available for identifying employees or allies to join. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY (EEO) STATEMENT Artera is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fair and equitable hiring practices. All hiring decisions at Artera are based on strategic business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. All candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. Affirmative Action Plan: To review our company’s Affirmative Action Notice, please click here to view our Affirmative Action Notice . Know Your Rights: To view your rights as an applicant under federal equal employment opportunity laws, please view the official EEOC poster: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal . In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Artera is committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment; Artera will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. Artera provides reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees in compliance with state and federal laws. If you need an accommodation, please reach out to hr@artera.io. DATA PRIVACY Artera values your privacy. By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal information provided in conjunction with your application. For more information please refer to our Privacy Policy . SECURITY REQUIREMENTS All employees are responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the organization’s systems and data, including safeguarding Artera’s sensitive information such as, Personal identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Those with specific security or privacy responsibilities must ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable standards and frameworks by implementing safeguards, monitoring for threats, reporting incidents, and addressing data handling risks or breaches.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing - Cloud & OT Security
jobs.description: Who is Tenable ? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Your Role: Tenable is seeking a talented and dynamic product marketing leader to help extend the company’s leadership across the cloud security (CNAPP) and operational technology (OT) security markets. Tenable is the Exposure Management company. More than 40,000 organizations around the world rely on us to help them understand and reduce cybersecurity risk. Our goal is to arm every organization, no matter how large or small, with the visibility and insight to answer four critical questions at all times: Where are we exposed? Where should we prioritize based on risk? Are we reducing our exposure over time? How do we compare to our peers? In this role, you will lead product marketing for Tenable’s Cloud Exposure (CNAPP) and Operational Technology (OT) solutions, with Product Marketing Managers aligned to each area reporting to you. These are two distinct buyer worlds, and a core part of this role is understanding those differences well enough to build credible, differentiated messaging for each, while also connecting both to Tenable's broader exposure management narrative so customers see one coherent platform story. Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Marketing, you will interface and regularly collaborate with a variety of departments across Tenable and play a key role in successfully executing product launches, enablement programs and demand generation campaigns for both the cloud security and OT businesses. You will leverage analytics, establish benchmarks, and gain feedback to identify program success and opportunities for improvement. Your Opportunity: Perform market research and analysis using primary (customer, partner) and secondary (analyst, sales) sources across both the cloud security and OT markets; use this to inform product, pricing, and go-to-market strategies Develop distinct buyer personas, solution messaging, and content strategy for the cloud security market and the OT security market Ensure cloud and OT positioning reinforces Tenable's overall exposure management platform narrative Create clear and compelling content for sales collateral, solution briefs, blog posts, website, webcasts, trade shows, and related activities to drive market demand and awareness for both businesses Identify key technology partnership / co-marketing opportunities and new routes to market Lead new product and solution launches across cloud security and OT Take ownership of results by measuring the effectiveness of campaigns and launch activities with data-driven insights and performance tracking Actively participate in analyst relations and public relations initiatives Participate in webcasts, events and other demand generation activities Guide and contribute to sales and partner enablement across both product areas Serve as a voice of the sales team to the product development organization Manage and develop Product Marketing Managers aligned to cloud security and OT, including setting priorities and ensuring alignment across both go-to-market strategies Recruit, onboard and train new hires Provide mentorship, guidance and career development to members of the team Create an inclusive, supportive environment where all team members can do their best work Evaluate performance of the team, including quarterly performance feedback for each team member; complete annual reviews and recommend rewards (merit/promotion/equity) based on performance for the review period Partner with manager on budget requests and spending for strategy and team development needs Provide input on yearly budget for planned strategy as well as for the team (T&E, etc.) Must have ability to travel in the US up to 20% of time What You’ll Need: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required 12+ years of high-tech product marketing or similar experience; 7+ years’ experience as a direct people manager Hybrid: Ability to commute to our Columbia, MD headquarters OR Boston, MA office - 3 days per week. Demonstrable knowledge of cloud security and vulnerability management trends, along with working knowledge of the operational technology (OT) field and broader trends in OT-heavy industries such as manufacturing and utilities Your written and oral communication skills are superb, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to a variety of audiences You are able to collaborate in a highly matrixed environment with many different stakeholders, including all levels of management You have the ability to blend strategic thinking with creative execution You possess excellent organizational skills and strong follow-through You thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where change is the norm and the bar for quality is set high You have the capacity to balance multiple projects with aggressive deadlines at the same time And Ideally: Master’s degree Working knowledge of both the CNAPP/cloud security market and the OT security landscape, including relevant compliance frameworks #LI-Hybrid #LI-LP1 This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs. US Pay Range $188,000—$250,666.67 USD We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact Recruiting@Tenable.com for further assistance. jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable . Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence. Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io Upbound builds control planes for cloud and AI infrastructure. We created Crossplane and donated it to the CNCF, where it is a graduated project used by platform teams around the world. We are applying that same model to AI inference. Upbound is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager that will own go-to-market for that work. You will help define how enterprises understand our commercial product and our open source roots. The community narrative and the enterprise narrative have to reinforce each other without collapsing into each other. We are looking for someone who has done enterprise product marketing in growth stages and who is familiar with the Pragmatic Marketing discipline. You will need to be customer obsessed and be able to talk to a platform engineer to a VP of Engineering and VP of AI and who has worked inside an open core company. In this role you will... Positioning and messaging for our AI inference portfolio. The message architecture, the value framework, and the proof behind every claim we make. Competitive and market strategy. You track the AI inference and infrastructure landscape, arm the field, and hold a defensible point of view on where the category is going. Launches, end to end. Narrative and press through analyst briefings through sales enablement, on a release cadence measured in weeks rather than quarters. Enterprise buyer fluency. Persona and journey work for CIOs, VPs of Engineering, VPs of AI, and the platform teams who evaluate us. Sales enablement sellers actually use. Sales plays, discovery questions, objection handling, cost and ROI models, customer stories. Pricing and packaging input , grounded in how enterprises actually buy and budget for AI infrastructure. The open source to commercial path. The relationship between what the project does and what the product does, and the narrative that differentiates each. Customer obsessed. You are a named spokesperson. You brief analysts, prep executives, and show up on stage, on podcasts, and in the community. You are a good fit if you have... 8+ years in B2B enterprise software product marketing , with meaningful time on infrastructure, developer, or data platform products sold to technical buyers. Enterprise go-to-market that closed real revenue. You can describe deals your messaging influenced, the buyer roles in the room, and what changed because of the work you did. Genuine technical depth. Working knowledge of AI and Inference, cloud infrastructure, and how modern software gets deployed and operated, with awareness of the Kubernetes ecosystem. Open source and commercial experience in the same organization. You have marketed a project and a product side by side. You understand community trust, the open core line, contributor and maintainer dynamics. Zero to one in an emerging category. You have taken a new, technically ambitious product to market before the analysts had a name for it. Writing you did yourself. You ship copy. Comfort with speed and ambiguity. Our releases ship in weeks. The AI infrastructure market is moving quickly. Trust with engineers, and senior sales leaders. A plus if you… Direct experience marketing AI or ML infrastructure, including inference serving, GPU capacity, or MLOps. Fluency in the CNCF and/or PyTorch ecosystem Hyperscaler or cloud marketplace route-to-market experience (AWS, Azure, GCP). Training in a value messaging discipline such as Command of the Message, or an equivalent framework you have actually operationalized. You have been the first or only PMM on a product and built the function from nothing. #LI-REMOTE Why Upbound? At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table. About Upbound Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

jobs.title: Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems
jobs.description: About KidKare The people who care for and feed children every day have enough on their plates. Their software shouldn't add to it. For more than 30 years, KidKare has built technology for the people behind childcare and child nutrition, helping them spend less time on paperwork, compliance, and administrative work and more time focused on the children and communities they serve. Our roots run deep in the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP), a federal nutrition program that helps provide healthy meals and snacks to children and adults across the country. Today, we're building on that expertise with a growing ecosystem of software supporting childcare organizations across food program compliance, business management, professional development, and licensing. We're growing into new products, new markets, and have a much bigger vision for what KidKare can do for the childcare community. To support these goals, we're looking for a Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems to build and run the engine that turns our product value into pipeline, adoption, and revenue. Position Summary This is an execution-first growth role. You'll partner with Product and Revenue Operations leadership to define the positioning and value proposition for each product, then put them to work: translating individual product propositions and features into audience-specific messaging and deploying that messaging through various tactics. You’ll be involved in managing the CRM, data enrichment, prospect scoring, routing, & lifecycle marketing. You'll report to our VP of Revenue Operations and work across Product, Sales, and Customer Growth to turn every launch and feature release into measurable pipeline, adoption, and expansion. In a given week you might ship a new CRM workflow, tune a fit-and-intent scoring model, launch a demand-gen test to a newly enriched segment, build an app telemtry guide for a feature release, fix a routing rule that's sending leads to the wrong queue, or walk leadership through what moved in the funnel and why. You'll build the machine, and you'll run it. You'll partner closely with our Digital Marketing Manager, who owns brand, creative, content, and channel execution. You'll own the systems, segmentation, lifecycle logic, experiment design, and measurement that make that work reach the right audience at the right moment. Together, you'll turn product and market insight into demand. Primary Responsibilities Positioning, Feature Messaging & Launch Execution • Partner with product leadership to define and refine positioning and value propositions for each product and major release, grounded in customer, competitive, and market insight. • Translate individual product features and releases into audience-specific messaging (the value, the proof, and the call to action) for each persona and segment we serve, carrying positioning down to the feature level. • Execute launches through the systems you manage: target segments, lifecycle and nurture workflows, in-app guides, sales sequences and snippets, with launch tiers matched to the size of the release. • Package features into the battlecards, talk tracks, and objection handling our Sales and Customer Growth teams need, delivered inside CRM where reps actually work. CRM Management & GTM Systems • Manage the CRM as the system of record for marketing and lifecycle: data model, custom properties, lifecycle stages, lead status, lists and segments, forms, and workflow automation. • Maintain CRM data quality and governance, including deduplication, field standards, consistent deal stages across pipelines, and clear documentation, so Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership trust the data. • Orchestrate the GTM stack (CRM, app telemtry, data enrichment, and automation tools) so product, marketing, and sales data flow cleanly between systems. Enrichment, AI Scoring & Routing • Build and maintain enrichment workflows that close firmographic, contact, and segment data gaps, including vertical-specific sources relating to childcare, education, and food program participation data. • Design, deploy, and continuously tune fit, intent, and product-usage scoring models, using AI and predictive approaches where they outperform rules-based logic. • Own lead and account routing rules, handoff SLAs, and alerts to Sales and Customer Growth, and monitor speed-to-lead and conversion by route. Demand Generation Experiments • Run a structured demand-gen experimentation program: define the hypothesis, audience, channel, offer, success metric, and decision rule before launch, then scale or move to the next experiment based on results. • Build and execute campaigns, nurture tracks, and outbound sequences against enriched, scored segments, partnering with the Digital Marketing Manager on creative and channel execution. • Use customer, competitive, and market insight to surface new segments and opportunities worth testing, and maintain a prioritized backlog and a visible results log so learnings compound. Lifecycle & In-App Engagement • Own lifecycle programs across the customer journey: onboarding, activation, feature adoption, cross-sell and expansion, renewal, and win-back. • Build behavior-triggered journeys that combine CRM email and telemetry in-app guides, driven by product usage signals rather than calendar cadence alone. • Partner with Product and Customer Growth to identify adoption gaps and cross-sell opportunities across our product portfolio, and run the programs that close them. Funnel Reporting & Measurement • Support maintenance of funnel stage definitions and conversion logic from first touch through closed-won, activation, and expansion. • Build and own dashboards and recurring funnel reporting for RevOps and leadership, covering pipeline, conversion rates, velocity, channel and campaign performance, and product adoption. • Set attribution and experiment measurement standards, and translate the numbers into clear recommendations on where to invest next. We care about great marketing, but ultimately we care about whether it drives growth. What Success Looks Like • First 90 days: You've aligned with product leadership on positioning for priority products; audited HubSpot data, lifecycle stages, and routing; published agreed funnel definitions; shipped a baseline funnel dashboard; and launched your first experiments. • First 6 months: Enrichment and scoring are live and routing leads to Sales and Customer Growth against defined SLAs; core onboarding and adoption journeys are running across email and in-app; and experiments ship on a steady cadence with documented results. • First 12 months: Every feature release runs through a repeatable launch playbook executed in the stack; conversion, speed-to-lead, and product adoption show measurable lift; and leadership uses your funnel reporting to make investment decisions. You'll Probably Love This Role If… • You're a builder who loves making the machine work, not just drawing the diagram. You'd rather ship the test than debate it. • You're curious about customers, competitors, and markets and naturally find yourself asking, “Where's the opportunity here?” • You read a feature release and immediately think about the segment, the trigger, the channel, and the metric. • Messy CRM data bothers you, and you'd rather fix it at the source than patch it in a spreadsheet. • You think in funnels and can explain, in plain language, why a conversion rate moved. • You use AI as a force multiplier in real workflows, from enrichment and scoring to research and content variants, and you know where it helps and where it doesn't. • You’re a natural collaborative and aren’t afraid to step outside of the RevOps team to work with Product, Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership. • You're comfortable owning your work end to end without needing a huge team around you. • You're excited to build the GTM engine rather than inherit a finished one. Required Qualifications • 4+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, revenue operations, or GTM engineering or a related B2B SaaS role. • Hands-on CRM management/ownership as an admin or power user, including properties, lifecycle stages, workflows, lists, scoring, and reporting. • Experience partnering with product leadership to define positioning and value propositions, and a proven ability to translate individual features into audience-specific messaging deployed across campaigns, lifecycle programs, in-app experiences, and sales enablement. • Experience building data enrichment, lead scoring, and routing, including AI or predictive scoring approaches. • A track record of designing and running demand-gen experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented outcomes. • Experience building behavior-triggered lifecycle programs across email and in-app channels. • Strong funnel reporting and analytics skills: defining stages and conversion metrics, building dashboards, and working comfortably with data in spreadsheets or BI tools. • Clear, concise writing, from lifecycle copy to experiment readouts to leadership summaries. • Strong project management and systems thinking, with a habit of documenting what you build. • A builder mentality and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CACFP, childcare, child nutrition, education, government programs, or other regulated industries is a huge plus, but not a requirement. CACFP has its own language, regulations, acronyms, and complexities. If you already know it, amazing. If you don't, you'll be surrounded by an exceptional team of people who do, and we'll help you get up to speed. A few other things we'd love to see: • Experience with vertical SaaS, multi-product portfolios, or marketing to both SMB and enterprise or public-sector buyers. • CRM certifications (Marketing, Sales, or Operations related) or hands-on experience with CRM AI and data enrichment features. • Hands-on experience with in-app engagement or product adoption platforms • Experience with enrichment and GTM automation tools • Technical comfort beyond the UI: SQL, APIs and webhooks, or light scripting (JavaScript or Python) to connect systems and automate workflows. • Comfort building AI-powered workflows for research, enrichment, scoring, and content variation. You know how to make AI your copilot, not your copywriter. Why KidKare? We're at an exciting inflection point, taking decades of experience in childcare and child nutrition and using it to build a broader ecosystem of products for the organizations and people who help care for our communities. You won't be starting from scratch. We've invested deeply in understanding our customers, markets, competitors, and products. But we're not handing you a finished machine and asking you to keep it running. We want you to build the engine that powers what comes next. If you want to own the systems, run the experiments, build the lifecycle, measure the funnel, and see exactly how your work moves pipeline and adoption, you'll have plenty to dig into here. All qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or marital status. #KidKare

jobs.description: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do . If they resonate, this could be a great fit! Location: This role is fully remote but must overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time. About this role Individual Giving has set an objective to double new donor acquisition in 2027 and expand our awareness through brand ads for key segments. Paid media is the biggest lever we have to get there, and as Growth Manager, Paid Media, you'll own delivery of this important priority. To help get us there, GiveDirectly is planning to expand its spend on paid media. We are looking for someone who will be a strong cultural fit—curious, keen not to follow industry standards but to look for disproportionately high-leverage opportunities, keen to constantly learn and adjust, and comfortable launching a paid program without agency support. This role would suit someone comfortable in a fast-paced environment, able to pivot and change tactics based on data and changing circumstances. Reporting to our Director of Individual Giving, you’ll manage all paid acquisition for Individual Giving across Meta, Google, YouTube, and TikTok, and also work closely with the VP of Marketing to manage all upper-funnel media buys (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, etc.) for both the Individual Giving and Marketing teams. This role is responsible for executing our paid media program end to end, including negotiating and managing contracts, creating ads, capturing screenshots for documentation, publishing campaigns, and monitoring performance. You will also build our tracking and attribution systems and use that data to grow both one-time and monthly giving. To do so, we are looking for a strong individual contributor who is comfortable executing within the platforms without a big team or agency. The Individual Giving team is responsible for generating revenue across donors with an annual gift below $50k. To do so, the Individual Giving team executes compelling public fundraising campaigns, drives creative donor-facing content, and tests new marketing initiatives aimed at expanding our donor base and raising awareness of direct cash transfers. You’ll join a small but high-performing team that runs several campaigns at once and works with a lot of independence. You’ll partner with Brand and Marketing colleagues each campaign cycle to ensure integrated marketing across all public-facing materials. Level: Manager (we are willing to hire at Senior Manager for more experienced candidates) Reports To: Director of Individual Giving Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1–2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits What you’ll bring: 3–5+ years in growth or performance marketing with a proven track record running paid media to a conversion or revenue target, in-house or agency, across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Non-profit experience is a plus, but not required. Experience managing a paid media budget of at least US$5M a year with a track record of strong performance measurement, with the discipline to trust your own data over platform recommendations and the judgment to know when to scale a channel, cut it, or admit it isn't working—pause and reset. A genuine test-and-learn habit: you design multivariable testing across creative, audience, messaging, and landing pages, using these insights to scale the program. Strong written communication, the ability to own creative direction of ads (from conception and drafting through launch), and experience with or a strong eye for graphic design (Figma, Canva). You’ll work with content creation teams for bigger projects, but initial ideation and direction should come from you. Strong, succinct communication, and the ability to work productively with a Brand and Marketing team focused on brand awareness. Alignment with GiveDirectly’s values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. Experience with tracking and attribution to ensure detailed reports are shared with senior management. Bonus skills: Experience with our tech stack (WordPress, Salesforce, PostHog, Google Analytics, Tableau, Zendesk, Ahrefs) or similar tools. Experience with paid ads with a non-profit of a similar size or an agency supporting non-profits. What you’ll do Own paid media strategy and performance to execute growth and brand goals Develop and execute the paid digital fundraising strategy that acquires new donors, grows revenue, and strengthens long-term supporter value across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, programmatic, and emerging platforms (approx. 50% of time). Run top-of-funnel brand ads, from placement and contracting to creative direction and development, including podcasts, OOH, and connected TV (approx. 30% of time). Manage and optimize paid investment daily, monitoring spend, pacing, cost per acquisition, and conversion, and reallocating budget as performance dictates. Run a continuous test-and-learn program across audiences, creative messaging, channels, landing pages, and donation experiences, and turn results into decisions rather than reports. Make key and strategic recommendations to the Director of Individual Giving and VP of Marketing on where budget spend should be allocated based on performance data. Grow one-time and monthly giving through paid Run acquisition and conversion campaigns for both one-time and monthly giving, testing paid tactics to grow the recurring program—the fastest-growing part of our portfolio. Optimize the digital supporter journey so paid campaigns connect cleanly to landing pages, donation forms, email, and CRM, maximizing conversion and retention. Analyze acquisition, conversion, revenue, and retention trends by segment to inform where the next dollar goes. Measurement & Reporting Stand up standardized paid-channel attribution and UTM tracking so acquisition spend is evaluable outside the ad platforms. Build and maintain performance dashboards that connect campaign, website, and CRM data into a single view of what each channel returns. Develop a forecasting model that projects cost per acquisition and revenue by channel, so budget increases are decisions rather than bets. Report to senior management on budget and paid campaign performance on a bi-weekly basis. This role might not be for you if You are used to relying on an agency for recommendations or ad builds in the platforms themselves. You do not have experience/familiarity with both upper-funnel and direct conversion paid advertising. You are not comfortable managing projects from A–Z, including ideation, planning, launching, testing, iterating, and evaluating. What success looks like in 12–18 months A clear, measurable contribution to the 2027 goal of doubling new donor acquisition, with a 50–70% share of new monthly donors acquired through paid. The Google Ad Grant is fully deployed against upper-funnel objectives, in compliance, and contributing measurable qualified traffic. A documented acquisition model forecasts cost per acquisition and revenue by channel accurately enough to justify a materially larger paid budget. Compensation At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here . Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income. This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, the US, or the UK, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process. Commitment to Safeguarding As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme , and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. Deep ABM expertise, including account selection, segmentation, intent signals, personalisation, multi-channel orchestration, Sales alignment and account-level measurement across 1:1, 1:few and scaled programmes. A strong track record of building demand-generation programmes that create measurable pipeline and revenue, with the ability to optimise channel mix based on commercial impact rather than lead or MQL volume. Strong commercial and analytical skills, with fluency in funnel metrics, pipeline, attribution, conversion and marketing ROI, including experience owning and allocating budget. Proven ability to operate as a true go-to-market partner to Sales and Revenue Operations, agreeing shared targets and priorities and working through disagreements constructively. As our Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll be responsible for the strategy and execution behind how we create and accelerate demand — from integrated campaign development and account-based marketing to email nurture, social, and our website. You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our programs generate real pipeline, not just activity. This is the right role for someone who thinks in full funnels, can manage multiple programs at once without losing quality, and brings both strategic instincts and execution chops. If you're energized by proactivity and making a real impact — and want to do it at a company with a product that practitioners genuinely love and executives choose for their critical infrastructure — this is your seat. What you will do: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns across the full funnel, from awareness to pipeline — and own the performance reporting that follows. Build and scale an account-based marketing (ABM) program targeting enterprise accounts in partnership with Sales, including tiered account plays and cross-functional alignment. Own our end-to-end email nurture strategy across audience segments — free users, trial accounts, and enterprise prospects — and continuously improve conversion through testing and segmentation. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, SEO and AI Visibility - US
jobs.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Role Overview We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the SEO and AI visibility solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once. The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both. This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance Productize what repeats. When the same issue or workflow shows up across the fleet, solve it once through better defaults, automation, shared capabilities, or safeguards Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines Run a real experimentation program: prove changes on representative cohorts of sites, establish incremental impact, then scale what works rather than shipping broadly and inferring impact afterward Own migration quality and regression prevention, including the standards, acceptance criteria, and automated checks that hold search quality as the platform ships Partner with the team building the next generation of our website platform so search is designed in from the start, and give every product team a low-friction path to the right implementation Set platform-level goals for organic performance, AI visibility, and client outcomes, and report against them to leadership Who You Are 8+ years combined across SEO and product management, including 3+ years as a product manager shipping alongside engineering teams You have owned search for a platform that hosts many independent customer domains, such as a website builder, a hosting or commerce platform, or a multi-location or franchise network. Running search for one large marketplace or corporate domain is valuable experience, but the fleet problem is a different job and it is the one we have Deep technical foundation across rendering and JavaScript SEO, crawl and index management, information architecture, structured data, page performance, and migrations You treat bots and AI agents as users of a website alongside people, and you design for both without trading one against the other Obsessive about experimentation and measurement, including cohort testing, causal impact analysis, Search Console data at scale, log analysis, and the discipline to tell a result from a coincidence A current point of view on AI search, including how models discover, interpret, and cite a brand, and the judgment to separate what genuinely moves visibility from what is repackaged advice Fluent with AI as a working tool. You use it to investigate messy systems, establish ground truth quickly, prototype solutions, and unblock yourself rather than waiting on another team at every stage of discovery You get requirements implemented by teams you do not own, and you are welcome back afterward. What you write is sharp enough that a team of engineers can move without waiting on you Opinionated about prioritization. This space generates infinite work, and your judgment about what to ignore matters as much as what you ship Preferred Qualifications Experience at a website platform such as Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, WordPress, or Duda Experience with programmatic or template-driven SEO across large page inventories Local and entity-driven search experience, since our clients compete market by market Conversion and page experience work alongside acquisition, since traffic that does not convert does not help a client Background in PropTech, real estate, or another B2B2C category where the platform's job is to make its customers win Experience building client-facing reporting or diagnostic tools for a non-technical audience Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations. Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms. You're the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else's Manage execution end to end. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time What we're looking for Builder mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead Strong communicator. You coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and execs smoothly Customer-first. You care about memorable, frictionless experiences from invite to post-event follow-up Curious and eager to learn. You're always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas, including AI, to make each event better than the last Experience 2+ years in event management, field marketing, or community roles, ideally in B2B SaaS Proven ability to plan and execute events, from small dinners to large activations Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot, and event platforms like Luma, Zoom Webinars or similar Comfortable building simple landing pages, managing email lists, and running event promotion campaigns Skilled in vendor sourcing, budget tracking, and on-site coordination Strong cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities Familiar with tracking and reporting event performance, including attendance, engagement, and pipeline impact Experience managing partner collaborations or maintaining relationships with GTM leaders and communities is a plus Nice to have Experience in B2B SaaS, RevOps, or MarTech Prior involvement in partner activations or co-marketing events Experience managing sponsorships or collaborations with other brands Comfortable using analytics tools to measure event outcomes A strong network within the GTM, Sales, or Marketing communities Background in social or content amplification around events, for example capturing and repurposing event moments Interview process Application review. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It's not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process. Executive interview. The final step. We're hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. Additional Information Why you'll love being a part of our team: Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future. jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote About the Team Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up. As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach. What You'll Do Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out. Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all. Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures. Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back. Partner with Marketing Operations to get attribution and UTM tracking right before scaling spend, so every dollar is measurable. Define target audiences and channel mix aligned to Netlify's ICP; partner with Product Marketing on messaging inputs for paid creative. Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel. Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off. As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team. What You'll Bring 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel This Role Is a Great Fit If You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature. You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency. You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters. You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought. You want to build in close partnership with Lifecycle, Campaigns, and Marketing Ops rather than run paid as a separate lane that hands off a spreadsheet at the end of the quarter Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $150,000 - $200,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-demand-generation-marketing-manager

jobs.title: AI Solutions Lead, Marketing
jobs.description: Headquarters: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only) We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu Most companies are layering AI onto existing processes. This role is about something different: rebuilding those processes from the ground up, so teams can do work that actually matters. Instacart's Marketing team has set ambitious AI goals — and this is the person who makes them real. You'll be the first role of this kind in Marketing, embedded in the org with a clear mandate: identify what's slow, manual, or broken across the Marketing organization and rebuild it into something fundamentally better. The benchmark isn't marginal improvement. It's transformation — building solutions that make people wonder how they ever worked without them. This is a builder role. Strategy is a means to an end. The end is something shipped, adopted, and measurable. You'll also be the connective tissue for Marketing's AI ambitions — convening the people who own AI goals, unblocking what's stuck, and creating internal momentum that makes the whole org move faster. What you'll cook up in your first year Building (60%) Identify high-impact workflows, systems, and processes across Marketing that are slow, manual, or duct-taped together — and rebuild them AI-natively, from the ground up Own the full cycle: understand the current state, design the solution, build it, ship it — then measure what changed. Establish the before, prove the after, and make the case to leadership Walk in with work already queued. Early builds include: Recurring leadership and planning narratives — transforming how Marketing produces its MBR, quarterly planning summaries, budget variance write-ups, and channel performance narratives; currently manual synthesis across multiple inputs, rebuilt into a faster, more consistent, AI-native output Integrated campaign launch process — automating key steps from campaign ideation to launch, reducing the manual handoffs and coordination overhead that slow campaigns down across teams Brief quality and standardization — an AI review layer that evaluates briefs before they leave the building, flags what's missing or unclear, and raises input quality across the org before downstream teams absorb the cost of a bad brief Build with portability in mind — your solutions should be constructed so others can pick them up, adapt them for their own context, and extend what you've built without starting from scratch; you're not just solving a problem, you're creating infrastructure others can build on Develop and maintain an intake framework: gather inputs from across the org, evaluate feasibility and impact, and make a defensible call on what gets built next — including what doesn't; prioritization discipline means saying no to low-value requests as readily as yes to high-value ones Driving Adoption (20%) Own the change management side of every build: create the conditions for people to trust what you've built, use it consistently, and not revert to old habits when something feels unfamiliar Evangelize internally — write up wins, build case studies, show other teams what's possible; your goal is to generate more demand than you can supply, which means the org needs to see what AI can actually do, not just hear about it Create energy around AI across Marketing — not as a cheerleader, but as someone who shows people things they didn't know were possible and makes it easy for them to take the next step Orchestration & Thought Partnership (20%) Lead the MarComms AI KR forum: convene AI KR owners across Marketing, create momentum behind shared goals, surface blockers, and hold the operating cadence Act as a working partner to AI goal owners — unblocking vendor delays, solving capability gaps, helping people get unstuck The secret ingredients we're looking for Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 7+ years in marketing operations, marketing strategy, or a closely adjacent discipline — you understand how marketing orgs work, where the friction lives, and what it costs to leave it unfixed Proven builder with a track record of impact — you have shipped AI-powered workflows and processes that demonstrably changed how teams work; you can name the problem, describe the solution, and quantify the result. You’re so invested in AI that you’ve applied it beyond the scope of your current role. Hands-on daily experience with frontier AI tools such as Claude, GPT-4o, or Gemini, including writing prompts that produce reliable, production-quality output at scale Experience building agentic systems where AI components interact with each other, including multi-agent design, orchestration layers, and workflows that run without a human in the loop at every step An adoption-minded approach to building: designing for adoption from day one and taking accountability for whether what you built actually gets used Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain what you're building, why it matters, and where it stands, for audiences from ICs to CMO-level leadership Prioritization discipline — you can evaluate a request and tell someone their problem isn't a good AI candidate right now, or that the cost of building outstrips the benefit; you know what not to build Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) A framework for evaluating AI vendors and tools quickly, including running comparison pilots and making principled decisions about what earns a place in the stack Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here . For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CAN $126,000 — $133,000 CAD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instacart-ai-solutions-lead-marketing
