jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Manager at Health & Wellness Supplements Brand (Remote)
jobs.description: Paired is a global recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located. About Our Clients Our client is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness supplements brand focused on building its presence through creator-led marketing and user-generated content (UGC). They are looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to build and manage a network of creators, develop creator partnerships, and grow affiliate-driven content and sales. This role is focused on managing creators and creator relationships rather than personally creating content. Key responsibilities Source and identify relevant creators and UGC creators within the health, wellness, fitness, supplements, and lifestyle space. Conduct creator outreach across email, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant channels to build a strong creator pipeline. Manage creator relationships from initial outreach through onboarding, briefing, content delivery, and ongoing collaboration. Develop and manage creator gifting and UGC campaigns, ensuring creators receive clear briefs and deliver content aligned with brand objectives. Build and maintain an affiliate creator network, identifying opportunities to turn high-performing creators into long-term brand partners. Track creator outreach, responses, content submissions, affiliate activity, and campaign performance. Monitor creator and campaign performance to identify high-performing partners and opportunities for further collaboration. Collaborate with the marketing team to continuously improve creator selection, outreach strategies, campaign briefs, and partnership processes. Requirements 5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, affiliate marketing, or a closely related field. Proven experience sourcing and conducting outreach to creators and influencers, preferably at scale. Experience managing creators throughout the full partnership lifecycle, from outreach and onboarding through content delivery and performance tracking. Previous experience working with health, wellness, supplements, fitness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands is strongly preferred. Experience with UGC creator campaigns and understanding of what makes creator content effective for paid and organic social. Experience building or managing an affiliate creator network is a strong plus. Strong communication, relationship management, negotiation, and organizational skills. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing multiple creator relationships simultaneously. Strong understanding of platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and relevant creator/affiliate ecosystems. Benefits Competitive USD salary based on experience. Fully remote position. Opportunity to work directly with a growing U.S.-based health and wellness brand.

jobs.title: Director, Demand Generation
jobs.salary: The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.
jobs.description: Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service. Founded in 2013 and trusted by leading brands and service providers, we power seamless, reliable service experiences through a modern platform built for scale. Our platform gives businesses the visibility, communication, and control they need to manage every step of the service journey, from job acceptance through completion. With the acquisition of Youreka in 2023, Dispatch expanded its capabilities to include a leading Salesforce-native Smart Forms application that equips mobile workers with guided workflows, improves field execution and customer service, and scales to support complex enterprise operations. As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We're investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth. We're now investing in a dedicated marketing function to match the strength of our product and customer base, and we're hiring our first Director of Demand Generation to build it. THE ROLE: Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Demand Generation will own demand generation for Dispatch and Youreka, reshaping what marketing means for the company and our products. This role also owns our Business Development Representative team's strategy and targets, working primarily through our existing BDR team lead. This is a hands-on, builder role: you'll set strategy and run campaigns yourself in the early days, then pursue growth within the marketing team as the function proves out. AS THE DIRECTOR OF DEMAND GENERATION, YOU WILL: Demand generation & growth - assess Dispatch's situation from first principles to determine where marketing should focus (paid acquisition, lifecycle/email, organic, and other channels); own the marketing automation and CRM stack; generate and manage a healthy, measurable pipeline in close partnership with sales. Building this out is the top priority for this role. Product-market fit & positioning - identify, through testing and analysis, which segments, use cases, and messages actually convert; use that to sharpen demand-gen targeting and messaging, and share findings with our Product Marketing team to inform their formal positioning work. Content - build a content engine (website copy, case studies, thought leadership) that supports demand generation and conversion. Team leadership - own strategy and targets for our BDR team, working closely with the existing Lead BDR and aligning team output with the broader demand generation strategy. You will also manage an existing marketing team resource and help define future role additions over time. Diagnose marketing channel mix for Dispatch's products - prioritizing investment accordingly. Establish the processes, reporting, and KPIs the function will run on. WITHIN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL: Build a functioning marketing engine - team, tools, and process, revamped from a lean starting point and working closely with our Senior Marketing Manager. Define a clear, data-backed point of view on where Dispatch should focus its marketing investment, measurable pipeline/revenue contribution from marketing, and BDR-driven programs. Develop sharper product positioning and messaging along with marketing support delivered for major product launches and market expansions. Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch's growth functions. LOCATION: Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use. SALARY: The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits. Requirements 5–10 years of marketing experience including specific focus on demand generation and program definition. A startup-tested operator - comfortable being hands-on and building programs with limited resources, not just directing an existing team. A proven track record of owning a marketing function or team from an early stage. Proven, hands-on experience managing a demand-generation/marketing function is required. Experience managing a team on a sales-style comp plan - such as a BDR, SDR, or inside-sales function - is a plus. An analytical, first-principles thinker who can diagnose which channels and tactics actually drive results for a given business, rather than defaulting to a standard playbook - we're counting on you to help define our ideal marketing mix, not just execute one. A strong written communicator who can turn technical or operational product value into compelling brand and content narratives. B2B SaaS experience preferred; experience in field service, home services, or enterprise software is a plus. Benefits WE HAVE: An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths A generous medical, dental, and vision package Paid parental leave 401(k) with company match Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule STILL WITH US? We're ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers. Not a fit? Keep an eye on our Careers Page for other positions! Dispatch is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other classification as required by applicable law. #Dispatch

jobs.description: The Opportunity As the Demand Generation Manager at Coursedog, you'll own driving new business into our pipeline—sitting at the center of marketing, sales, and product to build and run campaigns that generate real revenue impact. You'll partner closely with BDR, Sales, Product, Design, and Marketing to execute multi-channel demand gen strategy while staying hands-on with execution. This role is ideal for a go-getter with 3-6+ years of B2B marketing experience who thrives balancing strategic planning with scrappy, fast execution, enjoys owning outcomes from campaign conception through measurement, and is energized by direct visibility into pipeline and revenue results. This position offers a competitive base salary between $100,000 - $110,000 , based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to $110,000 - $125,000 when performance objectives are achieved. What You'll Do Own driving new business into the pipeline: develop demand gen strategy, identify high-impact campaigns and channels, and execute with accountability for pipeline and revenue outcomes. Build and run multi-channel demand gen campaigns across email, content, social, and digital advertising—measuring performance against pipeline goals and iterating based on data. Own paid advertising strategy and execution, including PPC/SEM, paid social, and display—managing budget allocation, bidding, targeting, and creative testing to maximize pipeline-qualified traffic and ROI. Partner with the BDR team on campaign strategy, targeting, and timing to maximize new engagement and qualification rates. Lead strategy, research, and creation for demand gen content, email, and social messaging, collaborating closely with team members to lead execution Develop and refine ABM strategy for key accounts, partnering with Sales to align targeting, messaging, and cadence with their priorities and sales cycles. Collaborate with the Product Marketing Manager and marketing team on messaging, positioning, and product news to ensure campaigns stay aligned with product direction and customer value propositions. Own event strategy for demand gen: help refine the event list, identify which presentation types and formats will drive the most pipeline, and partner with event marketing to align event selection with company and revenue goals. Use AI tools and marketing automation platforms to optimize campaign performance, personalization, and lead scoring—leveraging technology to scale impact and work smarter. Analyze pipeline and revenue data to guide campaign decisions, identify what's working, and continuously refine strategy and channel mix. Own consistent reporting and the communication of metrics to the broader team, while partnering with Marketing Operations to build dashboards and align on team/company goals. Take initiative across the marketing function: identify opportunities, move fast, and support teammates without waiting to be asked. Requirements What You'll Bring 4-5+ years of B2B EdTech demand generation or growth marketing experience, with hands-on expertise building and running multi-channel campaigns (email, content, social, digital advertising). Proven track record of generating measurable pipeline and revenue impact through demand gen campaigns. Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills: ability to use pipeline and revenue data to guide decisions, measure campaign performance, and optimize channel mix. Demonstrated experience with ABM strategy and close partnership with sales teams on key account targeting and messaging. Strong hands-on execution skills: comfort owning campaign creation, messaging, social content, and digital advertising—not just strategy or planning. Experience with marketing automation platforms and CRMs (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, or similar) and ability to evaluate and implement AI tools to improve campaign effectiveness. Go-getter mentality: takes initiative, digs in without being asked twice, balances strategic planning with scrappy execution, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills: proven ability to partner effectively with BDR, Sales, Product, Design, and the broader marketing team; genuinely open to feedback. EdTech or higher ed experience preferred. Not sure if you should apply? Research shows that women and people from underrepresented backgrounds are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification listed. At Coursedog, we're focused on finding the best person for the role, and that person may come from a non-traditional background. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement — our evaluation focuses on your ability to thrive in this role and make an impact. Benefits About Coursedog At Coursedog, our mission is simple but ambitious: to break down barriers to student success. Founded by former college students who were frustrated by outdated academic systems, Coursedog was built to empower higher ed administrators to deliver exceptional educational experiences and make it easier for students to achieve their goals. Since then, we’ve grown into a platform trusted by institutions across the country. Coursedog is the Intelligent Academic Operations Platform, empowering 400+ colleges and universities to better serve over 3.3 million students. Our platform brings together academic scheduling, curriculum and catalog management, assessment, and workflow automation — all designed to adapt to each institution’s unique needs and remove administrative roadblocks so educators can focus on helping students succeed. We’re a remote-first, fast-growing company and a Forbes Top 500 U.S. Startup Employer, with a culture that prioritizes engagement, ownership, and impact. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems, working with thoughtful teammates, and improving education at scale, you’ll feel right at home at Coursedog. Working at Coursedog Healthcare, Dental & Vision We follow a fixed contribution model to promote equity and transparency. Every employee receives the same annual dollar amount to apply toward medical, dental, and vision coverage. This approach gives you the flexibility to choose the plan that best fits your needs, whether that is a base-level option or more comprehensive coverage. Depending on the selected coverage level, the company covers: Employee-only coverage: 99% to 65% of monthly premiums Employee plus dependents: 77% to 50% of monthly premiums We partner with Aetna and Guardian, and offer access to best-in-class wellness and support programs, including: Spring Health (mental health support) XP Health (vision benefits) Carrot Fertility (family planning support) One Medical (primary care) We also support pre-tax savings through Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA). Retirement Planning To support long-term financial health, we offer a Safe Harbor 401(k) plan from day one of employment. Coursedog provides a 4% employer match on your total compensation (subject to federal limits) each pay period for employees contributing to a tax-advantaged retirement account. Paid Time Off We trust our employees to manage their time responsibly. That’s why we offer an unlimited Paid Time Off policy — because flexibility and balance are critical for sustained excellence and personal well-being. Remote-First Since Inception We were built for distributed work. Our culture emphasizes flexibility over rigidity, outcomes over hours, and transparency over gatekeeping. We are committed to being a remote-first organization indefinitely, empowering you to work where and how you thrive best. Equity As a valued contributor to our collective success, you’ll participate in the upside. All employees are granted equity in the company aligned to your role and tenure. Equity grants are reviewed and adjusted with promotions to reflect your evolving impact. Paid Parental Leave Coursedog supports all parents regardless of gender, family structure, or how you became a parent. All parents receive up to 6 weeks of Paid Bonding Leave at 100% of base pay following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. Birthing parents receive an additional 6 weeks of Paid Medical Recovery Leave at 100% of base pay to support physical recovery following childbirth — for a total of up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave.

This is a fully remote opportunity for professionals based in Latin America, working closely with an international team in an English-speaking environment. Organization: managing multiple accounts and tasks without missing deadlines or deliverables. Follow-through: completing tasks from start to finish and making sure everything works correctly. jobs.description: Summary We're a growing B2B SaaS company. We want an operator to build a team of high performers, especially in sales and marketing. This is not a traditional HR role. Available 15–25 hours a week, US-based, and open to going full-time. HOW IT WORKS Paid 30-day trial. jobs.title: Email and Lifecycle Marketing Specialist (Remote) | Nicaragua
jobs.description: Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor Workplace: Remote Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm EST Compensation: $1,800 - $2,000 About Us HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard. For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue. About the Role As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge. This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it. Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value. Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Responsibilities Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages. Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar. Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance. Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy. Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments. Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms. Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results. Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations. Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test. Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems. Requirements Must-Have: 3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience. Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting. DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience. Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work. Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health. Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns. Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion. Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows. Nice to Have: Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses. Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools. Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions. Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Who We Are We're Future, a global leader in specialist media. Our people bring our trusted brands to life, helping millions of people discover expert content that informs, inspires, and drives action. As a pioneering multiplatform media powerhouse, we provide expert content and technology that build valuable communities across all channels. You'll join our Commercial Product Marketing team, driving innovation across Future's global portfolio of premier digital brands. We connect millions of engaged consumers with leading advertisers through market-leading ad products, high-impact content, and proprietary technology. Our team turns industry insights into revenue opportunities that power sustainable commercial growth. Description We’re looking for an entrepreneurial Product Marketing Manager to help define, launch, and grow the next generation of Future’s offerings. You’ll own a customer segment, product area, or strategic growth opportunity - developing a deep understanding of the market, identifying customer needs, shaping the proposition, and driving commercial results. You won’t simply market an existing roadmap or take requests. You’ll identify and validate new opportunities, influence product priorities, develop the commercial strategy, and lead GTM launches that build awareness, adoption, and revenue. What You'll Do You will report to the Director of Product Marketing Own Your Customer Segment or Product Area: Develop a deep understanding of your customers, market dynamics, competitive landscape, unmet needs, and growth opportunities. Identify New Opportunities: Use customer research, market analysis, competitive intelligence, and Sales insight to identify opportunities that could create meaningful value for customers and Future. Validate the Opportunity: Test customer problems, concepts, demand, willingness to pay, pricing, packaging, and service models before significant investment. Shape the Proposition: Define who we serve, what problem we solve, why customers will choose us, and how our offering creates differentiated value. Influence What We Build: Translate customer and market insight into product opportunities, business cases, requirements, and priorities in partnership with Product and cross-functional teams. Own the Commercial Model: Develop positioning, pricing, packaging, revenue models, and monetization strategies that support adoption and growth. Equip Sales to Win: Develop sales narratives, presentations, playbooks, tools, training, and objection handling that help Sales communicate value and close business. Lead High-Impact Launches: Own launch strategy and execution, including audience definition, positioning, messaging, content, external marketing campaigns, thought leadership, PR, and other channels. Create Market Momentum: Build awareness and demand for new offerings through compelling stories, customer proof points, market education, and integrated external campaigns. Measure and Improve Performance: Use customer feedback, market insight, and commercial performance data to improve the product, proposition, launch strategy, and customer experience. Drive Growth: Identify what to scale, iterate, or stop, and help turn successful offerings into meaningful and repeatable revenue streams. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, operations, advertising, digital media, or a related discipline. Proven experience identifying, developing, launching, or scaling a new product, market, customer segment, or commercial offering. Proven ability to identify and validate new opportunities - not simply execute an existing roadmap. Experience owning or significantly contributing to external product launches and integrated go-to-market campaigns. Strong customer discovery, research, analytical, and market-sizing skills. Strong commercial instincts around pricing, packaging, monetization, and revenue growth. Experience working closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and customers. Excellent strategic, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. Highly curious and innovation-minded, with an interest in emerging technology and AI. Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial; comfortable creating the path forward rather than waiting for one. A bias toward action, experimentation, and learning. Comfortable operating without a playbook and building structure from scratch. Experience in advertising, ad tech, media buying, publisher monetization, marketing technology, or digital media is a plus, as is experience with high-volume, self-service, automation, or AI-enabled products. What We Offer Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401k plus a company match Uncapped leave When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus Refer a friend and get rewarded when they join Future Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programs Opportunity to purchase shares in Future with our Share Incentive Plan The expected range for this role is $90,000 - $120,000. This is a hybrid role, working 2 days from the New York office. Internal job family level Commercial 4 Diversity and Inclusion At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educate our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.description: Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint. We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology. Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle. Overview We are seeking a creative and trend-savvy Social Media Content Specialist to grow brand awareness, engagement, and community presence across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts. This role will be responsible for executing day-to-day social media activities, managing content calendars, creating engaging short-form content, and identifying emerging trends that strengthen TP-Link's connection with consumers. The ideal candidate combines strong content creation skills with a data-driven approach to social media marketing. They will develop and publish compelling social content, collaborate with creative teams and influencers, and capitalize on real-time trends to maximize reach and engagement. Success in this role requires hands-on experience producing short-form video content, deep knowledge of social platform best practices, and the ability to balance creative storytelling with measurable business results. Responsibilities 1. Channel & Calendar Management Execute Daily Publishing: Plan, schedule, and publish daily content across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, ensuring every channel remains active, on-brand, and consistently scheduled. Content Calendar Strategy: Build and maintain an integrated social content calendar aligned with product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal moments, and trending topics. 2. Content Creation & Production Agile Content Creation: Shoot and edit native short-form video (Reels, Shorts) and photo content independently when quick turnaround or real-time trend capitalization is needed. Creative Briefing & Asset Coordination: Draft clear creative briefs and collaborate with internal graphic designers, video editors, and copywriters to produce high-quality brand assets. Budget & Production Management: Manage micro-budgets for creative production, freelance resources, or sponsored post boosts as required. 3. Trend Discovery & Creator Activation Trend Spotting: Continuously monitor viral audio, formats, memes, and emerging social trends, pitching actionable ideas with a clear hypothesis on why they will perform. Influencer & Creator Engagement: Identify relevant tech creators, reviewers, and lifestyle influencers worth activating for content collaborations, product seeding, or co-branded campaigns. Requirements Bachelor's degree required. 3+ Year of hands-on experience managing brand social media channels (consumer electronics, hardware, or DTC e-commerce background strongly preferred). Production Skills: Proven ability to shoot, edit, and produce short-form video content using mobile editing tools (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or native platform editors). Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook formats, algorithms, and performance analytics. Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to balance aesthetic storytelling with data-driven decision-making to optimize reach, impressions, and engagement rate" Benefits Salary range: $73,500 - $100,00 annually Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial premium coverage for dependents) Contributions to 401k funds Bi-annual reviews, and annual pay increases Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership Quarterly team-building events At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc. This position offers a competitive base salary between $125,000 - $130,000 , based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to $135,000 - $150,000 when performance objectives are achieved. What You'll Do Own and evolve the overall product marketing strategy, including positioning, messaging architecture, and go-to-market plans across all platform modules and buyer segments Oversee market and competitive research initiatives to inform segmentation, persona development, pricing strategy, and long-term product roadmap alignment Drive alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership on strategy, messaging, and priorities—escalating and resolving conflicts to accelerate execution Establish and oversee key performance indicators across product marketing activities, including pipeline influence, win rates, competitive win/loss analysis, and customer satisfaction metrics Develop comprehensive customer advocacy programs, including advisory boards, case studies, testimonials, and customer reference networks that amplify our market presence Lead the creation and evolution of high-impact customer and prospect-facing assets—positioning documents, competitive battlecards, sales enablement materials, website content, videos, and thought leadership Own sales enablement strategy and execution, ensuring sales teams have the insights, messaging, and tools to effectively communicate value to different buyer personas and use cases Represent Coursedog as a thought leader and spokesperson at industry events, conferences, analyst briefings, and speaking engagements, often including presentations Establish and nurture relationships with industry analysts, press, and key opinion leaders to shape market perception and third-party credibility Onsite travel for conferences and events expected 20% throughout the year Leverage AI and emerging technologies to enhance product marketing efficiency and effectiveness—from market research and content creation to competitive analysis and customer insights Requirements What You'll Bring 3-5 years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or strategic role. Deep expertise in market research, competitive analysis, buyer persona development, and segmentation methodologies Demonstrated ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging that resonates across multiple audiences and personas Strong strategic thinking combined with execution excellence—able to set vision while rolling up sleeves to deliver high-quality assets Experience driving sales enablement, working directly with sales teams, and measuring impact on pipeline and revenue outcomes Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior leadership across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success Excellent communication and storytelling skills—comfortable presenting to executives, customers, and external audiences internally and externally at conferences Experience with SaaS pricing strategy, packaging, or go-to-market launches Knowledge of or passion for the higher education market or complex B2B enterprise software environments An empathetic, curious mindset paired with strong business acumen and ownership mentality Experience using AI tools and technologies effectively to drive productivity and creativity in marketing strategy, content development, and cross-functional collaboration Not sure if you should apply? jobs.title: Gestionnaire du marketing de croissance | Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Position Summary As Growth Marketing Manager at Sadie, you will be responsible for figuring out how Sadie earns attention and turns that attention into growth. We are looking for someone with exceptional creative instincts, a strong personal point of view, and the ability to turn ideas into campaigns, content, and experiences that people want to engage with. You should care deeply about the quality of what you put into the world. We don't want generic B2B marketing, content from a corporate template, or AI slop. We expect you to embrace AI and new creative tools to explore more ideas, move faster, and push what a small marketing team can produce. AI should increase your creative ambition, not replace your taste. You will work closely with management, sales, product, and customers to understand what makes Sadie different and find creative ways to make the market care. Combine taste, creativity, experimentation, and commercial thinking to build a growth engine that is distinctly Sadie. Values Exceptional creative taste and attention to detail High ownership and bias toward action Commercially minded and outcome-focused Curious and experimental Willing to challenge mediocre work Obsessed with understanding what resonates with people What You'll Be Doing Make Sadie Impossible to Ignore Develop campaigns, content, creative concepts, and experiences that make Sadie stand out in a crowded technology market. Find interesting ways to tell Sadie's story without generic B2B SaaS marketing. Build a distinctive voice and creative identity across everything we put into the market. Turn product launches, customer stories, hospitality insights, company moments, and product improvements into things worth talking about. Develop ideas that travel across social, paid, email, events, sales, partnerships, and other channels. Create, Not Coordinate This is a hands-on role. Take ideas through to execution without relying on an agency or a large team. Write campaigns, create concepts, produce videos, build landing pages, develop ad creative, interview customers, turn customer results into stories, and launch experiments. We care much more about what you can create than how many people you can coordinate. Use AI Without Looking Like You Used AI Use AI to research, brainstorm, prototype, write, design, edit, analyze, automate, and increase experimentation. Finished work must feel intentional, original, human, and unmistakably ours. Bring the judgement to distinguish interesting work from polished garbage, and use these tools to extend your creativity rather than substitute for ideas. Find What Resonates Understand hospitality operators: what they care about, what frustrates them, and what gets their attention. Spend time with customers, sales, and product so marketing reflects how people actually talk. Experiment with messaging, formats, channels, audiences, and creative concepts. Bring influences from culture, technology, hospitality, media, and the internet into Sadie's communication. Develop a strong instinct for which ideas deserve to exist. Turn Attention Into Growth Build campaigns that generate qualified opportunities and pipeline. Experiment with paid, organic, outbound, partnerships, events, content, and unconventional acquisition channels. Work closely with sales on target accounts, campaigns, messaging, and follow-up. Improve the journey from attention to conversation to customer. Track which ideas, campaigns, and channels influence pipeline and revenue. Build the Playbook Treat growth as a continuous series of experiments: form hypotheses, get ideas into market quickly, measure, and learn. Stop what isn't working and turn successful approaches into repeatable systems. Constantly look for new ways Sadie can earn attention and reach hospitality operators. Why This Role Matters Sadie is building something fundamentally new for hospitality. This role turns customer outcomes, product capabilities, hospitality culture, company personality, and great ideas into something the market notices — turning creativity into attention, attention into demand, and demand into growth. You will have significant freedom to experiment across content, creative, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, social, outbound, and new formats while working directly with management, sales, product, and customers. What You Bring 4+ years of experience in growth marketing, creative marketing, content, brand, demand generation, or a related role. A portfolio that demonstrates strong creative judgement. Excellent writing and storytelling ability. Strong visual and creative instincts, even without formal design training. A distinct point of view about what makes marketing good or bad. Experience personally creating and launching campaigns, rather than simply briefing others. Comfort experimenting across different mediums, formats, and channels. Strong understanding of how creative work connects to acquisition, conversion, pipeline, and revenue. Experience using modern AI and creative tools to increase the speed and ambition of your work. Strong analytical instincts and the ability to learn from performance without allowing dashboards to replace judgement. Ability to operate independently and turn loosely defined objectives into real work. Willingness to try ideas that might not work and recognize when work isn't good enough. Pluses Experience building a brand or growth function from an early stage. Content that has earned meaningful organic distribution. Experience with video, design, social, events, or other creative mediums. Experience marketing B2B technology. Experience in hospitality, restaurants, hotels, or other culturally driven industries. Campaigns for enterprise or multi-location customers. Developing a founder or executive voice alongside a company brand. Deep familiarity with emerging creative and AI tools. A strong interest in understanding what works on the internet. Personal Fit Strong opinions about advertising, brands, content, design, writing, and the internet; an eye for genuinely great work; and excitement about AI's creative possibilities alongside high standards for originality and quality. About the Team Sadie is building something fundamentally new for hospitality. This role works directly with management, sales, product, and customers to understand hospitality operators and translate customer outcomes, product capabilities, and company personality into marketing that earns attention and drives growth. The role is part of a small marketing team with a hands-on approach, high ownership, strong creative standards, and significant freedom to experiment. The team values exceptional creative taste, attention to detail, curiosity, commercial thinking, and a willingness to challenge mediocre work. AI and modern creative tools support ambitious experimentation across content, paid acquisition, events, partnerships, social, outbound, and new formats. _______________________________________________________________________________________________ Sommaire du poste À titre de gestionnaire, marketing de croissance chez Sadie, vous aurez la responsabilité de déterminer comment Sadie capte l'attention et transforme cette attention en croissance. Nous cherchons une personne dotée d'un flair créatif exceptionnel, d'un point de vue personnel affirmé et de la capacité de transformer des idées en campagnes, en contenus et en expériences auxquels les gens ont envie de participer. La qualité de ce que vous mettez au monde doit vous tenir profondément à cœur. Nous ne voulons pas de marketing B2B générique, de contenu calqué sur un gabarit corporatif ni de contenu bâclé généré par l'IA. Nous nous attendons à ce que vous adoptiez l'IA et les nouveaux outils créatifs pour explorer plus d'idées, avancer plus rapidement et repousser les limites de ce qu'une petite équipe marketing peut produire. L'IA doit accroître votre ambition créative, et non remplacer votre jugement. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle afin de comprendre ce qui distingue Sadie et de trouver des façons créatives d'intéresser le marché. Vous allierez goût, créativité, expérimentation et sens des affaires pour bâtir un moteur de croissance résolument à l'image de Sadie. Valeurs Goût créatif exceptionnel et souci du détail Grand sens des responsabilités et propension à l'action Sens des affaires et orientation vers les résultats Curiosité et goût de l'expérimentation Volonté de remettre en question le travail médiocre Passion pour comprendre ce qui résonne auprès des gens Ce que vous ferez Rendre Sadie impossible à ignorer Concevoir des campagnes, des contenus, des concepts créatifs et des expériences qui font ressortir Sadie dans un marché technologique saturé. Trouver des façons intéressantes de raconter l'histoire de Sadie, sans recourir au marketing SaaS B2B générique. Bâtir une voix et une identité créative distinctives dans tout ce que nous mettons en marché. Transformer les lancements de produits, les témoignages de la clientèle, les tendances du secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration, les moments marquants de l'entreprise et les améliorations du produit en sujets dont on a envie de parler. Développer des idées qui voyagent d'un canal à l'autre : médias sociaux, publicité payante, courriel, événements, ventes, partenariats et autres. Créer, et non coordonner Il s'agit d'un rôle très concret. Vous mènerez les idées jusqu'à leur exécution, sans dépendre d'une agence ni d'une grande équipe : rédiger des campagnes, créer des concepts, produire des vidéos, monter des pages de destination, concevoir des créatifs publicitaires, interviewer des clients, transformer leurs résultats en histoires et lancer des expérimentations. Ce que vous êtes capable de créer nous importe bien davantage que le nombre de personnes que vous pouvez coordonner. Utiliser l'IA sans que cela paraisse Servez-vous de l'IA pour faire de la recherche, générer des idées, prototyper, rédiger, concevoir, réviser, analyser, automatiser et multiplier les expérimentations. Le travail final doit paraître intentionnel, original, humain et incontestablement le nôtre. Ayez le jugement nécessaire pour distinguer le travail réellement intéressant de la camelote bien polie, et servez-vous de ces outils pour prolonger votre créativité plutôt que pour remplacer vos idées. Trouver ce qui résonne Comprendre les exploitants du secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration : ce qui compte pour eux, ce qui les frustre et ce qui attire leur attention. Passer du temps avec la clientèle, les ventes et le produit pour que le marketing reflète la façon dont les gens s'expriment réellement. Expérimenter avec les messages, les formats, les canaux, les auditoires et les concepts créatifs. Puiser des influences dans la culture, la technologie, l'hôtellerie et la restauration, les médias et Internet pour nourrir la communication de Sadie. Développer un instinct sûr pour reconnaître les idées qui méritent d'exister. Transformer l'attention en croissance Bâtir des campagnes qui génèrent des occasions d'affaires qualifiées et alimentent le pipeline de ventes. Expérimenter avec la publicité payante, le référencement organique, la prospection sortante, les partenariats, les événements, le contenu et des canaux d'acquisition non conventionnels. Travailler étroitement avec les ventes sur les comptes ciblés, les campagnes, les messages et les relances. Améliorer le parcours qui mène de l'attention à la conversation, puis à la clientèle. Assurer le suivi des idées, des campagnes et des canaux qui influencent le pipeline et les revenus. Bâtir nos façons de faire Aborder la croissance comme une série continue d'expérimentations : formuler des hypothèses, mettre rapidement les idées en marché, mesurer et apprendre. Cesser ce qui ne fonctionne pas et transformer les approches gagnantes en systèmes reproductibles. Chercher constamment de nouvelles façons pour Sadie de capter l'attention et de rejoindre les exploitants du secteur. Pourquoi ce rôle est important Sadie crée quelque chose de fondamentalement nouveau pour le secteur de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration. Ce rôle transforme les résultats obtenus par la clientèle, les capacités du produit, la culture du secteur, la personnalité de l'entreprise et les bonnes idées en quelque chose que le marché remarque — en convertissant la créativité en attention, l'attention en demande et la demande en croissance. Vous disposerez d'une grande liberté pour expérimenter en matière de contenu, de création, d'acquisition payante, d'événements, de partenariats, de médias sociaux, de prospection sortante et de nouveaux formats, tout en travaillant directement avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle. Ce que vous apportez Au moins 4 ans d'expérience en marketing de croissance, en marketing créatif, en contenu, en marque, en génération de la demande ou dans un rôle connexe. Un portfolio qui démontre un solide jugement créatif. D'excellentes aptitudes en rédaction et en narration. De forts instincts visuels et créatifs, même sans formation officielle en design. Un point de vue affirmé sur ce qui distingue un bon marketing d'un mauvais. De l'expérience dans la création et le lancement de campagnes par vous-même, plutôt que dans la simple rédaction de briefs confiés à d'autres. De l'aisance à expérimenter avec différents médiums, formats et canaux. Une bonne compréhension du lien entre le travail créatif et l'acquisition, la conversion, le pipeline et les revenus. De l'expérience avec les outils d'IA et de création modernes pour accroître la vitesse et l'ambition de votre travail. De solides réflexes analytiques et la capacité d'apprendre de la performance sans laisser les tableaux de bord remplacer le jugement. La capacité de travailler de façon autonome et de transformer des objectifs vaguement définis en travail concret. La volonté d'essayer des idées qui pourraient ne pas fonctionner et de reconnaître quand le travail n'est pas à la hauteur. Atouts Expérience de la mise sur pied d'une marque ou d'une fonction de croissance à un stade précoce. Du contenu ayant obtenu une distribution organique significative. Expérience en vidéo, en design, en médias sociaux, en événements ou dans d'autres médiums créatifs. Expérience du marketing de technologies B2B. Expérience dans l'hôtellerie, la restauration, l'hébergement ou d'autres secteurs à forte dimension culturelle. Campagnes destinées à des clients grande entreprise ou à des comptes multisites. Développement de la voix d'un fondateur ou d'un dirigeant en parallèle de la marque d'entreprise. Grande familiarité avec les outils créatifs et d'IA émergents. Un vif intérêt à comprendre ce qui fonctionne sur Internet. Affinité avec le rôle Des opinions bien arrêtées sur la publicité, les marques, le contenu, le design, la rédaction et Internet; un œil pour le travail véritablement remarquable; et de l'enthousiasme pour les possibilités créatives de l'IA, assorti d'exigences élevées en matière d'originalité et de qualité. À propos de l'équipe Sadie crée quelque chose de fondamentalement nouveau pour l'hôtellerie et la restauration. Ce rôle collabore directement avec la direction, les ventes, le produit et la clientèle afin de comprendre les exploitants du secteur et de traduire les résultats obtenus par la clientèle, les capacités du produit et la personnalité de l'entreprise en un marketing qui capte l'attention et stimule la croissance. Le poste s'inscrit dans une petite équipe marketing au fonctionnement très concret, marquée par un fort sens des responsabilités, des standards créatifs élevés et une grande liberté d'expérimentation. L'équipe valorise un goût créatif exceptionnel, le souci du détail, la curiosité, le sens des affaires et la volonté de remettre en question le travail médiocre. Strong knowledge of AI Search (AEO), modern SEO, and evolving discovery ecosystems. Advanced data analytical skills with expertise in attribution modeling, performance tracking, and ROI optimization Personal Attributes: Highly responsive, execution-oriented leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and rapid change. jobs.title: Amazon PPC/DSP Specialist
jobs.description: Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that handles e-commerce operations for brands across major retail channels. They specialize in catalog management, content, retail operations, and advertising on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and Target Plus. Their AI Agentic Commerce practice builds proprietary tooling for optimized performance. About the Company The company manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work. Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance. The Role Advertising Analysts run the accounts. This is the seat where the work actually happens. Analysts own the day-to-day management of advertising for a set of client brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and Target Plus — building campaigns, managing bids and budgets, adjusting targeting, watching pacing, and finding the changes that move performance. Their manager sets the strategy and the media plan; they make it real in the platform, and they are the first person to know when something isn't working. This is an individual contributor role, but it isn't a heads-down one. Analysts work directly with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness — inventory, catalog, promotions, detail page quality — and with the Design Team on creative for Sponsored Brands, video, and display. Advertising in these channels doesn't perform in isolation, and analysts who understand that make better recommendations than analysts who only look at ad reports. Analysts also do a meaningful amount of thinking, not just executing. They run account audits, dig into search term and placement data to find waste and opportunity, build the analysis behind quarterly and annual business reviews, and prepare the decks their manager presents to client leadership. Where they see a better answer than the plan calls for, the company wants to hear it. The company expects analysts to use AI in their work. The team uses AI for report analysis, bulk file preparation, keyword and search term work, audit drafting, and internal tooling. They don't need to be an engineer, but they should be comfortable working with AI tools and interested in using them to get through the mechanical parts of the job faster so they can spend more time on the parts that require judgment. This role is a path to account and strategy ownership. The analysts who do it well are the people the company promotes. What You'll Own Campaign management and optimization: Build, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP campaigns, plus their Walmart Connect and Target Roundel equivalents. Manage bids, budgets, negatives, placement modifiers, and dayparting against agreed targets. Keep pacing on plan and flag risk before it becomes a shortfall. Keyword, targeting, and audience work: Research and build keyword and product targeting sets, mine search term reports for new opportunity and wasted spend, and maintain clean negative structures. Support audience building and testing in DSP. Analysis: Pull and interrogate the data yourself — search term, placement, product-level, and business reports — and turn it into a recommendation rather than a summary. Understand why a number moved, not just that it did. Account audits: Perform structured audits on new and existing accounts: campaign architecture, targeting overlap, budget allocation, wasted spend, missed placements, and gaps between what the account is doing and what the strategy calls for. Write up findings clearly enough that someone else can act on them. Client reporting and business reviews: Build the reporting that keeps clients informed, and prepare the analysis and decks for quarterly and annual business reviews. Your work goes in front of client leadership, so it needs to be accurate, clear, and defensible. AI-assisted workflows: Use AI tools to speed up analysis, bulk file work, keyword processing, and documentation. Contribute to improving how the team works rather than just following the process you were handed. Collaboration: Partner with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and the Design Team on creative. Raise the constraints — inventory, catalog, pricing, page quality — that advertising can't fix on its own. What You Bring Required 2+ years hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns Amazon Ads certification in Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP (both required; verified) Experience with Amazon DSP campaign management, not just Sponsored Ads Genuinely analytical: comfortable in large data sets, can build your own analysis in Excel or Sheets, and check your own math Intellectual curiosity: want to know why something happened, and keep pulling the thread after the immediate question is answered Strong written and verbal communication: can explain a performance change in plain language and write findings a client can read Proficiency working with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows Detail discipline: bulk uploads, naming conventions, and negatives done right the first time Preferred Walmart Sponsored Ads and Walmart DSP certification Meta and TikTok ads experience, with certifications Target Roundel experience SQL, Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, or Amazon Marketing Cloud exposure Agency or multi-brand experience across categories Advanced Excel; Python or scripting a plus Familiarity with retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions Who Does Well Here The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The analysts who do well here treat a bad week as something to diagnose rather than defend, and would rather find the problem themselves than be told about it. The company also looks for ownership (escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (would rather be corrected than confidently wrong), care about accuracy, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it. What Success Looks Like 30 days: Managing daily optimizations on your accounts with light supervision, and you know each brand's structure, targets, and constraints. 90 days: Running your accounts independently, delivering audits and reporting your manager doesn't have to rewrite, and surfacing recommendations rather than waiting for direction. 12 months: Your accounts show measurable improvement you can explain, you're trusted in front of clients, and you've improved at least one thing about how the team works. How to Stand Out Come ready to walk through one account you improved — what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

Capacidad para trabajar con presupuestos publicitarios y optimizar la inversión de acuerdo con los resultados. Buen entendimiento de funnels de conversión y customer journey. Acompañar la expansión del negocio desde Perú hacia Latinoamérica . This person will own onsite merchandising and integrated marketing across Envelopes.com, JAM Paper, and Folders.com, while helping build and lead the merchandising capability behind those brands. You will be accountable for how customers discover, navigate, evaluate, and purchase from a large, complex catalog with a long tail of SKUs. You will translate commercial priorities into a better Shopify experience, stronger merchandising, coordinated campaigns, and measurable improvements in conversion, average order value, retention, and revenue. Deep, hands-on Shopify experience is essential. You must be comfortable personally working in Shopify while also setting direction, leading a team, and partnering effectively with developers, designers, analytics, lifecycle marketing, paid media, customer service, and sales. Personally work in Shopify to manage and troubleshoot collections, catalogs, navigation, onsite search, product detail pages, landing pages, promotions, product data, metafields and metaobjects, apps, and theme configuration. Translate business and merchandising needs into clear requirements for developers and agencies, and distinguish what the business team can execute directly from what requires technical support. Establish scalable Shopify operating standards across multiple brands so routine merchandising and campaign changes can be made quickly, accurately, and with minimal dependency on developers. Identify friction in product discovery and the purchase journey, prioritize improvements, and ensure changes are implemented and measured. Merchandising Strategy and Team Leadership Build, lead, and develop a high-performing ecommerce merchandising team with clear ownership, workflows, standards, and performance expectations. Create a merchandising strategy for complex product categories and a long tail of SKUs, balancing high-volume products, strategic categories, seasonal demand, inventory priorities, and emerging opportunities. Own taxonomy, category structure, collections, filters, attributes, product relationships, cross-sells, bundles, recommendations, and other product-discovery levers. Develop repeatable processes for product launches, category refreshes, promotional merchandising, and ongoing catalog optimization across three brands. Use customer behavior, search data, conversion performance, inventory, margin, and commercial priorities to determine what products and categories receive prominence. Partner with product-data, operations, and technology teams to improve catalog quality and resolve data issues that affect discoverability or conversion. Integrated Marketing and Commercial Calendar Own the integrated ecommerce marketing and merchandising calendar across Envelopes.com, JAM Paper, and Folders.com. Turn growth priorities into coordinated campaigns across website merchandising, email and lifecycle marketing, landing pages, paid-media creative, promotions, and product launches. Ensure each initiative has a clear customer insight, commercial objective, success metric, owner, timeline, and post-launch learning plan. Raise the quality of campaigns beyond checkbox marketing by improving relevance, segmentation, creative clarity, and the connection between onsite experience and outbound messaging. Maintain a high execution standard while making thoughtful tradeoffs when priorities or resources change. Customer Growth, Retention, and Experimentation Develop hypotheses based on customer behavior and design fast, practical experiments to validate them before scaling. Improve how we acquire customers, convert first-time buyers into repeat customers, reactivate lapsed customers, and grow long-term value. jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description: Who We Are Akkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies. Our platform currently reduces manual work by up to 90% and costs by as much as 50%, while improving accuracy and governance across leading Unified Communications platforms. This ability to innovate at scale defines who we are: big enough to compete at the highest level, yet agile enough to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving market. Our culture is people-first, fully remote, and rooted in grit, clarity, trust and respect, because when our people thrive, so do our customers. Who You Are You thrive in complex B2B environments, driving demand through Account-Based Marketing - direct enterprise channels and, through partner ecosystems including authorized resellers, service providers, and integration partners. You understand how to build scalable partner-led programs, co-marketing motions, and joint pipeline engines that create predictable demand. You bring rigor to how pipeline gets built, working backward from the ARR target to determine how much qualified pipeline needs to be in motion at any given time, and you hold yourself accountable to that math. You dig into account and funnel data regularly, not just to report on it, but to catch where deals are stalling and bring sales clear, specific recommendations on what to do next. You care as much about clean, standardized data (HubSpot lifecycle stages, attribution, partner association) as you do about the campaigns themselves, because you know unreliable data undermines every decision built on top of it. Equal parts analyst and operator, you turn every dollar of spend into measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer impact. Core Responsibilities Marketing & Campaign Management Build, manage, and continuously refine orchestrated, account-based and partner-based campaign sequencing, integrated end-to-end (email, LinkedIn, partner, events, sales follow-up), that proves out the account-based, partner-led model and establishes a repeatable template for future campaigns. Lead multi-channel demand generation marketing (SEM, paid social, programmatic, retargeting, affiliates) to drive leads, pipeline, and revenue. Ensure we are focused on the right accounts, and the right people in them. Maintain and update ICP inclusion/exclusion criteria; continuously rescore and prioritize Tier 1–3 accounts to concentrate high-touch effort on a manageable, well-defined set. Maintain and continually update buying committee maps across target accounts (economic, technical, operational, security, procurement, and champion roles), ensuring key contacts across those roles are identified and actively engaged for all Tier 1–2 accounts. Own the account-level funnel (ICP → Target → Engaged → MQA → SAA → Qualified Opportunity → Pipeline → Closed-Won) as the core measurement framework for demand generation performance. Continuously analyze account and funnel data to identify where accounts are stalling or losing momentum, and proactively bring findings and recommended next actions to sales to keep opportunities moving. Activate partners as a primary route to market, not a channel. Establish partner prioritization criteria based on ICP alignment, account access, and willingness to execute; maintain a ranked view of highest-value partners. Maintain and continually update the mapping of priority partners to target accounts, determining, account by account, whether activity is Akkadian-led, partner-led, or joint. Track and report partner-sourced versus partner-influenced pipeline as a standing metric, distinct from general partner activity. Develop and execute partner-led demand generation programs with authorized resellers and integration partners, including co-marketing campaigns, MDF utilization, webinars, and joint events. Build scalable partner enablement and activation workflows, including partner-specific messaging, playbooks, landing pages, nurture streams, and analytics dashboards to measure partner pipeline contribution. Backsolve pipeline from the ARR target and make it measurable. Standardize HubSpot data structure and attribution, including lifecycle stage, source, persona, tier, and partner association, distinguishing sourced from influenced contribution; collaborate with Sales on UTM hygiene and offline conversion tracking. Run the weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating cadence that reports progress against the account-level funnel and pipeline targets. Leadership Responsibilities Supervise the Marketing Coordinator, setting clear goals and regularly measuring progress against them. Provide ongoing feedback and coaching and conduct formal performance reviews on Akkadian's standard cadence. Support the Marketing Coordinator's development by identifying growth opportunities and building toward increased ownership over time. Supporting Responsibilities Develop messaging and assets that resonate with our ICP, using generative AI to accelerate ideas while safeguarding brand voice. Partner with leadership to review and reallocate budget for maximum ROI. Apply the latest tools to accelerate content, forecasting, segmentation, and spend optimization. Stay ahead of industry trends and explore AI-powered tools to keep our marketing stack efficient, insightful, and growth-focused. Optimize the website for SEO, UX, and conversion. Lead high-impact field and virtual events (e.g., Cisco Live, enterprise UC user groups), ensuring clear playbooks and ROI analysis. Meet KPIs including CAC, payback, pipeline coverage, lead-to-SQL conversion, and MQL velocity, delivering marketing insights weekly to leadership. Requirements Our Ideal Candidate has the following qualifications: 5+ years in B2B SaaS marketing with significant experience generating pipeline through partner-led go-to-market, including resellers, service providers, or system integrators. Demonstrated track record building partner co-marketing programs that produce measurable sourced or influenced revenue. Proven success scaling revenue and pipeline with clear KPI ownership. Experience building and maintaining ICP and account-tiering frameworks to focus go-to-market effort on the highest-value accounts. Experience running ABM, paid search/social, and lifecycle email programs, integrating intent data, predictive scoring, and AI-driven content. Familiarity with buying-committee mapping methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC) to identify and engage economic, technical, operational, security, procurement, and champion roles within target accounts. HubSpot fluency, including lifecycle stage tracking, attribution, and campaign management. Experience partnering directly with sales on funnel-stage and deal-level analysis, not just campaign reporting, to help identify stalled opportunities and recommend next steps. Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools including prompt libraries, AI-generated ad tests, predictive scoring, and forecasting. Fluency in growth metrics (CAC, LTV, NRR, ACV) and strong modeling skills. Strong storyteller and copywriter able to translate technical value into compelling campaigns. Certifications welcome: Google Analytics IQ, HubSpot Reporting, HubSpot Inbound/RevOps, 6sense Practitioner, Prompt Engineering. Bachelor’s degree appreciated, but proven performance, demand generation expertise, and adaptability matter most. Benefits We offer a fully remote environment, plus a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance and disability policies, 401(k) with a generous matching program, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager

Benefits WHY JOIN US: • Join a global aviation software group with a collaborative and innovative culture. • Work fully remotely within the UK with a supportive international team. • Opportunities for career growth in a fast-scaling environment. • Exposure to modern marketing technologies and high-impact projects. #Commsoft
