jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description: FMX is looking for a strategic, execution-minded Director of Product Marketing to lead our product marketing function and serve as the connective tissue across product, engineering, sales, and demand generation. In this role, you'll set the vision for how FMX communicates complex platform value to the market while managing and developing a team of product marketing managers. You'll partner with leaders across the go-to-market and product organizations to make sure positioning, technical feature launches, and enablement translate directly into pipeline and revenue. Responsibilities: As the Director of Product Marketing, you will: Own the strategic direction for product marketing, establishing product positioning, technical messaging, and launch frameworks that align product, sales, and marketing around one go-to-market motion. Lead, coach, and grow a team of product marketing managers, building a technical PMM function that scales alongside FMX's platform roadmap and growth goals. Serve as the primary connector between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation, ensuring GTM plans have clear ownership, timelines, and shared accountability across teams. Lead market research into FMX’s target segments to define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), build technical buyer personas (including facilities, operations, and IT leaders), perform Total Addressable Market (TAM) analysis, and provide targeting guidance for our GTM teams. Set the standard for how FMX plans and executes go-to-market launches for core platform capabilities and integrations, from early positioning through post-launch product adoption and retention. Direct ongoing competitive analysis, feature benchmarking, and market research to sharpen FMX's technical differentiation and inform product and sales strategy at the leadership level. Ensure the sales organization has the technical messaging, collateral (like feature deep-dives, architecture overviews, and battlecards), and training needed to sell confidently, and measure enablement's impact on win rates and deal velocity. Represent product marketing in leadership conversations, translating technical product insights, user feedback, and market dynamics into clear, confident recommendations for the executive team. Define and report on KPIs that connect product marketing activity to feature usage, pipeline, revenue, and retention outcomes. Requirements Preferred Experience & Qualities: 10+ years in product marketing, including 5+ years leading or managing a product marketing team, preferably in B2B SaaS handling complex software or technical platforms. Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities, architecture, and integrations into clear value propositions for both business decision-makers and technical buyers (e.g., IT, operations). Familiarity with facilities management, education, or government is a plus. A confident, assertive communicator who can influence senior stakeholders and represent product marketing at the leadership table and with strategic prospects and customers. A track record of moving quickly from strategy to execution and driving urgency across cross-functional teams. Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product marketers into strong strategic partners with deep product fluency. Able to synthesize market, competitive, and product data into a clear point of view that shapes company strategy and product roadmaps. A track record of building trust and alignment across product, engineering, sales, and marketing leadership. Demonstrated success tracking and driving product marketing impact across both pipeline/revenue metrics and product metrics (e.g., feature adoption, usage retention). A match with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence and Integrity. The hiring process for this role: Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions below via the Workable portal Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc. Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the VP of Marketing and CSO. Product Leadership Conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the CPO and VP of Product. PMM Conversation: A 60-minute peer interview with the Product Marketing team. On-site Panel: A day in person with marketing, product, and sales leadership. Offer & Onboarding: Candidates who receive an offer will be required to complete a background check prior to onboarding. New hires are also expected to work onsite at our Columbus, OH office during their first week to complete onboarding and connect with the team in person. Benefits FMX Benefits and Life at FMX: You’ll make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our product and the future of our company. Competitive benefits: 100% company-paid health, dental, vision, long and short term disability, and life insurance. Work from home: At FMX, we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We host one all-company event a year to ensure that you can put a face to a name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and coworkers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator. Home office stipend: We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection. Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies: If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time? Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines. You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously. Compensation: This position offers a base salary, with additional bonus potential. 401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance. Other Considerations: The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US. Company: FMX was founded in Columbus, Ohio, and is a remote-first organization headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product, enabling our customers to streamline processes, increase asset productivity, and turn actionable insights into meaningful results. Serving education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets, FMX is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space! Check us out at: https://www.gofmx.com/ Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Teammate Handbook. FMX is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: VP, Marketing Operations and Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description: About the Role: Most marketing teams still measure output in campaigns shipped. We measure it in decisions our agents make autonomously, and we want to widen that gap. As VP, Marketing Operations & Agentic AI Systems, you will own the management of our martech stack and the strategy, architecture, and execution of the agentic layer that runs Sidetrade marketing: lead scoring, enrichment, prospection, campaign orchestration, and attribution. You will define what "production-ready" means for AI agents at Sidetrade, build and lead the team that ships them, and hold accountability for measurable business outcomes reported at board level. This is a builder-leader role. You will set the vision and roll up your sleeves. You will not manage a function that runs on slide decks. About Sidetrade: Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific. We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion : Aimie Video Requirements What You will do: Define and own the multi-year roadmap for AI-powered marketing operations, aligned to revenue targets and approved at exec level. Set the standard for what constitutes a production-grade agent at Sidetrade: Eevaluation suites, guardrails, observability, and retirement criteria. Advise the CMO and CEO on emerging AI capabilities and their commercial implications for pipeline and revenue. Lead delivery of Deliver production agents for lead scoring, enrichment, MQL handoff, prospection, and revenue attribution, co-owned with Sales, BDRs, and Demand Gen. Replace at least five manual marketing workflows with production agents in the first 18 months, with documented time savings and quality parity or better. Own prompt libraries, tool definitions, and evaluation suites that govern agent quality across the team. Stand up and own the observability layer: cost per task, accuracy, drift, human escalation rate. Report the performance of the agentic layer monthly to the exec team and quarterly to the board. Quantify pipeline and revenue influenced by AI-driven workflows; defend the numbers. Own and manage the Martech stack: Marketo, Salesforce, Salesloft, 6Sense, ZoomInfo, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, LetSignIt, Asana, Kinsta, GoToWebinar, Wistia, Google GTM, Search Console, Analytics, Ads, Zapier, Proofjump. Cut the stack by at least 25% on cost or tool count in the first 18 months against measurable value. Evaluate, onboard, and retire vendors. You hold final sign-off on Martech investment. Provide enablement to marketing and sales users in collaboration with the department leaders Hire, develop, and retain a team of marketing engineers and operations specialists. Define roles, set standards, and create a culture of measurement and continuous improvement. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to align shared infrastructure and tooling. What You Will Bring: 12+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role owning technology and operations. Proven track record shipping production AI-driven workflows or agents that real users and revenue processes depended on. Sandbox demos do not count. Deep fluency with Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot, plus Salesforce. You have owned these platforms at scale. Hands-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier: multi-step flows, error handling, API integrations without writing production code from scratch. Expert-level command of LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent): prompt design, AI-in-workflow architecture, and clear judgment on reliability limits. Able to scope work for engineering teams, spec clearly, and validate output. You read JSON and API docs fluently. Track record of board-level reporting on marketing technology performance and ROI. Strong communicator: you translate agentic complexity into commercial outcomes for exec and investor audiences. Benefits Competitive executive compensation package including base salary and performance incentives. Hybrid work model: a flexible mix of in-office and remote days. Health & wellness: medical coverage, life insurance, and wellness programs. Generous paid leave plus public holidays. Learning, mentorship, and career advancement support at exec level. Active Social Club with regular team events across our international offices.

jobs.title: Paid Search Strategist
jobs.salary: 🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 per year, based on experience.
jobs.description: QRY 101 Hey there! We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands. We connect brand awareness and performance media to unlock growth, use sophisticated data analytics, and employ a full-funnel marketing strategy to help brands reach their most valuable consumers. We’re a high‑performance, high‑ownership team that values candor, curiosity, and results. We love what we do and the people we do it with. We’re hiring a Paid Search Strategist to own search performance across a portfolio of clients. You’ll plan, launch, and optimize search and shopping programs (Google, Bing, YouTube, and other retail channels where relevant), keeping budgets/pacing tight and turning data into crisp decisions. You love the details, move with urgency, and explain complex ideas simply to teammates and clients. If you have experience leading and managing search / SEM budgets for retail and ecommerce brands, this could be a perfect position. Your day-to-day Search Strategy: You plan, book, and optimize paid search campaigns (i.e. Google AdWords, YouTube, Bing Ads, Amazon, etc) for 5-8 clients, utilizing available search planning tools to develop search plans. You strategize and implement A/B experiments to test keywords, bid strategies, ad copy, landing pages, offers, etc You advise on paid search strategies, rationales, and plans to meet client goals. You keep current on the latest trends in search, social media, mobile marketing, tracking and tagging, behavioral marketing, retargeting & addressability. With support from Associate Directors, you manage the channel's monthly reporting and strategy sessions with the client, owning overall communication for all channel initiatives. Performance : You scope, develop, and manage channel initiatives to consistently hit the goals for channels across all clients. You act as a strategic advisor and recommend strategic pivots to increase the channel's performance. Reporting + Forecasting: You enthusiastically present reports to clients, highlighting the performance of your channels, how they assisted other channels in the funnel, and how they affect the client's business, while recommending next steps. You complete a monthly forecast for respective channels based on budget and/or revenue goals. Cross Channel Strategy + Collaboration: You collaborate with the other media and creative agency team members to ensure the creative specifications of negotiated plans are met. You consistently identify cross-channel strategies / collaborations with clients to improve performance. You effectively communicate with clients on teams' capabilities and opportunities, and proactively offer solutions for ad hoc issues. How you win Channel performance: You hit agreed KPI targets for your channels (e.g., MER/ROAS, CAC/LTV, revenue, efficiency) within budget and platform guardrails. Learning velocity: You run a disciplined test program with documented hypotheses, win rate, rollout decisions, and measurable lift. Forecast accuracy: You run accurate forecasts on a monthly basis and tie expectations to realistic assumptions. Execution: You deliver decks, reports, and campaign launches with low error rates related to QA or data, and you ensure QRY quality is represented in every outcome. What’s it like here We’re a high‑performance culture with high support. We’re serious about setting clear goals, providing direct feedback, documenting our progress, and celebrating our wins. You’ll get real ownership, supportive teammates, and the tools to do excellent work. Your first month: You’ll build trust with client and internal partners, learn each brand’s goals and constraints, and align on how success will be measured. You’ll review current channel setups and performance at a high level and agree on priorities and near‑term wins. By the end of the month, you’ll have a good understanding of our clients, their channel setups, and how our pods work. After month one: You’ll own steady, predictable performance against plans and keep budgets and timelines on track. You’ll communicate often, surface risks early with options, and highlight opportunities for smart growth. The result is consistent delivery, fewer surprises, and clear momentum. Requirements ✍️​ Experience: You have 2-5 years of successful hands-on paid search or SEM experience, ideally in an agency environment. You know the ins and outs of making things run smoothly and have applied successful tactics in a previous role. 📚 Education: Ideally, you have a bachelor's degree in marketing, science, or in a related field. 🔢 Analytical Mindset: You're an analytical thinker. You have experience turning complex data into digestible reports, seeing the big picture, and breaking it down into an actionable plan that gets results. 💬​ Communication: Your communication skills are top-notch and you can communicate with senior stakeholders effectively and efficiently. ⌚ Time Management: You're a master of time management. You know how to juggle multiple tasks effectively. 🚀​ Industry Passion: The e-commerce, advertising, and agency space excite you. You're genuinely interested in these fields and eager to make an impact within them. 🧠​ Creative Problem Solver: When challenges arise, you're ready to jump in and troubleshoot with creative solutions. You enjoy tackling problems head-on and finding innovative ways to overcome them. 💡​ Continuous Learner: You have a genuine passion for learning. You stay updated with the latest trends in digital advertising and marketing, always expanding your knowledge base. 🖥️​ Remote Work Environment: You understand the importance of a clean and quiet work environment suitable for video conferencing. You respect digital etiquette and ensure smooth virtual collaboration. Benefits 🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 per year, based on experience. 💰 Quarterly bonuses. Enjoy quarterly bonuses tied to company revenue. 🏠 USA remote flexibility. Choose your ideal workspace, whether it’s your home office or a coffee shop. 🌴 Time off made easy. Take advantage of our unlimited PTO policy. 🏥 Comprehensive healthcare. We offer exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance, fully covered for employees by QRY. We also offer a $100 monthly budget for your wellbeing, i.e. gym memberships, coworking day pass, etc. 📈 Secure your future. Participate in our 401k program with a company match. 🌱 Growth and development. Nurture your learning and development with our investment to L&D, growth opportunities, and tools such as our Learning & Development Philosophy + Policy, role matrices, and skill assessments. 💻 Latest tech. Team members are provided with the latest Macbook Pro and a one-time $500 stipend to set up their at-home workspace. 🥳 Celebrate and connect. Join us for annual team retreats (we’ve been to Austin, Tennessee, and Utah to name a few), weekly Coffee Chats, and monthly Happy Hours to foster our vibrant culture.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter ). Our latest product is Calendar 2 , which just launched to rave reviews. Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable . We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks. Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us. About the Role: We're seeking an analytical, commercially-minded Growth Marketing Manager to own the paid acquisition P&L for new product launches. You'll set and defend CPA/MER targets, partner directly with New Business GMs on 0-1 go-to-market strategy, and build the creative testing engine that turns learnings into scalable spend. This is a high-autonomy, high-visibility seat where you're not running someone else's playbook, you're writing it. Responsibilities: Profitably scale paid search and social spend through rapid creative iteration for Calendar Ecosystem products while adhering to MER, CPA and Contribution targets Own the full acquisition unit economics model for new products from blended CPA and payback period to contribution margin and make scaling/pullback calls accordingly. Develop a high velocity creative testing plan that generates actionable business learnings and informs the future creative roadmap and product positioning Set creative strategy and testing hypotheses based on performance data and customer insight, briefing internal/agency creative partners and making the final call on what scales Work collaboratively with Product Marketing to test and validate new marketing angles based on customer research Manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, and bidding to maximize CPA efficiency Continuously monitor auction insights, impression share, and CPC trends to maintain competitiveness Use platform data, third-party tools, and site analytics to inform decisions beyond in-platform metrics Report key performance insights and make actionable recommendations that improve performance Requirements 6+ years owning paid acquisition for a DTC, subscription, or consumer product business Experience scaling a new product or business line from early traction to efficient scale (0-1 to 1-10), including navigating inventory, seasonality, or subscription dynamics. Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Product, Finance, and GM-level stakeholders on P&L tradeoffs, not just channel performance. Experience with briefing creative teams and presenting creative performance data Track record of scaling budgets while maintaining profitability and efficiency targets Strong grasp of performance metrics (MER, CPA, ROAS, CTR, Thumbstop) Familiarity with various marketing attribution methodologies such as MMM, MTA and incrementality Benefits Our competitive compensation package includes: Competitive Salary + Equity Package 401K matching Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work Unlimited PTO Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January) Equal opportunity employer Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board! We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately. For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $110k - 170k based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $110k - 170k based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing (US)
jobs.description: Location: Remote / Hybrid (open to candidates in the US, UK, EU, other global regions) Department: Marketing Reports to: CEO About the Role We're looking for a creative, resourceful, and commercially minded Head of Marketing to lead our global marketing function. This is a high-impact role for a builder who thrives in a fast-paced environment, knows how to generate demand at the enterprise level, and can do more with less in an era where AI is reshaping how marketing is done. You will own the full marketing engine, from brand and messaging to demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and modern visibility across search, LLMs, and social. What You'll Do Own demand generation strategy and execution, with a clear mandate to drive qualified pipeline from enterprise accounts. Build and scale integrated campaigns across digital, ABM, events, email, partner, and content channels. Lead product marketing, including positioning, messaging, launches, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement. Ensure brand and messaging consistency from the website through every customer touchpoint. Drive SEO and next-generation visibility, including optimization for LLMs and AI-powered search, to grow organic discovery and share of voice. Elevate brand presence on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and other social platforms with bold, creative storytelling. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to align on pipeline goals, ICP, and GTM motion. Build, mentor, and optimize a lean, high-output marketing team that leverages AI and automation to multiply impact. Own marketing analytics: pipeline contribution, CAC, funnel conversion, campaign ROI, and brand metrics. Requirements What We're Looking For 8+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, with 3+ years leading marketing teams, ideally selling into enterprise accounts. Proven track record of driving enterprise pipeline and measurable revenue impact. Strong product marketing chops: you can sharpen messaging, write crisp copy, and translate technical value into buyer-ready narratives. Deep expertise in SEO and emerging experience with LLM/AI search optimization (GEO, AEO). Creative operator who can launch campaigns quickly, test fast, and scale what works. Fluent in modern martech, AI tools, and marketing automation; comfortable building efficient systems that do more with less. Excellent communicator and cross-functional leader who partners naturally with Sales and Product. Comfortable operating in a global, distributed environment across time zones. Benefits Why Join Us Lead marketing for a fast-growing enterprise SaaS company with strong product-market fit. Shape the brand, the message, and the go-to-market motion from the top. Work with a lean, talented team that values creativity, ownership, and speed. Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits tailored to your region. To Apply Submit your resume along with a short note (or loom) describing a campaign you led that drove enterprise pipeline, one creative marketing idea you'd test in your first 90 days, how marketing should be in 2026.

jobs.title: Senior E-commerce Manager (Remote) | Canada
jobs.description: Location: Remote / Virtual Job Type: Full-Time At HireHawk , we connect top global talent with highperforming U.S. companies. Our focus is on finding exceptional professionals who bring both expertise and drive to every role. We’re passionate about helping candidates grow their careers while supporting our clients with reliable, remote-ready talent that makes an impact from day one. This role is for a strategic, hands-on e-commerce leader who can take full ownership of our Shopify site and build the digital commerce function from the ground up. You’ll partner closely with the Founder, auditing what exists today, defining what “great” looks like, and executing the roadmap to get us there. The first phase is not about throwing money at ads, it’s about fixing fundamentals: site experience, analytics, merchandising, conversion, and operations. As the foundation strengthens, you’ll help us scale into paid media and CRM thoughtfully, and build the right team and partner bench over time. Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end Shopify experience, from backend operations to the storefront experience and on-site performance Audit the current site, identify the highest-impact fixes, and turn them into a clear 30/60/90-day execution plan Improve conversion rate and revenue per visitor through CRO, funnel analysis, and disciplined experimentation Elevate on-site merchandising (collections, product pages, navigation, search, promotions) to increase AOV and conversion Build reliable analytics and reporting that make performance clear (what’s working, what’s not, and why) Create and manage a promotional and merchandising calendar that supports revenue goals without eroding brand value Improve catalog and inventory hygiene (product data, tags, collections, and operational accuracy) Manage cross-functional execution with designers, developers, copywriters, photographers/content teams, and other partners Vet, hire, and manage freelancers and agencies as needed — and build scalable processes as the function grows Define and track the KPIs that matter most for a profitable, scalable DTC channel Requirements Must-Have: 5+ years of e-commerce experience, with clear ownership of site performance and revenue outcomes Strong Shopify expertise (admin, catalog management, configurations, and third-party app/integration oversight) Proven ability to improve conversion through CRO, merchandising, and checkout/funnel optimization Strong analytics instincts: you know how to set up reporting, interpret behavior, and prioritize what moves the needle Experience working cross-functionally with creative and technical partners (design, dev, copy, photo/content, media/CRM) Comfortable operating in lean, entrepreneurial environments where you lead and execute (especially in the early stages) Experience reporting directly to founders Fashion/apparel DTC experience with ownership of a brand site or meaningful revenue responsibility Based in Canada, with the ability to overlap working hours with North American time zones Nice to Have: Experience rebuilding or modernizing an under-optimized Shopify store (especially mobile experience and conversion infrastructure) CRM/email experience (strategy, segmentation, lifecycle flows) and/or experience scaling paid media after foundations are in place Familiarity with AI tools that support creative workflows, photography enhancement, or digital merchandising Benefits Access to a $200K+ perk marketplace with discounts on 150+ global services. Option to withdraw up to 50% of approved earnings before payday.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (China)
jobs.description: The Company Our client is a fast-growing D2C longevity/wellness startup. Their founding team came together around a shared commitment: to enable everyday people to access clean, high quality supplements with transparent ingredients based on the latest scientific insights in rapidly growing field of longevity. Our client takes great care in selecting only high quality ingredients from reputable sources and in a rare move for the supplement industry transparently publishes the supplier of each ingredient used on its website. All supplements are also double tested for purity and against contamination in an independent 3d party lab. The Role Our client is looking for a self-driven, highly motivated Performance Marketing Manager to be the architect of their digital marketing in China. Reporting directly to the Head of China Business, you'll operate within a highly lean, fast-moving global structure with the autonomy to build, own, and scale their performance marketing capabilities. The science of longevity is a global revolution, and our client is looking for a pioneering Performance Marketing Manager to drive their digital expansion in China. By building and optimizing our growth engine across China, you will directly empower millions to take control of their healthspan and age on their own terms. Responsibilities Establish and execute a robust in-house performance marketing strategy across major Chinese platforms (Douyin, RedNote, Tmall, JD.com), managing the channel mix across paid ads, KOL partnerships, and livestreaming. Ensure our scientific messaging translates flawlessly and resonates deeply across all localized touchpoints, to preserve our client’s premium Swiss positioning. Collaborate with our local Trading Partner for operational smoothness, inventory alignment, and high-impact execution during major campaign cycles (e.g. 6.18 and 11.11 campaigns). Conduct market research and benchmarking to identify emerging consumer trends, monitor competitor activities, and unlock new insights for optimization in the Chinese market. Continuously analyze campaign performance, customer acquisition costs, and performance marketing funnel metrics to optimize ROI and scale growth efficiently. Requirements Our client is looking for a proactive self-starter who blends analytical rigor with deep cultural market insight. Based in China and able to work in office 2-3 days per week. You possess deep, hands-on expertise in China's digital ecosystem , including ads management, livestreaming strategies, and influencer networks on Douyin, RedNote, Tmall, and JD.com. Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree with strong analytical background. 2-5 years of high-impact performance marketing experience, ideally within a fast-growing D2C brand, e-commerce, or health-tech startup. jobs.title: Brand & Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Aspire Software’s Hospitality Vertical , home to the trusted roommaster brand, is seeking a creative and strategic Brand & Content Marketing Manager to drive brand growth, storytelling, and marketing impact across all channels. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing and play a key role in shaping how our hospitality brands communicate globally. Leading a network of writers, freelancers, and creative partners, you’ll develop and execute content and campaign strategies that bring our hospitality technology to life for hoteliers worldwide . This role is ideal for a fast learner who thrives in a dynamic environment—someone willing to wear multiple hats, roll up their sleeves, and take ownership from strategy to execution. You’ll combine creativity with data, leveraging HubSpot, AI tools , and emerging marketing technologies to drive awareness, engagement, and measurable results. What You’ll Do Strategy & Planning Develop and execute the brand and content strategy to support Aspire’s hospitality GTM objectives. Align content and brand campaigns with product launches, lead generation initiatives, and customer engagement goals. Collaborate across marketing to ensure content supports all campaigns and GTM motions. Brand & Content Creation Manage the creation, review, and publishing of all content types — including ebooks, lead magnets, blogs, PR articles, email campaigns, case studies, website copy, and social media posts. Work with freelancers, agencies, and internal teams to ensure brand tone and product accuracy in every asset. Maintain cohesive brand messaging and visual standards across all channels. Campaign Management Plan and execute brand-driven campaigns — including product GTMs, webinars, customer storytelling, and partnership initiatives. Coordinate campaign assets, ensure on-time execution, and oversee distribution through HubSpot and other channels. Champion innovation and experimentation in campaign execution, exploring AI-generated content, automation, and emerging formats. Reporting & Optimization Measure and analyze campaign performance using HubSpot Marketing Hub, Google Analytics, and other reporting tools (such as Looker Studio or Power BI). Present post-campaign insights with actionable recommendations to improve engagement and ROI. Track and optimize content performance metrics to guide future strategy. Requirements A strategic B2B marketer with 5–8 years of experience in SaaS marketing Hotel technology background or experience is an added advantage. Experienced in content strategy, brand management, and campaign execution. Hands-on with HubSpot Marketing Hub Familiar with Google Analytics, Surfer SEO, Ahrefs, and Webflow (content publishing). Strong in leadership and communication, capable of managing freelancers, agencies, and multiple stakeholders with clarity and confidence. Knowledge of Zapier for automation and Salesforce CRM / Account Engagement (Pardot) is a plus. A fast learner who adapts quickly, embraces new tools, and executes with ownership. Organized, proactive, and results-oriented.

jobs.title: Marketing Resource Manager
jobs.salary: Competitive salary commensurate with your experience and impact from $2,000 to $4,000 USD/month
jobs.description: The Opportunity: We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Marketing Resource Manager to become the operational backbone of our client campaigns. This role is for a natural leader who excels at the intersection of project management, client strategy, and marketing execution. You will be the strategic linchpin for our campaign delivery, ensuring all moving parts—from SEO and content to creative and client services—are perfectly synchronized and optimized for success. We are looking for a dedicated professional who values ownership and results over clock-watching, and understands that in a fast-growing company, excellence comes from productivity, not rigid schedules. What You'll Do: Campaign & Resource Management: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated marketing campaigns (SEO, Content, Social, etc.), from strategic planning and resource allocation to final reporting. Manage the allocation and scheduling of our marketing team (SEO specialists, strategists, copywriters, designers), ensuring optimal workload distribution and project flow. Drive project timelines using tools like monday.com, proactively identifying risks and removing roadblocks to ensure on-time delivery. Strategic Account Management: Serve as a trusted marketing advisor to our clients, translating their business objectives into actionable marketing strategies and project plans. Lead key client communications, facilitating strategic discussions, managing expectations, and building lasting partnerships based on performance and trust. Cross-Functional Team Leadership: Act as the central point of communication, ensuring seamless collaboration between our SEO, Content, Developers and Paid Media teams. Facilitate strategic planning sessions and internal briefings to ensure the entire team is aligned on campaign goals and execution plans. Ensure all creative and content deliverables are on-brand, high-quality, and strategically sound before they reach the client. Requirements Who We're Looking For: A Strategic Thinker & An Operational Expert: You can see the big picture of a client's business goals and can build and manage the detailed project plan to get there. Data-Informed & Creatively-Minded: You respect the data and use it to guide decisions, but you also have a strong sense of brand and storytelling that helps you to understand the decision makers strategies. A Master Orchestrator: You excel at bringing different specialists together (SEO, content, design) to work as a cohesive and effective unit. Your organizational skills are legendary. An Expert Relationship Builder & Diplomat: Demonstrates strong diplomacy and relationship management skills, with a talent for managing diverse and high-performing personalities effectively. An Agile Builder: Thrives in the building phase of a company's growth and possesses the agility to make quick pivots as priorities evolve. Adaptable & Versatile: You have experience across various industries and can quickly grasp the marketing challenges and opportunities within new client verticals. Client-Obsessed: You are dedicated to client success and have a proven ability to build strong, collaborative relationships. Skills & Qualifications: 5+ years of professional experience in marketing project management, account management, or marketing operations, preferably within a digital agency setting. Demonstrable experience managing integrated digital marketing campaigns (SEO, content marketing, social media, etc.). Expertise in project management software (e.g., monday.com, Asana, Wrike) and workflow optimization. Deep understanding of the entire marketing funnel and the role each channel plays. Strong, practical knowledge of SEO principles and how they inform a successful content strategy. Exceptional client-facing communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Experience with analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, SEMrush) is highly desirable. Familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Figma, and ChatGPT. Bonus Points: Experience in B2B or home services industries. Benefits A Note on Our Demands & Your Rewards Let's be transparent: the expectations here are exceptionally high. This role demands a significant investment of your time, energy, and intellectual horsepower. It requires resilience and a proactive, problem-solving mindset that goes far beyond a 9-to-5 checklist. This role is not for everyone. However, for the right person, the rewards are immense. You are not a cog in a machine here. You are a critical driver of our clients' success and our agency's growth. You will be challenged, you will grow faster than you thought possible, and you will see the direct, tangible impact of your strategic work every single day. If you are a builder who is energized by that level of responsibility and impact, you will thrive here. What We Offer Competitive salary commensurate with your experience and impact from $2,000 to $4,000 USD/month A competitive benefits package (details may vary based on your location). Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and company holidays. A fully remote and flexible work environment. A dedicated budget for professional development, courses, and conferences. The opportunity to shape the trajectory of a rapidly growing agency. How to Apply If this sounds like the challenge you've been looking for, please submit your resume. To be considered for this role, please email your answers to the application questions to va@regexseo.com with the subject line: Marketing Resource Manager Test – [Your Name] . At the end of your email, include the phrase: “Regex SEO thrives on clarity and speed.” Please also note your primary working timezone and your general availability for collaboration during US Eastern Time (ET) business hours. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: China Marketing Manager
jobs.description: About the company: Our client is a fast-growing tech start-up founded in 2018 that is revolutionizing the way travelers stay connected to the internet abroad. With a diverse team of over 500 professionals globally, they are helping millions of travelers stay connected across more than 180 destinations worldwide. About the role: Our client is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead the marketing launch and growth of their firm in the Chinese market. This is a foundational hire and a unique opportunity to shape a high-impact business from day one. You will be the first local marketing presence in China, responsible for designing and executing our client's go-to-market strategy, building our brand, acquiring users through the Chinese digital channels, and managing local partnerships and agencies. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and strong executor who is excited to build something from scratch and thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Key Responsibilities Market Strategy & Execution Define and lead the marketing strategy for our client's entry and growth in the Chinese market, aligning with global objectives, global marketing team and local consumer behavior. Develop a comprehensive marketing plan that outlines key acquisition, awareness, and retention initiatives, tailored to the Chinese digital landscape. Select, guide and manage a local marketing agency to execute campaigns across the major Chinese platforms (such as WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Baidu, Douyin) and others ensuring high-quality, culturally relevant execution. Own growth performance, continuously optimizing campaigns for core KPIs such as CAC, ROAS, LTV, and marketing ROI. Track and report on key metrics including impressions, CTR, and conversion rates through regular dashboards and insights reporting. Establish a scalable test-and-learn framework to validate messaging, creative, and targeting strategies for Chinese users. Ensure full regulatory and platform compliance, overseeing that all marketin Build & Localize Our Client's Brand in China Define our client's local brand positioning based on competitive research, customer insights, and market dynamics. Design and execute brand-building initiatives to drive awareness and consideration leveraging content, influencers, partnerships, and community marketing. Ensure all messaging and creatives are localized to resonate with Chinese travelers while staying consistent with our client's global brand identity. Select, negotiate, and manage strategic local partnerships, including agencies, influencers, affiliates, and collaborators who can support both acquisition and brand-building goals. Track and report brand awareness and sentiment, using both qualitative and quantitative tools to assess progress and inform future strategies. Drive ongoing localization of our client's messaging, campaigns, and brand expression, ensuring relevance and resonance with target Chinese audiences. Requirements Must-Haves 5+ years of experience in marketing, digital growth, or go-to-market roles, ideally within startups, scale-ups, or tech-driven companies. Proven track record of launching or scaling digital products or brands in the Chinese market , with both strategic and hands-on responsibilities. Deep expertise in China’s digital ecosystem and analytics tools. Strong background in performance marketing , with experience managing or guiding media buying, creative testing, and KPI optimization (CAC, ROAS, LTV, CTR, impressions, etc.). Strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset , able to independently develop go-to-market plans and marketing strategies from the ground up. Ability to localize brand messaging and creative , aligning global positioning with local culture, trends, and consumer behavior. Demonstrated success m anaging partners and agencies , including negotiations, performance oversight, and alignment to business objectives. Proficiency in setting up and managing dashboards and reporting tools to track marketing effectiveness and competitive intelligence. Based in Mainland China (Shanghai or Beijing preferred) and deeply familiar with local consumer. Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is required. Nice-to-Haves Prior experience working in travel, e-commerce, telco, or consumer tech industries. Experience with influencer or community marketing strategies tailored to Chinese platforms. Experience working in remote and cross-functional teams , collaborating across time zones and business units. MBA or equivalent business/strategy experience is a plus. Benefits Be the first hire in a strategically critical market. Own and shape a high-impact business from Day 1. Join a fast-growing global startup with a remote-first culture. Access to a passionate, international team and exciting travel-tech space.

In a team of more than 40 experts, all passionate about their field, they rely on data-driven performance marketing and the full range of Google channels to ensure long-term success. Your Tasks: Developing tailor-made Google Ads strategies and working closely with account strategists, media buyers and pushing experts to continuously improve the performance of their clients. Using the interaction of Google Ads with other channels such as Meta and Microsoft and develop effective synergies. Creating well-founded market analyses, competitor reports and testing strategies. Optimizing campaigns with your knowledge from the e-commerce sector and know the requirements of Shopify and common shop setups. Developing successful strategies based on market and target group insights. Analyzing KPIs and creating meaningful reports to provide well-founded recommendations for action and ensure long-term success. Advising their customers with data-based recommendations and helping them achieve their goals in the area of Google Ads and Shopping. Google Ads Expertise: Being an expert in the Google Ads environment with a focus on Search & Shopping, including campaign structuring, bidding strategies, budget control and data-based optimization. Feed Optimization: Having experience in optimizing product data feeds and managing them effectively in Shopping campaigns. E-commerce skills: being well-versed in dealing with performance metrics such as ROAS, MER, AOV and conversion rate and optimizing them regularly. In addition, you have in-depth knowledge of buying behavior and target group insights. Analytical thinking: Analyzing data quickly, drawing precise impulses for action and thus driving performance. Self-employment & structure: Working independently and keeping track of complex campaigns. Communication skills: Being able to communicate your ideas clearly and concisely in German (C1). Team spirit: Being a real team player and supporting your colleagues in achieving common goals. Benefits Strategic Contribution and Impact: Contributing your ideas and actively shaping the further development of their strategies. What you bring to the table is of great importance – so you can have a direct say in the success of the agency. Unique Growth Opportunity: Being part of an ambitious and motivated team of experts who encourage each other to perform at their best every day. Continuing Education at All Levels: There are regular masterclasses, each focusing on the agency's expert areas. This way you learn something from your field, but also to think outside the box. In addition to internal masterclasses, there are of course also external resources to make you EVEN BETTER every day. Flexibility: Working 100% remotely and flexibly – you'll be part of an agile team that is constantly striving for new best practices. 2 Workations per year: They don't have an office, but several times a year, they come together from all countries in a villa and can live and work together for a whole week at a time. Home Office Equipment: Getting home office equipment befitting your status. (MacBook etc.)

jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote US Company Description At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale. We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care. We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum , including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network. For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all. Brief Overview As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in driving commercialization of Amwell’s solutions. This role focuses on executing high-impact go-to-market initiatives, enabling enterprise sales teams, supporting strategic deals and RFP responses, and translating complex product capabilities into differentiated, outcome-driven messaging. Sales, RFP & Field Enablement · Develop launch messaging, sales tools, and enablement materials aligned with established positioning · Partner with Sales and proposal teams to support RFP responses with differentiated messaging and positioning · Develop executive-ready materials for strategic opportunities and client presentations · Maintain reusable messaging frameworks that accelerate RFP response development · Develop payer-facing sales materials and supporting resources that help health plan clients communicate program value to their employer group customers · Incorporate field feedback to continuously improve sales tools and messaging · Track and analyze launch and enablement performance to continuously improve commercialization outcomes. Messaging & Competitive Intelligence · Translate complex product and clinical capabilities into clear, outcome-driven messaging · Maintain and evolve competitive battlecards and positioning guidance · Monitor payer and digital health market trends and synthesize insights that inform messaging and field enablement · Cross-Functional Collaboration · Partner with Product teams to understand roadmap priorities and upcoming launches · Collaborate with Performance Marketing to ensure campaign messaging aligns with payer positioning · Work with Customer Success and clinical teams to develop proof points and outcomes-driven narratives · Coordinate with Sales Enablement to support internal training and field readiness Qualifications • 8+ years of product marketing or related B2B marketing experience • Deep fluency in healthcare IT, digital health, or payer markets • Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise sales organizations and complex deal cycles • Proven ability to translate technical capabilities into clear buyer value • Experience developing sales enablement and go-to-market materials for multi-stakeholder buying environments • Strong cross-functional leadership and project management skills • Excellent written and verbal communication skills What Success Looks Like • High-impact launches executed with strong field adoption • Sales teams equipped with differentiated messaging and materials • RFP responses supported with consistent, compelling positioning • Employer-facing enablement materials effectively used by health plan clients • Competitive insights regularly refreshed and actionable Do Well. jobs.title: Marketing Technologies Director
jobs.description: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Marketing Technologies Director The Marketing Technologies Director, leads PlayStation's global marketing technology organization across engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, audience activation, and marketing data. This leader owns the technology vision, architecture, product strategy, and roadmap for platforms used by marketers worldwide to reach hundreds of millions of players. The role is accountable for building secure, scalable, AI-enabled capabilities that improve marketing effectiveness, speed, and customer experience. We are seeking a technology leader with direct software or data engineering experience building marketing technology products and platforms. The successful candidate can lead engineers and technical product teams, make architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, and translate marketing needs into durable systems. Experience limited to administering vendors or managing a marketing technology stack without direct engineering experience does not meet the requirements of this role. Key Responsibilities Technology Engineering and Product Leadership Lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for marketing technology engineering, product management, and UX, with clear goals, operating rhythms, and accountability for delivery. Own end-to-end delivery and operation of global marketing platforms, from discovery and architecture through launch, adoption, reliability, and continuous improvement. Set the architecture for marketing platforms, APIs, data pipelines, audience services, orchestration, and activation integrations. Define the marketing technology product vision and prioritize a multi-year roadmap based on customer value, technical feasibility, business impact, risk, and platform health. Establish engineering standards for security, privacy, reliability, observability, scalability, and the management of technical debt. Lead product discovery and UX research with marketing teams globally, converting user needs into intuitive workflows and measurable product outcomes. Evaluate build, buy, and partner options with technical rigor, and ensure third-party platforms integrate into a coherent, maintainable architecture. Measurement Experimentation and Audience Activation Lead the measurement and experimentation function, including test design, measurement frameworks, platform capabilities, and the use of results in marketing decisions. Lead audience activation and marketing data teams responsible for identity, segmentation, consent-aware audience management, data quality, governance, and activation readiness. Connect audience, measurement, and activation capabilities across marketing channels so teams can plan, execute, learn, and optimize through shared data and platforms. Partner with Data Science and Analytics leaders to embed experimentation, causal measurement, predictive models, and decision support into marketing workflows. Assess and scale AI and automation use cases that improve marketer productivity, decision quality, and customer relevance. Strategy and Transformation Serve as the technical and strategic partner to Media, Creative, Brand Marketing, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Data Science, and Business Analytics leaders. Align SIE teams that own or influence the marketing technology stack around a single architecture, product vision, roadmap, and set of investment priorities. Lead high-priority transformation initiatives, managing execution, organizational dependencies, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. Partner with marketing leaders to redesign workflows, processes, decision rights, and operating models around new platform capabilities. Balance global platform standards with appropriate local and product-level flexibility while maintaining security, privacy, and architectural integrity. Define success measures and post-launch KPI tracking for platform performance, adoption, marketing effectiveness, and business impact. Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, data engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An advanced degree is preferred. 12+ years of experience across software or data engineering, technical product management, and marketing technology, including leadership of global teams. Direct software or data engineering experience and a record of leading engineering teams that built and operated production marketing technology systems. Demonstrated success building, launching, and operating enterprise SaaS products or internal platforms, beyond implementing or administering third-party tools. Technical depth in cloud architecture, APIs, systems integration, data pipelines, identity and audience systems, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability. Experience leading multidisciplinary organizations spanning engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, analytics or data science, and audience activation. Strong command of experimentation methods, marketing measurement, analytics, and the use of data to improve product and marketing decisions. Experience with AI-powered products, machine learning platforms, or automation in production environments. Experience owning multi-year technology and product roadmaps and making investment, architecture, and build-versus-buy decisions. Ability to influence senior leaders, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and lead transformation across teams and regions. At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.  Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.  In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more. This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below. $207,400 — $311,200 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our  Candidate Privacy Notice  for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. Equal Opportunity Statement: Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category. We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.  Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

jobs.description: The Opportunity: The Senior Growth Manager (Paid Search) role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and optimize our paid search strategies, directly influencing Caraway's growth trajectory. jobs.description: About the role As a Senior Paid Search Manager you run 2 to 3 client accounts that need significant oversight, and you manage the people running the rest. A large part of this job now runs through AI, and that has changed what the role spends its time on. If that's not how you want to work, this won't be the right fit. We're a small, growing team. Your responsibilities will grow and change with the company and you'll have an enormous impact on the business. What you'll own Your accounts Run 2 to 3 client accounts that need significant oversight, across Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Shopping) and Microsoft Ads. Set the strategy, and own the bidding and account structure calls. Run budget pacing off a forecast you built, and say where the month lands before the client asks. Write the weekly client report, and the story that goes with the numbers. Your team Manage a few Paid Search Managers. Weekly 1:1s, growth plans, and honest reviews. Review work before it reaches a client. You own the quality bar across the team's accounts, not only your own. Sit in hiring loops. Step onto an account yourself when one is off track. Thought leadership Write for our blog, and build out the paid search playbooks the rest of the team works from. Track what's changing across the platforms, and say what it means for our accounts before a client asks. Run internal sessions and webinars on the things you know best. AI and tooling (this part is not optional) Run reporting and analysis through Claude using our skills and MCP connectors. Build skills and workflows the whole team uses, not only your own. Judge AI output critically, and hold the team to the same standard. New business and measurement Lead audits for prospects, and present them in pitches. Reconcile platform numbers against attribution tools and the client's own reporting. Catch tracking problems before they show up in a report. About you 5+ years hands-on in Google Ads, including time at an agency. Microsoft Ads experience is a plus. You've managed people, or you've been the person others came to and you're ready to make it official. Deep on SEM fundamentals, with opinions you can defend using data. Familiarity with GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking setups. You've built with AI, not only prompted it. A workflow automation, a reporting tool, a script that took a manual step out of your week. Comfortable in spreadsheets: pacing models, pivot tables, audit sheets. You write and speak clearly for a specific reader, and you can hold a room with a founder or an exec. Proactive by default. You raise things before anyone asks, and you take ownership of performance outcomes. Bonus: Shopping feeds, YouTube, cross-channel context (Meta, TikTok), or hands-on tracking implementation. What you'll find here Competitive salary with bonus structure 99% coverage for health, dental, and vision Distributed, remote, and global culture Unlimited vacation with 3 weeks required vacation Unlimited mental health or physical health leave Remote work budget to make it easier to work from wherever you feel most productive! Monthly physical activity budget to get your body moving 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave Stipend for laptop and other home office equipment Indoor plant budget Annual company-wide retreat Yearly stipend for books, seminars, courses, and coaches Matching for charitable donations Flourishing at Pearmill We get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction out of making the things around us better at their jobs. Clients who arrived wanting a channel fixed and left with a system. People who joined to run ad accounts and left able to build a team that runs global strategy. And most recently, our little AI agents running around our Notion docs and giving us super powers. We're a fast growing, diverse group of goofy yet dedicated marketers, creatives, engineers, and analysts, running over $500M in ad spend across 15+ platforms. Join us!

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description: [Full-time] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to own paid user acquisition end to end. You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable. This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit. Key Responsibilities Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across all paid channels, with an initial focus on SEM and paid social, then expanding into CTV, paid sponsorships, and new channels as the data supports it. Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue. Analyze audience and placement data to find new opportunities and cut inefficient segments Report on paid performance and test results weekly, and translate results into a clear point of view on what we do next Partner with our data team to make sure attribution, tracking, and conversion measurement are trustworthy—and flag it loudly when they aren't Evaluate and manage agencies, vendors, and tools where they extend our capacity Evolve the acquisition roadmap based on performance, seasonality, competitive shifts, and new audience insight Requirements 6+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with meaningful time in a consumer/B2C environment Hands-on operator experience in Google Ads and paid social (Meta at minimum; Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok a plus)—you've built and optimized accounts yourself, not just briefed an agency Track record of owning a paid budget of at least $1M annually and hitting efficiency targets, with specific numbers you can walk through Strong analytical skills: comfortable pulling your own numbers from BI or warehouse layer, and able to build your own reporting rather than waiting on someone else Working understanding of attribution, incrementality, and measurement limitations—you know when a number is directional vs. reliable Experience with subscription or freemium business models, and comfort optimizing to downstream revenue rather than lead volume Demonstrated CRO instincts and experience partnering on landing page and funnel testing Clear written communication—you can explain performance and tradeoffs to a leadership audience without a translator Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you set your own priorities Salary Range $140,000 – $175,000 + Equity + Performance Based Bonus - DOE We want to be as inclusive as possible in our hiring process.
